summary: AI systems increasingly operate between flexible input representations and formal objects used by downstream tools. A key challenge is recognizing when an unfamiliar formulation denotes a known formal object. We study this challenge through theorem recognition: given an equivalence-preserving transformation of a theorem condition, a model must recover the theorem identity associated with the standard statement. We introduce TREAT, a benchmark for evaluating whether large language models can recover known theorem identities from equivalence-preserving formula-level transformations. Rather than paraphrasing theorem text, TREAT changes the mathematical form of theorem conditions themselves, expressing known results through residual equations, witness statements, optimization identities, set relations, operator forms, and proof-intermediate characterizations. Starting from scraped theorem pages, we filter for entries with usable mathematical expression forms, extract canonical theorem conditions, and generate transformed variants with recorded assumptions and inverse mappings. The final corpus contains 737 theorem identities and 29,480 transformed rows. On a test panel, the best model retrieves the correct theorem identity in only 60.73% of cases. Other systems reveal different failure modes, including abstention, wrong detection, and malformed outputs. These suggest that theorem knowledge can be fragile under equivalent changes in representation. TREAT therefore provides a controlled testbed for evaluating representation-robust access to formal knowledge, with broader relevance to domains that require stable target objects, explicit equivalence relations, validation procedures, and auditable scoring.

AI.tldr: TREAT是一个基准测试集，用于评估大语言模型能否在等价保持的公式级变换下识别已知定理的身份。该基准包含737个定理身份和29,480个变换样本，最优模型在测试面板上仅有60.73%的正确率，表明模型在等价的表示变化下对定理知识的访问是脆弱的。
AI.motivation: AI系统越来越多地在灵活输入表示和下游工具使用的形式对象之间运行，关键挑战在于识别不熟悉的表述是否指代已知的形式对象。现有工作仅关注文本改写而非改变数学形式，缺乏对定理身份识别在等价变换下鲁棒性的系统评估。
AI.method: TREAT通过以下步骤构建：(1)从定理网页爬取并过滤具有可用数学表达形式的条目；(2)提取规范定理条件；(3)生成等价保持的变换变体（包括残差方程、见证语句、优化恒等式、集合关系、算子形式、证明中间特征化），并记录假设条件和逆映射。基准包含737个定理身份和29,480个变换行。
AI.result: 最佳模型在测试面板上仅达到60.73%的定理身份检索正确率；其他系统表现出不同的失败模式，包括弃权、错误检测和格式异常输出。
AI.conclusion: 定理知识在等价的表示变化下是脆弱的。TREAT为评估表示鲁棒的形式知识访问提供了一个受控测试平台，其设计原则（稳定的目标对象、显式等价关系、验证程序和可审计评分）可推广到需要类似特性的更多领域。

title: Thinking Hard, Not Smart: Reasoning Models Fail to Ration Test-Time Compute Across Questions
summary: Reasoning language models increasingly use test-time compute to improve performance, but existing evaluations typically study this compute one question at a time. Yet when multiple problems share an end-to-end cost or latency constraint, models must decide how to divide limited inference compute among them. We introduce an exam-style evaluation framework for studying this setting, in which a model must distribute one shared token budget across questions with different difficulty and point values to maximize its total score. Across several open and frontier reasoning models, we find that models fail to allocate a shared budget strategically across questions of varying difficulties and values. Models behave largely as greedy sequential solvers: they prioritize questions by presentation order, front-load effort on early questions, and remain insensitive to value, with these tendencies becoming more pronounced as the number of questions grows. Explicit planning prompts spread compute more evenly but do not produce value- or difficulty-aware prioritization. The same behavioral pattern extends from mathematical to code reasoning. These findings establish global budget allocation as a distinct capability that is not captured by conventional per-question evaluation and remains a challenge for current reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个考试式评估框架，研究推理模型如何在共享推理预算下跨多个问题分配计算资源。研究发现，无论开源还是前沿推理模型，都无法策略性地分配共享预算——它们表现得像贪心顺序求解器，按呈现顺序优先处理、在早期问题上投入过多精力、对问题分值不敏感，且这些问题随问题数量增加而加剧。
AI.motivation: 现有推理模型的评估通常一次只研究一个问题的test-time compute使用情况，但在多个问题共享端到端成本或延迟约束的真实场景中，模型必须决定如何在问题之间分配有限的推理计算。这一全局预算分配能力尚未被系统性研究。
AI.method: 引入考试式评估框架，要求模型在多个难度和分值不同的问题之间分配一个共享的token预算以最大化总分。对多个开源和前沿推理模型进行测试，并比较了默认行为与显式规划提示下的表现，同时验证了该行为模式在数学推理和代码推理任务中的一致性。
AI.result: 模型无法策略性地分配共享预算，表现得像贪心顺序求解器：按呈现顺序优先处理问题、在早期问题上过度投入、对分值不敏感，这些倾向随问题数量增加而更明显。显式规划提示虽然使计算分配更均匀，但并未产生分值或难度感知的优先级排序。该行为模式在数学推理和代码推理中一致存在。
AI.conclusion: 全局预算分配是一种独立于传统逐问题评估的能力，现有推理模型在此方面仍存在明显挑战。研究结果表明需要新的评估方法和训练策略来提升推理模型的全局资源分配能力。

title: Temporal Generalization in fNIRS-Based Autism Classification: A Cross-Time-Window Transfer Benchmark
summary: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) classification, yet existing approaches assume temporally aligned evaluation. In practice, the optimal observation window varies across subjects due to differences in hemodynamic delay and neurovascular coupling, creating a temporal distribution shift that degrades performance. We formalize this as a \textit{cross-time-window transfer problem}, introducing a protocol that varies window length (2.5--10\,s) and offset within biological motion trials. Using topographic map representations of fNIRS recordings, we benchmark three vision architectures under two zero-shot baselines and eight adaptation strategies under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation ($N{=}124$). Key findings: (1) zero-shot cross-window accuracy is near chance (54--69\%); (2) ${\approx}5\%$ subject-specific fine-tuning recovers 90--96\%, while a subject-specific upper bound reaches 97--100\%, identifying inter-subject variability as the dominant barrier; (3) domain-adversarial and self-supervised strategies achieve 78--90\% without target-subject data; and (4) discriminative information is recoverable from windows as short as 2.5\,s. These findings provide a practical roadmap for deploying fNIRS-based ASD classifiers under realistic temporal variability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究功能近红外光谱（fNIRS）在自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）分类中的跨时间窗迁移问题。由于个体间的血液动力学延迟和神经血管耦合差异，最佳观测窗口因人而异，造成时间分布偏移。作者提出了跨时间窗迁移协议（窗口长度2.5-10秒），并通过拓扑图表示、三种视觉架构、两种零样本基线和八种适应策略在124名受试者上进行了系统评测。关键发现包括：零样本跨窗口准确率接近随机（54-69%）；约5%的受试者特定微调可恢复90-96%的准确率；域对抗和自监督策略在无目标数据时可达78-90%；2.5秒的短窗口即可提取判别性信息。
AI.motivation: 现有fNIRS-based ASD分类方法假设时间对齐的评估场景，但实际应用中由于个体间血液动力学延迟和神经血管耦合差异，最佳观测窗口长度和偏移各不相同，导致时间分布偏移并使模型性能严重退化。作者希望形式化并解决这一跨时间窗迁移问题，为实际部署提供可行方案。
AI.method: 作者将fNIRS记录转化为拓扑图表示，提出跨时间窗迁移协议（变化窗口长度2.5-10秒及偏移量），在生物运动任务条件下系统评测三种视觉架构（两种零样本基线和八种适应策略），采用留一受试者交叉验证（N=124），比较零样本、受试者特定微调、域对抗和自监督等多种策略的跨窗口迁移性能。
AI.result: （1）零样本跨窗口准确率仅为54-69%，接近随机水平；（2）约5%的受试者特定数据微调可将准确率恢复至90-96%，而受试者特定上界可达97-100%，表明受试者间变异性是主要障碍；（3）域对抗和自监督策略在无目标受试者数据的情况下实现78-90%的准确率；（4）最短2.5秒的窗口即可恢复判别性信息。
AI.conclusion: 受试者间变异性是跨时间窗迁移的核心障碍，少量受试者特定微调即可大幅恢复性能，而无标注数据的域适应策略也具备实际可行性。该研究为fNIRS-based ASD分类器在真实时间变异性条件下的部署提供了实践路线图。

title: An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop
summary: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu. Neither arm drifts: both falsify roughly three quarters of their own hypotheses, and the best trained policy comes from the oracle-less arm. What the oracle changes is direction, not score: it alone explores test-time adaptation, it authored the winning designs where its arm led, and it carried lessons across streams that the other arm repeatedly re-derived. The scaffold keeps the loop honest; kkanbu decides where it looks.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个面向四足机器人导航策略泛化研究的AI科学家系统。该系统在Karpathy的自研循环范式上增加了三个组件：不可变实验卡片（防止假设被事后修正）、职责受限的专用子代理、以及kkanbu偏好oracle（以类型化知识图谱承载用户研究品味并进行主观判断）。实验通过11条研究流、有无oracle的对照表明：两条臂均不漂移（约3/4假设被证伪），最佳策略来自无oracle臂；oracle改变的是研究方向而非分数，它独自探索了测试时适应，并在跨流传播经验。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型驱动的自主研究循环虽能以规模运行机器学习实验，但往往容易向其优化的指标做局部收敛（局部细化），而非检验驱动实验的假设。作者旨在从结构上解决这一漂移问题，构建一个能忠实检验假设而非单纯优化指标的自主AI科学家系统。
AI.method: 在Karpathy的autoresearch范式基础上，编码循环新增三个组件：(1) 不可变实验卡片，在固定schema下将每次迭代的预测与结果配对，使被证伪的假设无法事后改写（防retconned）；(2) 专职子代理，各自被限制在机械性角色中；(3) kkanbu偏好oracle，将用户研究品味表示为类型化知识图谱，是唯一被允许做主观判断的组件。为隔离oracle作用，在11条研究流上以有无kkanbu进行相同的两次循环运行。
AI.result: 两条运行臂（有/无oracle）均未发生漂移，各自约3/4的自有假设被证伪；整体最佳训练策略来自无oracle臂。oracle带来的改变是方向而非分数：只有它探索了测试时适应，在其领先的支流中主导产生了获胜设计，并将经验跨研究流传播（这些经验在另一臂中被反复重新发现）。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明：脚手架（不可变卡片+专职子代理）保证循环保持诚实/不漂移，而kkanbu oracle决定研究的探索方向。二者解耦——oracle的贡献在于引导研究路线而非提升最终得分。

title: Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP): Hallucination Detection in LLMs from Hidden States
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent and useful responses but remain prone to hallucinations. We introduce Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP), a white-box method for answer-level hallucination detection from the hidden states of a frozen LLM. PEP extends standard linear probes by augmenting the input with a small number of learnable prompt embeddings. We evaluate PEP on TriviaQA, GSM8K, and MedQA using Qwen3 models at multiple scales. PEP improves hidden-state-based detection over standard linear probes in the main in-distribution setting. We further evaluate PEP for pre-generation prediction, cross-model transfer, and out-of-distribution generalization. PEP remains effective in the pre-generation and cross-model settings, whereas robust cross-dataset transfer remains difficult. These results show that prompt-based adaptation can strengthen hidden-state probing while keeping the backbone frozen and adding only a small number of trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Prompt Embedding Probes (PEP)，一种用于大语言模型答案级幻觉检测的白盒方法，通过向标准线性探针的输入中加入少量可学习的提示嵌入来增强检测能力，在TriviaQA、GSM8K和MedQA上使用Qwen3模型验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然能生成流畅有用的回答，但容易出现幻觉（hallucination）。现有基于隐藏状态的检测方法（如标准线性探针）在答案级幻觉检测上性能有限，需要一种更有效的白盒方法来从冻结LLM的隐藏状态中检测幻觉。
AI.method: PEP在标准线性探针的基础上进行扩展，通过向探针输入中增加少量可学习的提示嵌入（prompt embeddings）来增强检测能力。该方法保持LLM骨干网络冻结，仅增加少量可训练参数。
AI.result: PEP在主要的同分布（in-distribution）设置下优于标准线性探针的隐藏状态检测。在前置生成预测和跨模型迁移场景中PEP依然有效，但跨数据集迁移仍然困难。
AI.conclusion: 基于提示的自适应方法可以在保持骨干网络冻结、仅增加少量可训练参数的情况下增强隐藏状态探针的性能，但跨数据集的鲁棒泛化仍是一个待解决的挑战。

title: Latent-Frequency Validity: Fast Spectral Editing with Screened Video-VAE Transfer Operators
summary: Direct spectral editing in video-VAE latents can control noise, flicker, smoothness, and frequency content without a decode--filter--reencode pass. However, video VAEs may redistribute pixel-space frequency bands across latent channels, and latent edits can disrupt VAE round-trip dynamics. We introduce \emph{latent-frequency validity} (LFV), which learns a compact VAE-specific spectral response and deploys it only when it improves decoded-target fidelity without worsening round-trip drift. LFV follows a validation-selected path from a diagonal per-frequency calibrator (C1) to full channel mixing (CM), making cross-channel capacity a controllable per-edit resource. Across 544 VAE--edit cells spanning six spectral families, LFV emits 423 cheap operators: 277 are handled by C1, while 146 (34.5\% of emitted operators) require channel mixing. On the primary 120-cell radial sweep, 99/100 emitted operators pass source-video-grouped held-out evaluation. Across five additional filter families, all 323 emitted operators pass held-out evaluation. Fully frozen OpenVid-fitted operators, including the validation-selected path coefficient, pass all 20 tested CogVideoX and HunyuanVideo generated-domain cells without adaptation. The selected response matches direct latent-filter latency and is about $3\times$ faster than pixel filter--reencode. The resulting maps reveal distinct VAE regimes, including strongly channel-coupled CogVideoX responses and a sharp Open-Sora high-band stability frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"潜空间频率有效性"(LFV)方法，在视频VAE潜空间中实现直接谱编辑，通过学习VAE特定的紧凑频谱响应来控制噪声、闪烁、平滑度和频率内容，无需解码-滤波-重编码的往返过程。LFV通过验证选择路径，从对角逐频率校准器(C1)演进到全通道混合(CM)，将跨通道容量作为可控的每编辑资源。实验覆盖544个VAE-编辑单元和六个频谱族，LFV产生了423个廉价算子（其中277个由C1处理，146个需要通道混合），在120单元径向扫描中99/100的发射算子通过保留验证，所有323个发射算子在其他五个滤波器族中通过保留验证。冻结的OpenVid拟合算子（含验证选择路径系数）在所有20个CogVideoX和HunyuanVideo生成域单元中通过测试，且延迟与直接潜过滤相当，约为像素滤波-重编码的3倍快。
AI.motivation: 视频VAE潜空间中的直接谱编辑具有控制噪声、闪烁、平滑度和频率内容的潜力，但存在两大挑战：一方面VAE可能在潜通道间重新分配像素空间的频带，导致潜空间编辑不可靠；另一方面，潜编辑可能破坏VAE的往返（round-trip）动力学，影响生成质量。因此需要一种方法来确保潜空间编辑的有效性与保真度。
AI.method: LFV方法包含以下核心步骤：(1) 学习一个紧凑的、VAE特定的频谱响应模型；(2) 仅在提升解码目标保真度且不恶化往返漂移时部署该响应；(3) 采用验证选择路径，从对角逐频率校准器(C1)逐步演进到全通道混合(CM)，使跨通道容量成为可控的每编辑资源；(4) 在544个VAE-编辑单元和六个频谱族上系统验证，覆盖径向扫描、多个滤波器族及OpenVid、CogVideoX、HunyuanVideo等VAE。
AI.result: LFV产生了423个廉价算子，其中277个由C1对角校准器处理，146个（占发射算子的34.5%）需要通道混合。在主要120单元径向扫描中，99/100的发射算子通过源视频分组保留验证；在其余五个滤波器族中，全部323个发射算子通过保留验证。完全冻结的OpenVid拟合算子（包括验证选择的路径系数）在所有20个CogVideoX和HunyuanVideo生成域单元中通过测试而无需适配。延迟方面，选择的响应与直接潜过滤匹配，约为像素滤波-重编码的3倍快。结果还揭示了不同的VAE机制，包括强通道耦合的CogVideoX响应和Open-Sora的高频带稳定性边界。
AI.conclusion: LFV证明了通过学习紧凑的VAE特定频谱响应并在验证指导下选择性部署，可以在潜空间中实现高效且可靠的直接谱编辑，避免昂贵的解码-滤波-重编码流程。方法在多个VAE和滤波器族上展现了强大的泛化能力，即使完全冻结的算子也能迁移到未见过的生成域。LFV还提供了分析VAE潜空间频谱行为的工具，揭示了不同VAE体系的谱响应特征，为未来视频编辑和生成任务中的潜空间操作提供了基础。

title: The Field Knows: Cross-Dimensional Geometry from Navigation to Black Holes
summary: We introduce a continuous metric field framework trained by a single causal contrastive loss. The framework encodes a scene into coefficients of a fixed symmetric matrix basis, assembles them into a Lie algebra element, and exponentiates the result to a Riemannian or Lorentzian metric. Across dimensions, this field discovers the full spectrum of geometric structures: from obstacle-avoiding geodesics in robot navigation across planar and manipulator configuration spaces, to event horizons of black holes in Lorentzian spacetime. Extensive zero-shot generalization studies demonstrate that the field captures transferable geometric structure rather than memorizing specific configurations. In the black hole setting, the causal loss spontaneously evolves genuine black-hole-like structures with the correct Lorentzian signature. The same loss, the same architecture, and the same training protocol produce the full range of geometric phenomena across dimensions. The field knows geometry, and geometry knows physics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种连续度量场框架，通过单一因果对比损失训练，将场景编码为对称矩阵基的系数，组装成李代数元素并指数化为黎曼或洛伦兹度量。该框架在不同维度上发现了完整的几何结构谱系：从机器人导航中的避障测地线到黑洞事件视界。零样本泛化研究表明该场捕获了可迁移的几何结构而非记忆特定配置。
AI.motivation: 现有的几何学习框架通常针对特定维度或特定几何类型设计，缺乏一个统一的、能够跨维度发现不同几何结构（从黎曼测地线到洛伦兹时空）的普适框架。作者希望证明一个统一的架构和学习目标可以在不同物理与几何场景中自发涌现出正确的几何结构。
AI.method: 采用连续度量场框架，以单个因果对比损失作为唯一训练目标。网络将场景编码为固定对称矩阵基的系数，组装这些系数形成李代数元素，再通过矩阵指数映射得到黎曼或洛伦兹度量。整个流程在不同维度（平面、机械臂构型空间、洛伦兹时空）上采用相同的架构和训练协议。
AI.result: 该框架在机器人导航（平面与机械臂构型空间）中学习到避障测地线；在洛伦兹时空中，因果对比损失自发演化出具有正确洛伦兹符号的真实黑洞类似结构（事件视界）。广泛的零样本泛化实验表明模型捕获了可迁移的几何结构而非记忆特定配置。
AI.conclusion: 同一损失函数、同一架构、同一训练协议即可跨维度产生完整的几何现象谱系，表明度量场框架具有通用性。该工作架起了几何学习与物理学之间的桥梁——"场懂几何，几何懂物理"，为统一处理不同维度下几何与物理问题提供了新范式。

title: APEX-VW: A Document-Level English-Spanish Post-Editing Dataset in the Healthcare Domain
summary: Post-Editing (PE) of Machine Translation (MT) output often involves repeating the same lexical and terminological corrections across many segments, especially in specialised and highly repetitive documents. Despite substantial work on Automatic Post-Editing (APE), most available corpora operate at the sentence level, others are synthetic, and overall not designed to study how corrections propagate in realistic Computer-Assisted Translation (CAT) workflows. This paper presents the APEX-VW (Automatic Post-Editing eXperiments on Virtual Wards) Corpus, a new open English-Spanish (EN-ES) dataset built from recent NHS virtual-ward documents and professional PE in Trados Studio, with controlled MT, terminology, and quality assurance settings. The corpus contains seven document-coherent source texts totalling 42k words, translated with four MT systems representing different paradigms and then post-edited by professional translators. Unlike prior resources such as WMT APE corpora, eSCAPE, MLQE-PE, or LangMark, the dataset preserves document order and CAT-tool context, making it suitable for research on terminology normalisation, correction propagation, and human-in-the-loop translation support. The paper describes the corpus design, data preparation, PE setup, and initial corpus statistics, and positions the resource as a benchmark for document-level APE and propagation-aware assistive tools.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍APEX-VW语料库，一个基于英国NHS虚拟病房文档构建的开放英西平行数据集，包含四套MT系统翻译的42k词源文本及专业译员人工后编辑，保留了文档顺序和CAT工具上下文，专为文档级自动后编辑（APE）和术语修正传播研究设计。
AI.motivation: 现有APE语料库大多在句级层面工作，或为合成数据，未能反映真实CAT工作流中修正如何在文档内传播的现象。在专业化和高重复性文档中，同一词汇和术语修正跨段落反复出现，但缺乏保留文档上下文和CAT工具环境的资源来研究这一挑战。
AI.method: 从NHS虚拟病房真实文档中选取7份文档连贯的源文本（共42k词），使用代表不同范式的四套MT系统进行翻译，再由专业译员在Trados Studio环境中执行受控后编辑，同时设置了术语表和QA管理。语料库保留了文档顺序和CAT工具上下文，而非句级孤立处理。
AI.result: APEX-VW语料库提供了首个保留文档级上下文和CAT工具环境的英西APE数据集，与WMT APE、eSCAPE、MLQE-PE和LangMark等现有资源相比，支持术语规范化、修正传播和人机协同翻译辅助研究。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库被定位为文档级APE和传播感知辅助工具的基准资源，为研究如何在真实专业翻译场景中实现修正传播和术语一致性提供了基础。

title: COMEX: A Composition-Grounded Benchmark and Learning Framework for Explainable Aesthetic Image Cropping
summary: Explainable aesthetic image cropping requires not only localizing a visually pleasing crop but also explaining why it is preferred. Existing crop-and-explain methods largely treat explanation as post-hoc text generation and overlook composition, a key aesthetic factor that links crop decisions with interpretable reasoning. In this paper, we reformulate explainable aesthetic image cropping as a structured crop-composition-explanation problem. To support this setting, we introduce COMEX, a new benchmark built through image expansion and an IO-reversal pipeline. COMEX contains 33,161 quadruples, each consisting of an expanded image, a crop box, a composition category, and a composition-grounded explanation, enabling joint learning of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation. We further propose a two-stage SFT+GRPO framework, where supervised fine-tuning establishes the structured output protocol and basic cropping ability, and GRPO further improves crop quality, composition prediction, and explanation faithfulness. We benchmark 15 large vision-language models and existing cropping methods on COMEX, establishing a comprehensive testbed for composition-grounded explainable aesthetic cropping. Experiments on both COMEX and prior benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of our framework, with strong performance across evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可解释美学图像裁剪问题，将其重构为"裁剪框-构图-解释"的结构化任务。作者引入COMEX基准测试集（包含33,161个四元组），并提出一个两阶段SFT+GRPO框架，先通过监督微调建立结构化输出协议和基础裁剪能力，再用GRPO提升裁剪质量、构图预测和解释忠实度。实验在COMEX和先前基准上验证了该框架的有效性和可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释美学图像裁剪方法将解释视为事后文本生成（post-hoc），忽略了构图这一连接裁剪决策与可解释推理的关键美学因素。作者希望将可解释裁剪从"先裁剪再解释"的解耦范式转变为"裁剪-构图-解释"联合学习的结构化问题。
AI.method: 1) 提出COMEX基准，通过图像扩展和IO-reversal流水线构建，包含33,161个四元组（扩展图、裁剪框、构图类别、基于构图的解释），支持裁剪定位、构图理解和解释生成的联合学习。2) 提出两阶段SFT+GRPO框架：第一阶段监督微调建立结构化输出协议和基础裁剪能力；第二阶段GRPO（group relative policy optimization）进一步优化裁剪质量、构图预测准确性和解释忠实度。
AI.result: 在COMEX上基准测试了15个大视觉语言模型和现有裁剪方法，建立了构图可解释美学裁剪的全面测试平台。在COMEX和先前基准上的实验均表明所提框架具有有效性和强可迁移性，各项评估指标表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 将可解释美学裁剪重构为结构化裁剪-构图-解释问题是有效的研究范式，COMEX基准和两阶段SFT+GRPO框架能够同时提升裁剪质量、构图理解和解释生成能力，且具有良好的跨基准泛化能力。

title: TeXFix-Bench: An Empirically Grounded Multi-Format Benchmark for LLM-Based Document Source Repair
summary: Scientific and technical writing depends on markup sources that must compile: LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown pipelines fail on missing delimiters, mismatched environments, broken imports, or package conflicts. Existing document-repair evaluations inject faults with ad-hoc edits that lack an empirical fault model. We present TeXFix-Bench, a multi-format benchmark for LLM-based full-source document repair grounded in a mined fault taxonomy. A Grounded-Theory study of localized hard-crash LaTeX faults from TeX Stack Exchange, GitHub commits, and package documentation (168 verified faults, dual open coding at $κ$=0.34) yields an 18-category taxonomy instantiated as DocMut: 48 AST-aware operators across three formats. A three-model cross-benchmark shows DocMut faults are 5.6-9.2 pp harder to repair than pattern-based mutations on the same seeds, and a real-error case study (88 mined human crashes, 67.0% repair success) brackets both synthetic sets from below. We construct 10,437 instances from 743 openly licensed seeds and evaluate seven LLMs under a fixed zero-shot protocol with provider-pinned routing, collecting 48,651 attempts at about USD 200 total inference cost. A complete 6,613-instance x 7-model balanced matrix confirms all rankings. A pinned engine gate yields a 27.5-point intention-to-treat compile spread (56.7-84.2%). Typst is markedly harder than LaTeX and Markdown. A restoration oracle over 28,129 compiling repairs shows that 13.6-18.5% of compiling repairs materially alter document text, and restoration rank diverges from compile rank: the model with the lowest compile rate restores content best among its successes. Compile success alone overstates repair quality. We release the taxonomy, DocMut, and all campaign artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TeXFix-Bench，一个基于经验挖掘故障分类法的多格式文档修复基准。通过扎根理论研究从 LaTeX 实际崩溃中归纳出 18 类故障分类法（168 个已验证故障），并实例化为 DocMut——跨三种格式（LaTeX/Typst/Markdown）的 48 个 AST 感知变异算子。基于 743 个开源种子构建 10,437 个实例，评估 7 个 LLM、共 48,651 次尝试、约 200 美元推理成本。结果显示 DocMut 故障比模式化变异难修复 5.6-9.2 个百分点；固定零样本协议下编译成功率为 56.7-84.2%；编译成功会高估修复质量（13.6-18.5% 的编译成功修复实质改变了文档文本），且恢复指标与编译指标排名不一致。
AI.motivation: 现有文档修复评估依赖临时、随意注入的故障，缺乏经验支撑的故障模型，导致评估结果不能真实反映 LLM 在实际文档修复场景中的性能。作者希望建立一个基于真实故障经验的多格式文档修复基准。
AI.method: 1) 对 TeX Stack Exchange、GitHub commits 和包文档中的 LaTeX 硬崩溃故障进行扎根理论研究，双人开放编码（κ=0.34），得到 168 个已验证故障，归纳为 18 类分类法。2) 将分类法实例化为 DocMut，包含 48 个跨三种格式的 AST 感知变异算子。3) 从 743 个开源许可种子构建 10,437 个实例。4) 在固定零样本协议+供应商固定路由下评估 7 个 LLM，收集 48,651 次尝试。5) 进行完整 6,613 实例×7 模型的平衡矩阵、真实错误案例研究（88 个崩溃，67.0% 修复成功率）和恢复 oracle（28,129 个编译成功修复）。
AI.result: DocMut 故障比模式化变异在相同种子上难 5.6-9.2 个百分点；真实错误案例以 67.0% 的修复成功率从下方包裹两个合成集。7 个 LLM 编译成功率跨度为 56.7-84.2%（27.5 点意图治疗差距）。Typst 明显比 LaTeX 和 Markdown 更难。13.6-18.5% 的编译成功修复实质改变了文档文本，且恢复排名与编译排名不一致——编译率最低的模型在其成功案例中内容恢复最佳。
AI.conclusion: 编译成功单独作为指标会高估修复质量；恢复（内容保真）是与编译互补的关键维度。作者发布分类法、DocMut 及所有实验工件，为后续文档修复研究提供基准基础。

title: DialectS2S: End-to-End Speech Dialogue Modeling for Low-Resource Chinese Dialects
summary: Current end-to-end speech dialogue models are primarily optimized for mainstream languages and remain limited in low-resource dialect scenarios due to the scarcity of dialect speech data. Moreover, during dialect adaptation, the semantic representation space of speech dialogue models continuously evolves, while conventional speech supervision remains unchanged, leading to semantic inconsistency between hidden representations and speech targets and degrading speech stability and naturalness. To address these issues, we propose DialectS2S, an end-to-end speech dialogue model for Chinese dialects. We first develop a scalable dialect speech dialogue synthesis pipeline for efficient data construction. We further introduce a two-stage post-training strategy with self-aligned speech supervision, which aligns the semantic content of speech supervision with the evolved semantic representations of the model to improve dialect speech generation quality. Experimental results show that DialectS2S consistently outperforms existing baselines across multiple Chinese dialects in speech dialogue, achieving substantial improvements in dialect consistency, response quality, and speech intelligibility. Our work provides an efficient and scalable solution for end-to-end speech dialogue modeling in low-resource dialect scenarios. To facilitate future research and practical applications, we fully open-source the DialectS2S framework, including model checkpoints, training datasets, and fine-tuning code.

AI.tldr: DialectS2S是一个面向中文方言的端到端语音对话模型，通过可扩展的方言语音对话合成管线高效构建数据，并引入两阶段后训练策略配合自对齐语音监督，解决低资源方言场景下语音对话模型语义表示空间演化与固定语音监督不一致的问题，在多个中文方言上显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端语音对话模型主要针对主流语言优化，在低资源方言场景下受限于方言语音数据稀缺；此外，方言适应过程中模型语义表示空间持续演化，而传统语音监督保持不变，导致隐藏表示与语音目标之间存在语义不一致，损害语音稳定性和自然度。
AI.method: 1) 提出可扩展的方言语音对话合成管线用于高效数据构建；2) 引入两阶段后训练策略，采用自对齐语音监督，使语音监督的语义内容与模型演化的语义表示相对齐，以提升方言语音生成质量。
AI.result: DialectS2S在多个中文方言的语音对话任务上一致优于现有基线，在方言一致性、响应质量和语音可懂度方面均取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低资源方言场景下的端到端语音对话建模提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案，并全面开源框架（含模型权重、训练数据集和微调代码）以促进后续研究与应用。

title: A Review of Vision-Based Vehicle Detection for UAV-Based Traffic Monitoring: Experimental Insights and Future Directions
summary: In Intelligent Transportation System (ITS), unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based surveillance offers an innovative solution to traffic surveillance with wide coverage and real-time data collection capabilities. In comparison to fixed ground-based infrastructure, UAVs are able to respond to dynamic traffic but present challenges such as vehicle detection at varying altitudes, compensation for motion-induced image variations and efficient processing of high-resolution images. Deep learning has been largely beneficial on improving the detection accuracy; however, for practical deployment, a critical assessment of the accuracy, latency, and harmonization with current transportation systems needs to be carefully considered. This survey reviews recent advancements in the UAV-based traffic monitoring, with a primary focus being deep neural network models for traffic analytics in various urban settings. Three main challenges identified in the literature are ensuring compatibility with traffic control systems, achieving real-time processing to optimize traffic flow, and maintaining robust detection in different environmental conditions. Existing solutions often lack comprehensive frameworks for utilizing UAV captured data to respond to incidents and manage traffic effectively. Future research should focus on optimal detection models, edge processing, and adaptive control integration to improve the responsiveness of urban traffic management.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于无人机(UAV)的智能交通监控系统中深度学习模型的应用现状，识别出三大挑战：与交通控制系统的兼容性、实时处理能力以及不同环境条件下的鲁棒检测，并指出未来研究方向应聚焦于最优检测模型、边缘处理和自适应控制集成。
AI.motivation: 无人机相较于固定地面基础设施具有广覆盖和实时数据采集能力，能够响应动态交通变化，但同时也面临变高度车辆检测、运动补偿和高分辨率图像高效处理等挑战。虽然深度学习显著提升了检测精度，但在实际部署中仍需对精度、时延及与现有交通系统的协调进行关键评估，因此需要系统性的综述研究。
AI.method: 本文采用调查综述的方法，系统回顾了基于无人机的交通监控领域的最新进展，重点关注用于各类城市环境中交通分析的深度神经网络模型，并从文献中提炼出三大核心挑战。
AI.result: 识别出三个主要挑战：(1)确保与交通控制系统的兼容性；(2)实现实时处理以优化交通流；(3)在不同环境条件下保持稳健的检测能力。同时指出现有解决方案缺乏综合利用无人机感知数据进行事故响应和交通管理的综合框架。
AI.conclusion: 未来研究应聚焦于最优检测模型、边缘计算处理和自适应控制集成三个方面，以提升城市交通管理的响应能力。

title: CMU-Drive and V2V-VLA: Cooperative Multi-agent Unified Driving with Reasoning Benchmark and Vehicle-to-Vehicle Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently achieved impressive performance for end-to-end autonomous driving, yet existing approaches are primarily designed for an individual single autonomous driving agent with limited support for cooperative perception, reasoning, and planning. We present Cooperative Multi-agent Unified Driving with Reasoning (CMU-Drive), a closed-loop end-to-end benchmark for evaluating cooperative autonomous driving with multiple connected autonomous vehicles (CAVs) operating in safety-critical driving scenarios with background traffic participants. We further propose Vehicle-to-Vehicle Vision-Language-Action (V2V-VLA), a cooperative VLA model that integrates cooperative driving into a single forward pass by jointly generating driving actions, future waypoints, language reasoning, and communication policies. Experiments on CMU-Drive establish the first benchmark and baseline for cooperative VLA driving and provide a foundation for future research on multi-agent, closed-loop, end-to-end cooperative autonomous driving. Our code, benchmark, and model checkpoint will be publicly released to facilitate open-source research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CMU-Drive，一个用于评估多智能体协同自动驾驶的闭环端到端基准，并提出V2V-VLA，一个将协同驾驶集成到单次前向传播中的车对车视觉-语言-动作模型，统一生成驾驶动作、未来路点、语言推理和通信策略。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型在端到端自动驾驶中取得显著性能，但大多数方法仅针对单一自动驾驶智能体设计，缺乏对协同感知、推理和规划的支持，无法应对多车协同驾驶中安全关键场景的需求。
AI.method: 1) 构建CMU-Drive闭环端到端基准，包含多辆互联自动驾驶车辆(CAVs)在带有背景交通参与者的安全关键驾驶场景中协同操作；2) 提出V2V-VLA协同VLA模型，通过单次前向传播统一生成驾驶动作、未来路点、语言推理和通信策略，将协同驾驶集成到单一模型中。
AI.result: 在CMU-Drive上建立了首个协同VLA驾驶基准和基线，验证了所提出方法的有效性，为多智能体闭环端到端协同自动驾驶研究奠定了基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了VLA模型在多车协同自动驾驶领域的空白，提供了首个协同VLA驾驶基准与模型，并将开源代码、基准和模型权重以推动后续研究。

title: Commitment Before Realization: When Classifier-Free Guidance Becomes Unnecessary in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is usually kept on throughout masked diffusion language model decoding, although its benefit varies across prompts and over time. We study when CFG is actually needed by comparing, from any partial output, the probability of eventual constraint satisfaction under continued CFG and under base-only continuation. Their difference defines the remaining value of guidance. Guidance dependence is highly prompt-specific. Many prompts already succeed without CFG, while for others it provides no measurable benefit or can be harmful. For prompts that do benefit, the gain is often concentrated early. We define the commitment horizon $\astar$ as the earliest point from which switching all remaining decoding to the base model reduces final success by no more than a chosen tolerance. Under the base model, the corresponding success probability, or committor, is a martingale. To first order, CFG's per-step effect is governed by the covariance between the guidance logit direction and the successor committor. This gives a local account of when guidance can help, but it does not by itself locate the horizon. Among prompts with an observed preterminal horizon, $\astar$ is usually early and varies more within constraint families than between them. Freezing each prompt at its own cross-fitted horizon is noninferior to full CFG on all 13 subtasks at the prespecified margin, even while many tokens remain masked. This separates commitment from realization. The boundary also identifies a later region in which higher parallelism adds only a small cost in constraint success, although fluency still degrades with parallel width. For failed trajectories, reopening committed positions improves recovery in both failure modes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究掩码扩散语言模型解码中分类器无引导（CFG）的实际必要性。通过比较部分输出在继续CFG与仅基础模型延续下最终满足约束的概率，定义了"承诺视界"（commitment horizon），即从该时刻起切换到基础模型不显著降低成功率的时刻。研究发现CFG的价值高度依赖提示词，且收益常集中在早期；按每个提示词自适应地冻结解码早于完整CFG，在13个子任务上均不劣于全程CFG。
AI.motivation: CFG通常在掩码扩散语言模型解码全程使用，但其收益随提示词和时间动态变化，并非始终需要。当前缺乏对CFG何时真正必要的系统性理解和准则。
AI.method: 作者从任意部分输出出发，比较在继续CFG和纯基础模型延续下最终满足约束的概率之差，定义"引导的剩余价值"。进一步定义承诺视界a*为从该点切换至基础模型使成功概率降低不超过容忍度τ的最早点。利用基础模型下committor（成功概率）的鞅性质，推导CFG每步效应与引导对数几率方向和后继committor协方差的一阶关系。
AI.result: CFG依赖高度依赖提示词：许多提示词无需CFG即可成功，部分提示词不受益甚至受损。在受益的提示词中，收益常集中于早期。跨拟合的提示词特定承诺视界通常较早，且同一约束族内差异大于族间差异。按各自视界早冻结在所有13个子任务上不劣于完整CFG（在预设容差下），同时许多token仍被掩码。后期区域高并行度仅带来小约束成功率代价，但流畅度随并行宽度下降。对失败轨迹重新开放已承诺位置可改善两种失败模式的恢复。
AI.conclusion: CFG的收益应在解码早期集中兑现，之后可安全切换到基础模型完成剩余解码。"承诺"与"实现"可分离：约束满足的关键决策发生在早期，后续只需基础模型填充。该发现为按提示词自适应调度CFG提供了理论基础，同时兼顾约束成功率和解码效率。

title: BRACE: Taming Sharp Irregularities via Barycentric Rational Forecasting for Fast Diffusion Transformers Inference
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in high-fidelity image and video generation. To alleviate their massive computational overhead, temporal feature caching has been proposed to bypass redundant computations. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods driven by derivative-based polynomials often cause severe quality degradation under high acceleration due to unstable long-step predictions. To address this bottleneck, we propose Barycentric Rational Forecasting with Chebyshev Enhancement (BRACE). Motivated by the observation that DiT feature trajectories are globally smooth yet frequently exhibit sharp irregularities and local non-smoothness, BRACE shifts the paradigm from derivative-driven polynomial extrapolation to feature-driven rational forecasting. Specifically, it maintains a local sliding window to cache sparse historical features and leverages adapted Chebyshev weights to formulate a barycentric rational function, directly aggregating these raw features to ensure numerical stability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BRACE achieves state-of-the-art quality-efficiency trade-offs across various DiT architectures with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: BRACE提出了一种基于重心有理函数和Chebyshev权重增强的时间特征缓存方法，替代传统导数驱动的多项式外推，在不增加计算开销的前提下提升Diffusion Transformers在高加速比下的生成质量。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformers在高保真图像和视频生成中表现优异，但计算开销巨大。现有的时序特征缓存方法基于导数驱动多项式外推，在高加速比下由于长步长预测不稳定而导致严重的质量退化。作者观察到DiT特征轨迹全局平滑但局部存在尖锐不规则和非平滑现象，因此需要一种更稳定的预测方法。
AI.method: BRACE将预测范式从导数驱动的多项式外推转变为特征驱动的有理函数预测。具体而言：(1) 维护一个局部滑动窗口缓存稀疏的历史特征；(2) 利用适配的Chebyshev权重构造重心有理函数（barycentric rational function）；(3) 直接聚合原始缓存特征，绕开导数计算以保障数值稳定性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，BRACE在各种DiT架构上取得了最优的"质量-效率"权衡，且仅引入可忽略的计算开销，显著优于现有的导数驱动多项式外推方法。
AI.conclusion: BRACE通过将特征预测从导数驱动外推转向基于Chebyshev增强的重心有理函数聚合，有效解决了高加速比下时序特征缓存的质量退化问题，为扩散模型的效率优化提供了新的范式。

title: Controlled Memory Interference in Continual LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory enables AI agents to maintain continuity across sessions, personalize behavior, and evolve through accumulated experience. Yet memory evolution is not simply a process of storing more information: new experiences may reinforce, revise, or interfere with existing memory states. Existing systems mainly emphasize memory construction and relevance-based retrieval, but several memories may remain simultaneously relevant while differing in state, temporal validity, or authority. We introduce Controlled Memory Interference (CMI), a controlled diagnostic and data-generation framework for studying how agent memory evolves under different memory relationships. Across controlled memory evolution, benign accumulation has limited effects, whereas relationship-specific interference sharply suppresses update plasticity with little stability gain, either by blocking target-memory exposure or by disrupting its downstream use. Lexical and Dense retrieval exhibit distinct interference pathways, while poisoning is more sensitive to update-authority cues than to recency alone. Beyond diagnosis, CMI provides targeted examples for interference-aware memory learning, improving the distinction between valid updates and interference-inducing memories while preserving performance on original memory tasks. These findings show that memory evolution is shaped not only by memory scale, but also by interactions among accumulated experiences. More broadly, memory interference emerges as an important factor for reliable continual agent memory systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出受控记忆干扰（CMI）框架，用于诊断和研究AI智能体长期记忆在不同记忆关系下的演化过程，发现关系特定的干扰会抑制更新可塑性，并提出针对干扰感知记忆学习的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 现有AI智能体记忆系统主要关注记忆构建和基于相关性的检索，但忽略了记忆演化过程中新经验与已有记忆之间的相互作用——包括增强、修正或干扰。多个记忆可能同时相关但在状态、时间有效性或权威性上存在差异，这导致记忆更新可能受到干扰，而现有系统缺乏对此的系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出受控记忆干扰（CMI）框架，作为一个受控的诊断和数据生成工具，用于研究不同记忆关系下智能体记忆的演化方式。框架涵盖良性累积、特定关系干扰等多种记忆关系场景，并分析Lexical和Dense两种检索方式下的干扰路径差异，同时探究投毒对更新权威线索和时效性的敏感性。
AI.result: （1）良性累积对记忆演化影响有限，而特定关系的干扰会显著抑制更新可塑性且几乎没有稳定性收益；（2）干扰通过阻断目标记忆暴露或破坏其下游使用两种方式起作用；（3）Lexical和Dense检索表现出不同的干扰路径；（4）投毒对更新权威线索比单纯时效性更敏感；（5）CMI提供的针对性样例可改进干扰感知记忆学习，提高有效更新与干扰记忆的区分度，同时保持原始记忆任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 记忆演化不仅受记忆规模影响，还受累积经验之间交互作用的塑造。记忆干扰是构建可靠持续智能体记忆系统的重要因素，需要更深入地纳入记忆学习的设计考量。

title: Archer: Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) iteratively refine a sequence, allowing earlier predictions to be revised as context evolves. This rollback capability distinguishes them from irreversible autoregressive generation, but makes inference costly. Every denoising update alters the global context, forcing both prompt and response states to be recomputed even though only response tokens are revisable. Key-value (KV) caching could reduce this cost, yet conventional caching assumes immutable historical states and is therefore difficult to reconcile with rollback.In this paper, we introduce Adaptive Reuse of Cached Hidden States for Efficient Rollback (Archer), a training-free KV caching method for rollback-capable DLMs. Archer asymmetrically keeps the mutable response synchronized with the current hypothesis while reusing prompt K/V within a bounded state neighborhood. Although prompt representations also change under bidirectional attention, their token identities remain fixed; bounded reuse therefore amortizes repeated prompt computation without caching mutable response states. It also delays feedback from tentative tokens, reducing premature reinforcement of transient high-confidence errors and giving rollback more opportunity to correct them. Our analysis characterizes prompt reuse as a reversibility-aligned cache boundary, bounds its state-dependent approximation error, and gives a decoder-margin condition for preserving full-refresh decisions.Existing DLM acceleration often trades quality for speed. Archer shifts this frontier, attaining the best mean performance of 33.63% together with a 2.57x mean speedup on the main suite. Across evaluated settings, it improves Pass@1 by up to 3.05 points and reaches up to 2.95x speedup. Controlled analyses connect the quality gain to delayed prompt feedback and validate state-aware refresh. Our code is available at https://github.com/Hxnng/Archer.

AI.tldr: Archer是一种面向可回滚扩散语言模型（DLM）的免训练KV缓存方法。它不对称地缓存：响应状态保持与当前假设同步，而提示（prompt）的K/V在受限状态邻域内被复用。该方法不仅将推理加速约2.57倍，还通过延迟暂定token的反馈改善了生成质量（Pass@1最高提升3.05个点），在质量-速度权衡曲线上优于现有DLM加速方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）通过迭代精炼序列实现回滚能力，这使其优于不可逆的自回归生成，但推理成本高昂——每次去噪更新都会改变全局上下文，导致提示（prompt）和响应状态都被强制重算，尽管只有响应token是可修订的。现有的KV缓存假设历史状态不可变，无法与回滚机制协调，因此需要一种专门针对DLM回滚特性的缓存方案来降低推理开销。
AI.method: Archer采用不对称KV缓存策略：(1) 可变响应状态始终与当前假设保持同步，避免缓存不稳定的响应；(2) 提示的K/V在受限状态邻域内被复用，尽管双向注意力下提示表示也会变化，但其token身份固定，因此有界复用在可接受误差内摊销重复的提示计算；(3) 延迟暂定token的反馈，防止过早强化瞬态的高置信度错误，给回滚更多修正机会。理论分析将提示复用刻画为可逆性对齐的缓存边界，界定了状态依赖的近似误差，并给出保持全刷新决策的decoder-margin条件。
AI.result: 在主测试集上，Archer在获得33.63%最佳平均性能的同时实现2.57倍平均加速；在多种评估设置下，Pass@1最高提升3.05个点，加速最高达2.95倍。受控分析验证了质量提升与延迟提示反馈的因果关系，并确认了状态感知刷新的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Archer证明了在DLM中，精心设计的KV缓存不仅能加速推理，还能通过延迟反馈改善生成质量，突破了现有DLM加速方法"以质量换速度"的权衡模式。它为可回滚生成模型的推理优化提供了新的方向，核心洞见在于：固定身份但可变表示的token（如提示）与身份和表示均可变的token（如响应）应被不对称地对待。

title: Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification with Swin Transformer and Clinical Metadata Fusion
summary: Skin lesion classification plays an important role in supporting the early diagnosis of skin cancer. However, automated analysis remains challenging due to class imbalance, inter-class similarity, and intra-class variability in dermoscopic images. This paper proposes a multimodal classification framework that combines Swin Transformer-based image features with structured clinical metadata to improve diagnostic performance through integrated visual-context learning. Experiments on a publicly available dataset show that the proposed model achieves a test accuracy of 92.55% and a macro F1-score of 91.33%, with strong performance across minority classes. Temperature scaling is applied as a post-hoc calibration method, resulting in a reduction in expected calibration error and improving prediction reliability, while uncertainty estimation is incorporated to further assess the confidence of model predictions. Qualitative explainability analysis further shows that the model focuses on lesion regions during inference. Therefore, the results demonstrate that multimodal fusion, combined with calibration and interpretability analysis, provides an effective and trustworthy approach for automated skin lesion classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于Swin Transformer图像特征与结构化临床元数据融合的多模态皮肤病变分类框架，通过视觉-上下文联合学习、温度缩放校准和不确定性估计，在公开数据集上达到92.55%的测试准确率和91.33%的宏F1分数，并验证了模型的可靠性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 皮肤病变分类对皮肤癌早期诊断至关重要，但皮肤镜图像存在类别不平衡、类间相似性高和类内变异大等挑战，单一图像特征的自动化分析性能受限，需要引入临床元数据进行多模态融合以提升诊断性能。
AI.method: 提出一个多模态分类框架，将Swin Transformer提取的图像特征与结构化临床元数据相结合，实现视觉-上下文联合学习；采用温度缩放作为事后校准方法降低期望校准误差，并引入不确定性估计评估模型预测置信度，辅以定性可解释性分析。
AI.result: 在公开数据集上达到92.55%的测试准确率和91.33%的宏F1分数，且在少数类上表现强劲；温度缩放有效降低了期望校准误差，提升了预测可靠性；可解释性分析显示模型在推理时聚焦于病变区域。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合结合校准和可解释性分析，为自动化皮肤病变分类提供了一种有效且可信的方法，兼顾诊断性能与预测可靠性的平衡。

title: From Single Chatbots to Governed Agent Ecosystems: An Agentic AI Pattern Catalogue and Orchestration Framework for Mission-Critical Hospital Information Management Systems
summary: Hospitals are racing to embed AI, while coping with the surge in adaptation of the technology in other industries, into the triage management, documentation, scheduling, and revenue-cycle workflows, yet most deployments remain as fragmented pilots that stall at the edge of production, exposing patients and institutions to operational fragility, ungoverned risk, and mounting technical debt. At the same time, the global AI-in-healthcare market is projected to exceed nearly USD 1 trillion by 2034, according to the report of Fortune Business Insights, amplifying the financial consequences of architectural missteps and failed scaling strategies. This research proposes a compliance-first Agentic AI pattern catalogue and orchestration framework, purposely built for HIMS, moving beyond the single LLM chatbots and towards a governed ecosystem of autonomous and semi-autonomous agents. The framework extends by adding (i) a taxonomy of Agentic roles, (ii) a formal risk-stratification model that maps each pattern to risk tiers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and governance hooks, and (iii) a unified orchestration runtime capable of coordinating multi-agent workflows across EHR/HIMS landscapes such as Epic, Cerner, and MEDITECH. Technically the framework combines vLLM-based inference, optimized paging memory, confidential computing, and MCP based on-premise deployment, enforcing end-to-end encryption and policy-as-code controls aligned with HIPAA, GDPR, the EU AI Act, India's DPDP and DISHA Acts, ISO 27001, ISO 27002, ISO 14971 and IEC 62304. We exhibit how the proposed architecture is capable and efficient to reduce the documentation time, integration effort, and AI pilot attrition while constricting the governance and auditability, offering hospital leaders and governing authorities an urgently needed blueprint to convert AI investment into sustainable clinical, operational, and financial ROI

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个合规优先的Agentic AI模式目录与编排框架，专为医院信息系统（HIMS）构建，将AI从碎片化试点推向受治理的自主/半自主智能体生态系统，涵盖角色分类学、风险分层模型和统一编排运行时，并集成vLLM推理、机密计算、MCP本地部署及多国合规政策代码控制。
AI.motivation: 医院在嵌入AI的竞赛中面临困境：大多数AI部署仍停留在碎片化试点阶段，难以进入生产环境，导致运营脆弱性、无监管风险和不断累积的技术债务。同时全球AI医疗市场预计到2034年将接近1万亿美元，架构失误和扩展失败的财务后果被急剧放大，亟需一个系统性、合规优先的治理框架。
AI.method: 提出三层扩展框架：(i) Agentic角色分类学（定义自主/半自主智能体类型）；(ii) 正式的风险分层模型（将每个模式映射到风险等级、人机回环检查点和治理钩子）；(iii) 统一编排运行时（协调跨Epic、Cerner、MEDITECH等EHR/HIMS的多智能体工作流）。技术上结合vLLM推理、优化的分页内存、机密计算和基于MCP的本地部署，实施端到端加密及策略即代码控制，对齐HIPAA、GDPR、EU AI Act、DPDP/DISHA、ISO等标准。
AI.result: 论证了所提架构能够减少文档处理时间、降低集成工作量、抑制AI试点流失率，同时压缩治理与审计成本，为医院领导者和监管机构提供了将AI投资转化为可持续临床、运营和财务ROI的蓝图。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为医院AI规模化部署提供了合规优先的整体解决方案，通过系统化的智能体治理、风险分层和跨系统编排，弥补了当前单一大语言模型聊天机器人的局限，是推动AI投资产生可持续回报的关键路径。

title: Wisdom in Unity: The Role of Multilingual Training in Figurative Language Identification in Proverbs
summary:
Although multilingual approaches to figurative language identification are not new, the shift beyond language homogeneous training data requires a clearer understanding of the contribution of translated multilingual supervision. We examine this question using 742 proverb concepts across 6,787 translated instances in seven languages. We evaluate five models, including multilingual encoders and instruction tuned LLMs, under progressively increasing levels of multilingual supervision. Moreover, we introduce a multidimensional annotation framework for proverbs that characterizes them through four complementary figurative forms: Metaphorical, Moral/Advisory, Cause-Effect, and Culture Specific.
  Our findings show that approximately 50% of the translated multilingual training data is sufficient to achieve near-optimal figurative language identification performance. We further show that combining diverse figurative forms yields the strongest overall performance. A notable finding is that the least frequent figurative form, Culture Specific, exhibits the largest performance gains under multilingual supervision. Furthermore, the Moral/Advisory and Culture Specific forms contribute most to the performance of instruction-tuned LLMs on figurative language identification. These findings motivate multilingual figurative language identification to move beyond metaphor-centric taxonomies toward concept level multidimensional frameworks that explicitly model complementary forms of figurative meaning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多语言监督对习语（谚语）比喻语言识别任务的影响，使用7种语言、6,787个翻译实例和742个谚语概念，提出了包含四种互补比喻形式（隐喻、道德/劝诫、因果、文化特定）的多维标注框架，并系统评估了五种模型在不同程度多语言监督下的表现。
AI.motivation: 多语言方法用于比喻语言识别并非新课题，但超越语言同质训练数据需要更清晰地理解翻译型多语言监督的具体贡献。现有研究缺乏系统性的分析来回答：翻译得到的多语言监督数据究竟在多大程度上以及以何种方式帮助比喻语言识别。
AI.method: 使用742个谚语概念、7种语言的6,787个翻译实例，评估五种模型（包括多语言编码器和指令微调LLM），在逐步增加的多语言监督水平下进行实验。同时提出一个四维标注框架，从隐喻、道德/劝诫、因果、文化特定四个互补比喻形式来刻画谚语。
AI.result: （1）约50%的翻译多语言训练数据即可达到接近最优的比喻语言识别性能；（2）组合多样化的比喻形式可获得最强的整体性能；（3）出现频率最低的文化特定形式在多语言监督下获得了最大的性能提升；（4）道德/劝诫和文化特定形式对指令微调LLM的比喻语言识别贡献最大。
AI.conclusion: 多语言比喻语言识别应超越以隐喻为中心的传统分类体系，转向概念层面的多维框架，显式建模互补的比喻意义形式。

title: Beyond Isotropic Assumptions: Continuity-Constrained Segmentation and GPU Morphometry for Nanoscale GBM Analysis
summary:
Confocal microscopy of optically cleared and swelled tissue resolves complex biological structures in 3D, but such acquisitions are highly anisotropic: along the under-sampled axial direction the structure can appear discontinuous, hampering reconstruction and automated quantitative analysis. The usual remedy upsamples the axial dimension to an isotropic volume before training a segmentation model, which requires dense annotations in the upsampled space, a prohibitive labeling burden.
  We present an end-to-end, GPU-accelerated framework that overcomes this without additional annotations. The model is trained on the native acquisition volume; random rotation of training patches leverages the well-resolved lateral plane to supply the missing axial information, and a z-axis continuity loss keeps neighboring slices consistent. We adapt both a convolutional (3D U-Net) and a transformer (SwinUNETR) backbone, aggregate overlapping patches by Gaussian consensus, and compute point-spread-function-corrected membrane thickness by ray-surface intersection on the GPU.
  We apply the method to the glomerular basement membrane (GBM), a thin, highly convoluted part of the kidney's filtration barrier that grows more irregular in disease. Segmentation accuracy matches inter-expert agreement. Continuity-aware training improves reconstruction smoothness and suppresses a periodic terracing artifact at minimal accuracy cost. We quantify GBM thickness across the reconstructed 3D surface and capture disease-related thickening, enabling fully automated anisotropic 3D morphometry of biological structures without dense volumetric labels or image restoration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端、GPU加速的框架，用于在保持原生采集体积上训练分割模型，无需额外标注即可处理共聚焦显微镜图像的各向异性问题。通过随机旋转训练补丁利用高分辨率横向平面补充缺失的轴向信息，辅以z轴连续性损失保持切片间一致，并适配3D U-Net和SwinUNETR两种骨干网络，最终应用于肾小球基底膜（GBM）厚度量化，实现了全自动的各向异性3D形态测量。
AI.motivation: 共聚焦显微镜在轴向方向欠采样导致结构出现不连续，影响重建和自动化定量分析。传统方法需要先将轴向维度上采样至各向同性体积再训练分割模型，这要求在上采样空间中进行密集标注，标注成本过高且不切实际。
AI.method: 1) 直接在原生采集体积上训练分割模型，避免各向同性上采样；2) 通过随机旋转训练补丁，利用横向平面分辨率高的特性补充轴向缺失信息；3) 引入z轴连续性损失保持相邻切片一致；4) 适配3D U-Net（卷积）和SwinUNETR（Transformer）两种骨干网络；5) 通过高斯共识聚合重叠补丁；6) 使用GPU上的射线-表面相交计算点扩散函数校正的膜厚度。
AI.result: 在肾小球基底膜（GBM）分割任务中，模型精度达到与专家间一致性相当的水平。连续性感知训练改善了重建平滑度并抑制周期性阶梯伪影，同时以极小精度代价实现。厚度测量能够捕捉疾病相关的GBM增厚变化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了无需密集体积标注或图像恢复的全自动各向异性3D形态测量，为薄而高度卷曲的生物结构（如GBM）提供了可用的定量分析工具。

title: Agent-MD: Selective LLM Intervention with Event-Driven Escalation for Stateful GCMC--MD Campaigns
summary: Long-running molecular simulation campaigns require repeated continuation from saved states, provenance-aware progression, adaptive assessment, and occasional interpretation of workflow conditions that cannot be resolved safely by fixed rules. Here, we present Agent-MD, a framework that places large language model (LLM) reasoning selectively at campaign construction and event-triggered review, while routine simulation, analysis, continuation, archiving, and state progression are handled by a persistent rule-based campaign agent using approved policies and explicit state records. Agent-MD was demonstrated in a grand canonical Monte Carlo-molecular dynamics (GCMC-MD) water-vapor desorption campaign comprising five montmorillonite systems and three sequential relative-humidity states (RH = 0.9-0.3-0.1). Across 15 system-RH states, the workflow completed 120 segmented simulation cycles with state-specific sampling lengths and provenance-aware restart inheritance. Routine production required no live reasoning-agent invocation, while one state reached a review boundary; two preserved incidents were subsequently evaluated through blinded reasoning-agent replay, which identified the underlying workflow problems and recommended appropriate follow-up actions. The simulations also revealed distinct composition-dependent low-RH responses, with Ca-bearing montmorillonite retaining more interlayer water and maintaining a larger basal spacing than the Na- and K-bearing systems, while the highest-charge Na system retained more residual water under dry conditions. These results demonstrate that long-running scientific workflows need not place every operation inside an LLM reasoning loop: selective reasoning can instead be combined with deterministic execution, structured evidence, and validated control handoffs to provide reproducible and auditable agent-assisted molecular simulation.

AI.tldr: Agent-MD是一个将大语言模型推理选择性嵌入长期分子模拟工作流中的框架：常规模拟、分析、续算、归档和状态推进由基于规则的持久化代理处理，仅在战役构建和事件触发审查时启用LLM推理。在蒙脱石GCMC-MD水蒸气脱附战役中（5个体系×3个RH状态，共15个状态、120个分段模拟周期）验证了该框架的有效性，并发现了组成依赖的低RH响应差异。
AI.motivation: 长期分子模拟战役需要重复续算、溯源感知的状态推进、自适应评估以及无法由固定规则安全处理的偶发工作流条件解读。现有方案要么全程依赖LLM推理导致开销高且不可复现，要么完全依赖固定规则无法处理边界情况，缺乏一个在两者之间取得平衡的框架。
AI.method: Agent-MD采用双层架构：(1) 持久化规则驱动战役代理，基于已批准策略和显式状态记录处理常规模拟、分析、续算、归档和状态推进；(2) 大语言模型推理仅在战役构造和事件触发的审查节点被选择性调用。事件被保留后通过盲审推理代理回放来诊断工作流问题并推荐后续措施。
AI.result: 在15个系统-RH状态下完成120个分段模拟周期，常规生产过程中无需调用实时推理代理即可完成；一个状态达到审查边界，两个保留事件通过盲审推理代理回放被诊断出底层工作流问题。模拟还揭示了组成依赖的低RH响应：含Ca蒙脱石保留更多层间水并维持更大层间距，而最高电荷的Na体系在干燥条件下保留更多残余水。
AI.conclusion: 长期运行的科研工作流不需要将每个操作都放入LLM推理循环中。选择性推理与确定性执行、结构化证据和经过验证的控制交接相结合，可以提供可复现、可审计的智能辅助分子模拟。

title: NeuPAT: Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning for Language-Preserving MLLMs
summary: Multimodal expansion of large language models (LLMs) enables new perceptual capabilities but often compromises the language intelligence acquired during pretraining. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon from the perspective of internal adaptation dynamics and discover that neurons in pretrained LLMs exhibit heterogeneous plasticity during multimodal learning: some neurons are critical for preserving language capabilities, while others are more adaptive to multimodal knowledge. Based on this insight, we propose NeuPAT (Neuron-aware Plasticity Allocation Tuning), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that allocates neuron-wise update constraints during multimodal instruction tuning. NeuPAT uses a small-scale probing stage to estimate neuron adaptation patterns and selectively protects language-sensitive neurons while promoting multimodal adaptation through more plastic neurons. Experiments across diverse LLM families demonstrate that NeuPAT recovers 94.5\% of the language capability degradation caused by vanilla tuning on 11 language benchmarks while maintaining comparable multimodal performance, providing an effective approach for capability-preserving multimodal expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeuPAT框架，通过分析多模态扩展中预训练LLM神经元的异质性可塑性，在微调时按神经元分配更新约束，在保持多模态性能的同时恢复94.5%的语言能力退化。
AI.motivation: 多模态扩展虽赋予LLM新的感知能力，但往往损害其预训练阶段获得的语言智能。作者希望从内部适应动力学角度理解这一现象，并找到在不牺牲多模态性能的前提下保持语言能力的有效方法。
AI.method: NeuPAT通过一个小规模探测阶段估计各神经元的适应模式，识别语言敏感神经元与多模态适应神经元，然后依据这一划分在指令微调过程中对神经元施加异构的更新约束——保护语言关键神经元、促进高可塑性神经元的自适应更新。该框架轻量且与模型架构无关。
AI.result: 在多个LLM家族的实验中，NeuPAT在11个语言基准上恢复了普通微调造成的语言能力退化的94.5%，同时保持可比的多模态性能。
AI.conclusion: NeuPAT提供了一种有效的、保持语言能力的多模态扩展方法，验证了根据神经元可塑性异质性进行差异化更新约束的可行性。

title: Open-World Hierarchical Perception: Taxonomic Abstraction over Class-Agnostic Proposals for the Safe Handling of Out-of-Vocabulary Road Objects
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Third paper in a series; v1 archived at Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21593472. Code: https://github.com/freshNfunky/IE2025-Research-Paper
summary: A closed-set detector for autonomous driving must assign every object one of a fixed set of labels. On an object outside that set (a horse-drawn carriage, road debris, livestock on a rural road) it can only force a confident but wrong specific label or drop the object. Prior work in this series replaced the flat label set with a hierarchical taxonomy and a runtime abstraction rule, but evaluated it only on the boxes a closed detector already produces. This paper takes the layer open-world: we place taxonomic abstraction on top of class-agnostic region proposals so objects the closed detector never boxes can still be classified or flagged; we report a feasibility study of three open-world signals (class-agnostic segmentation, appearance-based out-of-distribution scoring, monocular depth) that shows why no single 2D cue suffices and how they compose; and we run the evaluation the earlier papers could not, a ground-truth leave-classes-out benchmark on real annotated objects. Holding out seven COCO classes and classifying their 235 ground-truth crops, a flat closed head emits a confident wrong specific label 100% of the time (37% of them in the wrong super-category, e.g. an animal named as a vehicle), whereas the hierarchical layer emits zero confident wrong specific labels and safely handles 94% of the objects (a correct super-category, or an explicit UNKNOWN OBSTACLE). We are explicit that this is a safety result, not a specificity one: the correct super-category is recovered only 26% of the time and the remaining 69% are conservatively flagged unknown. The contribution is an open-world perception layer that never makes a confident categorical mistake on an out-of-vocabulary object, together with an honest account of its cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种开放世界感知层，将分层分类法（hierarchical taxonomy）与类无关的区域候选（class-agnostic region proposals）结合，使自动驾驶的闭环检测器对词表外物体不再强制给出错误的特定标签，而是安全地归类到正确超类或标记为UNKNOWN OBSTACLE。
AI.motivation: 闭环检测器对词表外物体只能强制给出自信但错误的标签或丢弃目标，无法安全处理开放世界中的未知物体（如马车、道路杂物、牲畜）。此前工作只用分层分类法做运行时抽象，但仅在闭环检测器已产生的框上评估，未触及未知物体从未被检测的问题。
AI.method: 将分层分类法置于类无关区域候选之上，使闭环检测器未框出的物体仍可被分类或标记；研究三种开放世界信号（类无关分割、基于外观的分布外评分、单目深度）的可行性，说明为何没有单一2D线索足够以及它们如何互补；构建真实标注对象的留出类（leave-classes-out）基准进行评估。
AI.result: 扣留COCO七类并分类其235个真实标注裁剪图像：扁平闭环头100%时间给出自信但错误的特定标签（其中37%归类到错误超类，如把动物称为车辆）；而分层层的自信错误特定标签为零，安全处理94%的物体。但正确超类恢复率仅26%，其余69%被保守标记为未知。
AI.conclusion: 这是一个安全结果而非特异性结果：该开放世界感知层在词表外物体上不会做出自信的分类错误，并诚实地报告了成本（正确超类恢复率低，多数被保守标记为未知）。

title: Contextual Value Alignment via Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
summary:
Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values remains a major challenge, especially for trustworthy AI. While existing approaches such as RLHF, CAI, and their variants have achieved promising results, they often rely on a single-agent framework and a unified reward system. This limits their ability to capture ethical pluralism, adapt to diverse moral contexts, and reflect the dynamics of multi-agent moral reasoning.
  In this work, we propose a framework that utilizes multilayer combinatorial fusion for contextual value alignment (MCF-CVA). At the first layer of the framework, it instantiates multiple moral agents, each fine-tuned to represent a distinctive value. Their outputs are then expanded combinatorially using both score- and rank-combinations as well as average and weighted aggregations. These combined models are then reduced to the same number of initial moral agents. This expansion and reduction (EAR) process continues for multi-layers until a stopping criterion is reached.
  The MCF-CVA framework leverages cognitive diversity between agents to mitigate conflicts and redundancies across multiple agents, producing responses that better reflect contextual human values. The framework using the EAR algorithm is performed on the dual architecture of Euclidean score space and Kemeny rank space. Empirical evaluations demonstrated that the proposed framework outperforms single-agent baselines, multi-agent single-layer results, and previous aggregation approaches on standard metrics, showing that the MCF-CVA framework provides a robust and effective mechanism for advancing contextual value alignment in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCF-CVA框架，通过多层组合融合实现大语言模型的上下文价值对齐。该框架实例化多个代表不同价值观的道德智能体，通过评分和排名的组合展开与缩减（EAR）过程在多层中迭代，利用智能体间的认知多样性来缓解冲突和冗余，最终在标准指标上超越单智能体基线和多智能体单层方法。
AI.motivation: 现有RLHF、CAI等对齐方法依赖单智能体框架和统一奖励系统，无法捕捉伦理多元性、适应多样道德情境，也难以反映多智能体道德推理的动态性。需要一种能够整合多个价值视角的框架来实现真正的上下文价值对齐。
AI.method: 提出MCF-CVA框架：第一层实例化多个经微调、代表不同价值的道德智能体；通过评分组合与排名组合（平均和加权聚合）对输出进行组合展开；将组合结果缩减为与初始智能体相同数量；该展开-缩减（EAR）过程在多层中持续迭代直到满足停止条件。框架在欧几里得评分空间和Kemeny排名空间的双重架构上执行EAR算法。
AI.result: 在标准指标上的实证评估表明，MCF-CVA框架优于单智能体基线、多智能体单层结果以及以往的聚合方法，证明了其作为上下文价值对齐机制的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: MCF-CVA通过多层组合融合利用智能体间的认知多样性，有效缓解了多智能体间的冲突与冗余，为推进LLM的上下文价值对齐提供了稳健且有效的机制。

title: Can LLM Agents Stick to the Script? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Consistency in Interactive Narratives
summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) is revolutionizing AI for Games by enabling open-ended and fluid interactive storytelling. However, existing research has largely overlooked the critical challenge of maintaining long-horizon logical consistency and narrative integrity against unconstrained user interventions. To address this, we formulate this challenge as Narrative Commitment Preservation (NCP), and take interactive narrative as our testbed. We introduce NCP-Bench, a benchmark of 100 narrative environments derived from movie synopses. Each environment includes a structured narrative specification (trajectory, commitments, and initial facts) that we can automatically check throughout the interaction between the player agent and the narrator agent. Experiments across state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a substantial long-horizon consistency gap: high linguistic quality does not guarantee commitment preservation; even strong models frequently generate logically conflicting content under adversarial interventions, with the best-performing model (GPT-5.2) achieving only 42% survival rate after 20 turns and fact conflict rates ranging from 40% to 68% across models, and only isolated runs satisfying all achievement commitments within the 100-turn limit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NCP-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型在交互式叙事中维持长期逻辑一致性与叙事承诺的能力。基于100个电影情节环境，实验发现即使最强的GPT-5.2在20轮后存活率仅42%，全模型事实冲突率在40%-68%之间，揭示高质量语言输出与叙事完整性之间存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的交互式叙事研究忽视了用户自由干预下维持长期逻辑一致性与叙事完整性的关键挑战。高质量的语言生成不一定保证叙事承诺的保持，需要一个系统化的基准来量化这一差距。
AI.method: 将挑战形式化为叙事承诺保持（NCP）问题，构建NCP-Bench基准，包含100个源自电影情节梗概的叙事环境。每个环境包含结构化的叙事规范（轨迹、承诺和初始事实），并可在玩家智能体与叙述智能体的交互过程中自动检查承诺保持情况。
AI.result: 跨SOTA LLM的实验显示显著的长期一致性格差：高语言质量与承诺保持无必然关联；即便最强模型在对抗性干预下也频繁生成逻辑冲突内容——GPT-5.2在20轮后存活率仅42%，各模型事实冲突率在40%-68%之间，且只有孤立的运行在100轮限制内满足全部成就承诺。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在交互式叙事中长期维持逻辑一致性的能力严重不足，NCP-Bench为该问题提供了可量化、可自动检查的评估基准，揭示了构建可靠交互式叙事系统所面临的重大挑战。

title: Geometry Beats Estimated Depth: RGB-Only Multi-Camera 3D Tracking under Sim2Real
summary: The AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 evaluates multi-camera 3D perception in large indoor warehouses under a synthetic-to-real (Sim2Real) setting; depth is available only for training and validation, so inference is RGB-only. We use two RGB-only routes as a controlled test of one hypothesis: that cross-view geometric consistency, not monocular depth accuracy, governs performance under Sim2Real. The first is a geometry-first pipeline: YOLO11x detection, homography lifting to the world frame, class-level 3D size priors, multi-camera fusion, world-coordinate tracking, and offline tracklet stitching. The second is estimated-depth pseudo-LiDAR: monocular depth (D4RT, Metric3D~v2) back-projected into a fused point cloud and passed to a 3D detector (V-DETR), mirroring prior point-cloud winners that used depth. The gap is decisive: geometry-first reaches 13.0 3D HOTA (51.6 LocA), whereas pseudo-LiDAR collapses to 0.12 (9.2 LocA). We trace the collapse to cross-view inconsistency of monocular depth---scale correction is necessary but not sufficient---which domain-adaptation fine-tuning does not repair within budget. Within the geometry pipeline, offline stitching is the only intervention that helps; SAHI detection, appearance Re-ID, learned lifting, RT-DETR ensembling, test-time augmentation, and domain randomization all fail to beat the baseline detector. The bottlenecks are complementary: detection quality bounds the geometry route (DetA), localization consistency bounds pseudo-LiDAR (LocA). We release a complete, reproducible RGB-only pipeline and ablation.

AI.tldr: 本文在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1多相机3D感知任务中，系统对比了两条RGB-only检测路线以验证一个假设：在Sim2Real场景下，跨视角几何一致性（而非单目深度精度）才是决定性能的关键。几何优先管线（YOLO11x+单应性提升+3D尺寸先验+多相机融合+轨迹拼接）达到13.0 3D HOTA，而伪LiDAR路线（单目深度反投影+V-DETR）仅取得0.12，揭示单目深度的跨视角不一致是致命缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有Sim2Real多相机3D感知主要依赖深度传感器进行训练，但推理阶段仅提供RGB图像，导致训练-推理模态不匹配。作者希望验证跨视角几何一致性是否比单目深度精度更能解释Sim2Real场景下的性能差异，从而为RGB-only多相机3D感知提供可靠的设计路线。
AI.method: 构建两条RGB-only对照路线：(1) 几何优先管线：YOLO11x检测→单应性提升到世界坐标系→类级3D尺寸先验→多相机融合→世界坐标跟踪→离线轨迹拼接；(2) 伪LiDAR路线：单目深度估计（D4RT、MetricV3-v2）反投影为融合点云→V-DETR三维检测。同时系统消融SAHI检测、外观Re-ID、可学习提升、RT-DETR集成、测试时增强和域随机化等模块。
AI.result: 几何优先管线取得13.0 3D HOTA（51.6 LocA），伪LiDAR崩溃至0.12（9.2 LocA）。离线轨迹拼接是几何管线中唯一有效干预；其余消融均未超越基线。瓶颈互补：检测质量限制几何路线（DetA），定位一致性限制伪LiDAR（LocA）。
AI.conclusion: 在Sim2Real条件下，单目深度估计的跨视角不一致性无法通过尺度校正或域适应微调在预算内修复，因此基于几何一致性的方法显著优于依赖深度伪标签的方法。跨视角几何一致性是RGB-only多相机3D感知在Sim2Real场景下的主导因素。

title: Mendel Gödel Machine: Recursive Self-Improving Coding Agents via Comparative Evolution
comment: Project Page at https://reallcz.github.io/MGM; Code at https://github.com/RealLcz/MGM
summary: Self-improving coding agents that iteratively rewrite their own source code have demonstrated impressive performance on coding tasks. However, existing solutions generally derive self-modification from a single failure trajectory at a time, overlooking rich comparative signals available in the agent's expanding archive of past attempts. According to Mendelian principles of controlled inheritance, we introduce Mendel Gödel Machine (MGM). In addition to the general single-trajectory clonal mutation, MGM includes two new types of self-modification that better utilizes evidences accumulated: the reaction-norm mutation edits an agent based on its trajectories on multiple tasks simultaneously, and the cross-lineage hybridization edits an agent using the trajectory of a reference agent from another lineage on the same task. Under an additive fitness landscape model, we prove theoretically and demonstrate via controlled surrogate simulation that the new strategies facilitate a faster and better convergence over single-trajectory baselines. Experiments on SWE-bench and Polyglot confirm MGM's consistent improvement in performance, efficiency, and generalizability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出孟德尔哥德尔机器（MGM），一种自改进编码智能体框架，基于孟德尔遗传学原理引入两种新的自我修改策略（反应规范突变和跨谱系杂交），利用多轨迹证据而非单一失败轨迹来改进编码智能体，在理论和实验中均证明比传统的单轨迹克隆突变方法收敛更快、性能更好。
AI.motivation: 现有自改进编码智能体仅从单次失败轨迹中获取反馈来修改自身代码，忽略了其历史尝试存档中蕴含的丰富比较性信号（如多个任务间的模式、不同智能体谱系间的差异）。单一视角的自我修改限制了智能体的学习效率和泛化能力。
AI.method: 借鉴孟德尔遗传学的可控遗传原则，MGM在原有单轨迹克隆突变基础上引入两种新策略：(1) 反应规范突变——基于智能体在多个任务上的轨迹同时进行编辑，捕捉跨任务的反应模式；(2) 跨谱系杂交——利用同一任务上另一谱系参考智能体的轨迹来编辑当前智能体，实现谱系间的遗传信息融合。方法通过加性适应度景观模型进行理论分析和受控替代仿真验证。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在加性适应度景观模型下，新策略比单轨迹基线收敛更快且能更好地收敛；在SWE-bench和Polyglot数据集上的实验确认了MGM在性能、效率和泛化性方面的一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 利用多轨迹比较性信号进行自我修改是编码智能体自改进的有效方向，孟德尔遗传学原则为设计更高效的智能体进化策略提供了理论指导。

title: STEMMA: An Adversarial Multi-Agent Framework for Evaluating Self-Identity Consistency in LLMs
summary: Knowledge Distillation is a widely adopted technique in the training and fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) enabling transfer of structured information and functional behavior from a large teacher model to a smaller student model while significantly reducing computational costs. However, as the use of distillation increases in both scale and complexity it raises an important question about what kind of knowledge is really transferred from the teacher model. In this work, we argue that apart from the functional knowledge, student models also learn behavioral patterns, specifically how a model represents its own identity raising concerns about output homogeneity, model biases, and accountability. To address this challenge, we introduce STEMMA, a multi-modal and multi-agent framework in which role specific agents collaboratively probe self identification behavior in different models. We also contribute a set of adversarial prompts designed manually to evaluate identity consistency in LLMs. Our results show that to an extent most models are vulnerable to inconsistencies in self-representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEMMA框架，一个多模态多智能体系统，用于探究大语言模型在知识蒸馏过程中是否不仅转移了功能性知识，还继承了教师模型的自我表征行为（即模型如何表示自身身份），并通过对抗性提示评估模型的自我一致性，发现大多数模型在自我表征上存在一定程度的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏被广泛用于LLM训练与微调，但其规模和复杂度日益增长，引发了对"究竟什么知识被真正转移"的疑问。作者认为学生模型不仅学习功能知识，还会习得教师模型的行为模式，特别是模型如何表征自身身份，这可能引发输出同质化、模型偏见和问责性问题。然而这一问题尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 作者引入STEMMA（多模态多智能体框架），其中角色特定的智能体协作探测不同模型的自我识别行为。同时，作者设计并贡献了一组手工构造的对抗性提示，用于评估LLM的自我一致性（identity consistency）。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，大多数模型在自我表征（self-representations）方面存在一定程度的不一致性，即模型容易受到对抗性提示的影响而产生矛盾的自我身份描述。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏不仅转移功能性知识，还可能转移教师模型的自我表征行为模式，这引发了关于输出同质化、模型偏见和问责机制的担忧。STEMMA框架为系统评估和检测LLM自我身份不一致性提供了有效工具，揭示了当前模型在该维度的普遍脆弱性。

title: Real-time physics inversion for retrieval of sub-pixel wildfire temperatures from VSWIR imaging spectroscopy
comment: In Review in Remote Sensing of Environment
summary: In this work, we present a wildfire temperature retrieval framework for VSWIR imaging spectroscopy data, employed on data from NASA's Airborne Visible Infrared Imaging Spectrometer (AVIRIS-3). The retrieval framework utilizes a full-physics approach in which a forward model is employed to resolve both solar and emitted radiance derived from a temperature distribution and utilizes the full spectral range in the residual fit. To optimize the forward model retrieval, we use state-of-the-art nonlinear least squares methods implemented for fast convergence on the on-board GPU, allowing for estimation of effective fire temperature within flight cadence. We verify the forward model assumptions on simulated spectra with an injected thermal signature and find good agreement with an RMSE of $41.8$ Kelvin (K). We apply the retrieval over the full 2025 FireSense AVIRIS-3 campaign, totaling 168 overflights with probable active fire spectra, and demonstrate a residual radiance fit of $\leq 10\%$ across bands in the short-wave infrared (SWIR). Lastly, we verify the applicability of the retrieved posterior fire temperature parameters to generalize to space-borne imaging spectrometers such as EMIT, by retrieving at coarsened spatial resolution. We find that the posterior distribution exhibits good coverage of the underlying sub-pixel temperature range with an absolute error of $30$ K across quantiles and a mean absolute error of $27.16$ K between spatial resolutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于VSWIR成像光谱数据的野火温度反演框架，采用全物理前向模型结合非线性最小二乘法，在GPU上实现快速收敛，成功应用于NASA AVIRIS-3的2025年FireSense活动数据，在模拟光谱上达到41.8K的RMSE，并验证了对星载成像光谱仪（如EMIT）的推广适用性。
AI.motivation: 野火温度的高精度、快速反演对于火灾监测和火行为理解至关重要，但现有方法在计算效率和全光谱利用方面存在局限，特别是需要在飞行机载成像光谱仪数据上实现飞行周期内的实时反演能力。
AI.method: 采用全物理反演框架，通过前向模型同时解析太阳辐射和来自温度分布的热发射辐射，在残差拟合中利用全光谱范围。使用先进的非线性最小二乘法在GPU上实现快速收敛，估算有效火灾温度。方法包含模拟验证（注入热特征的模拟光谱）以及跨空间分辨率（粗化到EMIT尺度）的泛化验证。
AI.result: 模拟验证中RMSE为41.8K；应用到2025年FireSense AVIRIS-3活动共168次过境数据，SWIR波段残差辐射拟合≤10%；在粗化空间分辨率下后验分布对亚像元温度范围覆盖良好，各分位数绝对误差30K，空间分辨率之间的平均绝对误差为27.16K。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在飞行节奏内实现快速的野火温度反演，具备良好的精度和泛化能力，不仅适用于机载AVIRIS-3数据，也能推广到EMIT等星载成像光谱仪，为野火遥感温度产品提供了高效可靠的技术路径。

title: An Agentic AI Framework Overcomes Fundamental Limitations of Large Language Models for Glaucoma Detection from Fundus Photography
summary: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in medical image interpretation but suffer from hallucination, limited accuracy, and run-to-run inconsistency. We developed and validated an agentic AI framework integrating LLMs with specialized deep learning tools for glaucoma detection from fundus photography. The workflow had three steps: (1) LLM initial assessment; (2) function calling to invoke specialized tools for image quality (QAModel, FundaQ-8), glaucoma classification (SwinV2-Tiny), and optic disc/cup segmentation (SegFormer-B0); and (3) LLM reflection integrating the initial impression with tool outputs. Two LLMs (Gemini 2.5 Flash, GPT-5.4 mini) were evaluated on two public datasets (ORIGA, n=100; RIM-ONE-v3, n=100) under uncropped and cropped fields of view; all images were independently graded by a masked fellowship-trained glaucoma specialist. The agentic workflow improved classification accuracy by 16 to 47 percentage points across all conditions, reaching within 6 points of the specialist; on RIM-ONE-v3 the best configurations matched the specialist accuracy of 88%. LLM-alone approaches failed in two ways: GPT-5.4 mini showed positive bias (sensitivity 95-100%, specificity 0-5%), while Gemini 2.5 Flash varied stochastically between runs; the agentic workflow corrected both. Cup-to-disc ratio error fell 15-50% (MAE 0.156-0.228 to 0.104-0.132), and correlation with specialist grading rose from weak (r=0.12-0.39) to moderate-strong (r=0.59-0.84). Run-to-run consistency rose from near-random (kappa as low as -0.01) to near-perfect (kappa up to 0.96). Integrating LLMs with specialized tools addressed key limitations of LLM-alone approaches, including over-diagnosis and run-to-run variability. Gains held for both LLMs, suggesting generalizability across backbones, and may signal a shift from monolithic models toward orchestrated multi-agent systems in medical AI.

AI.tldr: 本文开发并验证了一种将大型语言模型（LLMs）与专用深度学习工具整合的智能体AI框架，用于眼底照相的青光眼检测。该工作流包含三步：LLM初步评估、函数调用调用专用工具（图像质量、青光眼分类、视盘/视杯分割）、以及LLM反思整合。在两个公开数据集上，该框架将分类准确率提升16-47个百分点，杯盘比误差降低15-50%，运行间一致性从近随机（kappa低至-0.01）提升至接近完美（kappa高达0.96），同时纠正了LLM单独使用的正向偏倚和随机波动问题。研究结果表明，从单体模型向编排式多智能体系统的转变可能成为医学AI的新方向。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在医学图像解读中虽有前景，但存在幻觉、准确率有限以及运行间不一致的问题，亟需一种能够克服这些局限的方法。
AI.method: 构建智能体AI框架，将LLM与三个专用深度学习工具（QAModel/FundaQ-8图像质量评估、SwinV2-Tiny青光眼分类、SegFormer-B0视盘/视杯分割）通过函数调用集成。工作流为三步：LLM初始评估→调用专用工具→LLM反思整合。使用两种LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash、GPT-5.4 mini）在两个公共数据集（ORIGA、RIM-ONE-v3）上评估，并以掩蔽的专科医生评分为金标准。
AI.result: 智能体工作流在所有条件下将分类准确率提升16-47个百分点，最佳配置在RIM-ONE-v3上与专科医生88%的准确率持平；杯盘比MAE从0.156-0.228降至0.104-0.132，与专科医生的相关性从r=0.12-0.39提升至r=0.59-0.84；运行间一致性kappa从低至-0.01提升至高达0.96。LLM单独使用表现出正向偏倚（GPT-5.4 mini：敏感性95-100%，特异性0-5%）或随机波动（Gemini 2.5 Flash），智能体工作流均予以纠正。两种LLM均获益，表明跨骨干网络的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM与专用工具集成可有效解决LLM单独使用的过度诊断和运行间变异性问题，且效果在不同LLM骨干上保持稳定，预示医学AI可能从单体模型向编排式多智能体系统演进。

title: Thinking vs. NoThinking: Towards Interpreting Reasoning Mechanisms of Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) employing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exhibit superior reasoning capabilities, the neural mechanisms distinguishing this explicit Thinking mode from direct answer generation (NoThinking mode) remain poorly understood. To deconstruct this cognitive process, we apply Top-K Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to the intermediate representations of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and examine the model's divergent behaviors across math-solving tasks of three distinct difficulty levels. Observationally, we identify a clear distinction in how the model functions under two reasoning modes: Thinking mode relies on sparse and high-intensity feature activations driving verbal deduction independent of problem complexity, whereas NoThinking mode exhibits an adaptive and diffuse pattern prioritizing symbolic manipulation. Causally, suppressing the three most active sparse features by Total Activation Volume reveals three principles: (i) reasoning and syntactic structure are tightly coupled, as interventions consistently degrade \LaTeX{} and boxed-solution formatting; (ii) Thinking responds to disruption with compensatory over-generation marked by increased metacognitive cues and repetitive, low-information continuations; and (iii) coherent CoT behavior depends on a fragile coordination among specialized features, yielding distinct failure modes under perturbation but a consistently impaired output structure.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用Top-K稀疏自编码器（SAEs）分析DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B在数学推理任务中的中间表征，揭示了LLM在思维链（Thinking）模式与直接生成（NoThinking）模式下的神经机制差异。研究发现Thinking模式依赖稀疏高强度的特征激活驱动语言演绎，而NoThinking模式呈适应性弥散模式侧重符号操作；通过抑制Top-3活跃稀疏特征，揭示了三项因果干预原则。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLM结合思维链展现出卓越推理能力，但区分显式推理模式（Thinking）与直接答案生成模式（NoThinking）背后的神经机制仍未被充分理解。作者希望解构这一认知过程，从表征层面阐明两种推理模式的内部工作机制差异。
AI.method: 采用Top-K稀疏自编码器（SAEs）应用于DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B的中间层表征，在三个不同难度级别的数学求解任务上比较模型在Thinking与NoThinking两种模式下的行为差异。通过总激活量抑制Top-3最活跃稀疏特征，进行因果干预实验来验证特征的功能角色。
AI.result: 发现两大核心结果：(1) 观察性结果——Thinking模式依赖稀疏高强度的特征激活驱动与问题复杂度无关的语言演绎；NoThinking模式则呈适应性弥散模式，优先进行符号操作。(2) 因果性结果——抑制Top-3活跃稀疏特征揭示三条原则：推理与句法结构紧密耦合（LaTeX及框式答案格式受损）；Thinking模式对干扰产生补偿性过度生成（元认知线索增加、重复低信息延续）；连贯的CoT行为依赖特化特征间的脆弱协调，扰动下呈现不同失败模式但输出结构一致受损。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了LLM思维链推理与直接生成在稀疏表征层面的根本差异，证明了推理能力与句法格式之间存在紧耦合，且CoT的鲁棒性依赖于特化特征间的脆弱协调。这一发现为理解LLM推理的神经内部机制提供了表征层面的可解释性洞见。

title: Multi-Branch Policy Optimization for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Group-based reinforcement learning methods for multimodal large language models typically rely on trajectory-level credit assignment that applies a single advantage to all tokens in a response. However, multimodal reasoning involves substantially higher perceptual uncertainty than text-only settings, where the model must repeatedly re-examine visual information to verify intermediate interpretations, and different visual groundings can lead to divergent reasoning paths, making such uniform credit assignment particularly inadequate and causing relative advantages to progressively degenerate toward zero. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Branch Policy Optimization (MBPO), a tree-based framework that constructs reasoning trees at vision-language decision boundaries, enabling sibling branches to explore diverse visual hypotheses and assigning segment-level credit through branch-relative advantages. We further introduce a temporal replay buffer to reuse informative segments while controlling policy staleness. Experiments on several multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that MBPO outperforms representative baselines, improving both learning signal quality and optimization efficiency. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShuaiLyu0110/MBPO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多分支策略优化（MBPO），一种面向多模态大语言模型的树状结构强化学习框架。该框架在视觉-语言决策边界构建推理树，使兄弟分支能够探索多样化的视觉假设，并通过分支相对优势进行细粒度的段级信用分配，同时引入时间回放缓冲区来重用信息丰富的片段并控制策略陈旧性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于组（group-based）的强化学习方法对多模态大语言模型通常采用轨迹级信用分配，即对整个响应的所有token施加单一优势值。然而，多模态推理相比纯文本场景存在显著更高的感知不确定性，模型需要反复审视视觉信息来验证中间解释，且不同的视觉依据可能导向不同的推理路径，这使得统一信用分配方式尤其不适用，并导致相对优势逐渐退化为零。
AI.method: MBPO包含三个核心组件：（1）树状框架：在视觉-语言决策边界构建推理树，使兄弟分支可以探索不同的视觉假设；（2）段级信用分配：通过分支相对优势（branch-relative advantages）实现细粒度的信用分配；（3）时间回放缓冲区：重用信息丰富的历史片段，同时控制策略陈旧性以避免分布漂移。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准上的实验表明，MBPO优于代表性基线方法，在提升学习信号质量和优化效率两方面均有显著改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过将粗粒度的轨迹级信用分配细化为段级分支相对优势，并辅以时间回放机制，MBPO有效解决了多模态推理中感知不确定性带来的信用分配退化问题，为多模态大语言模型的强化学习优化提供了更有效的方案。

title: IntelliAudit: Using Large Language Models to Evaluate Audit Controls
summary: IT audits require auditors to judge whether heterogeneous organizational evidence satisfies semantic security and compliance controls. This judgment is difficult to automate because relevant evidence is distributed across policies, records, spreadsheets, and operational artifacts, and because audit conclusions depend on evidentiary sufficiency rather than keyword matching. We present IntelliAudit, a retrieval-grounded multi-agent system for IT audit evidence evaluation. Given a control and an evidence corpus, IntelliAudit retrieves relevant artifacts, generates an evidence-grounded assessment, challenges adverse findings, adjudicates disagreements, and produces an auditor-facing recommendation with cited evidence, rationale, missing-evidence analysis, and remediation guidance. We instantiate IntelliAudit on ISO/IEC 27001 and evaluate it across multiple simulated organizations using expert auditor review and audit-readiness user feedback. The evaluation shows that IntelliAudit can support control interpretation, evidence-grounded reasoning, and audit-preparation workflows, while also revealing the importance of human oversight for calibrating sufficiency judgments and correcting overly permissive recommendations. These results suggest that retrieval-grounded multi-agent systems can assist audit evidence review, but should remain decision-support tools rather than autonomous certification systems.

AI.tldr: IntelliAudit是一个基于检索的多智能体系统，用于IT审计证据评估。它将检索到的相关工件、生成基于证据的评估、挑战不利发现、仲裁分歧，并产出面向审计师的推荐报告（含引用证据、理由、缺失证据分析和补救指导）。在ISO/IEC 27001控制上实例化，并通过专家审计师审查和用户反馈进行评估，结果表明其能支持控制解释、证据推理和审计准备工作流，但需人工监督来校准充分性判断，应作为决策支持工具而非自主认证系统。
AI.motivation: IT审计要求审计师判断异构组织证据是否满足语义安全和合规控制。这一判断难以自动化，因为相关证据分散在政策、记录、电子表格和操作工件中，且审计结论依赖于证据充分性而非关键词匹配。现有方法无法有效处理这种分布式的、需要语义推理的证据评估任务。
AI.method: IntelliAudit是一个检索接地（retrieval-grounded）的多智能体系统。给定控制项和证据语料库，它执行以下流程：1) 检索相关工件；2) 生成基于证据的评估；3) 挑战不利发现（adverse findings）；4) 仲裁分歧（adjudicates disagreements）；5) 产出面向审计师的推荐，包含引用证据、理由、缺失证据分析和补救指导。系统在ISO/IEC 27001上实例化，并在多个模拟组织上进行评估，采用专家审计师审查和审计准备用户反馈两种方式。
AI.result: 评估表明IntelliAudit能够支持控制解释、证据接地推理和审计准备工作流。同时，评估也揭示了人工监督对于校准充分性判断和纠正过于宽松（permissive）的推荐的重要性。结果表明检索接地多智能体系统可以辅助审计证据审查，但应保持为决策支持工具而非自主认证系统。
AI.conclusion: 检索接地多智能体系统在IT审计证据评估方面具有潜力，能够辅助审计证据审查流程，但审计判断中的充分性校准和最终决策仍需人工监督，系统应定位为决策支持工具而非全自主的认证系统。

title: A Grounded and Decomposed Framework for Relation-Level Hallucination Evaluation in Abstractive Summarization
summary:
Abstractive text summarization systems frequently generate fluent yet unfaithful summaries by fabricating or distorting relationships between entities and
  events. Such relation-level hallucinations undermine the reliability of generated summaries, particularly in high-stakes domains. In this work, we present a
  refined and grounded framework for evaluating relation hallucination in abstractive summarization. We present the empirical Relation Hallucination Index (RHI) by
  introducing a dependency-aware relation extraction algorithm that incorporates lemmatization-based normalization, named entity grounded subject resolution,
  passive agent recovery, negation-aware verb modeling, reporting verb filtering, nominal relation fallback, clausal propagation, and systematic deduplication.
  These enhancements improve the structural fidelity of extracted relation triples and reduce spurious matches during evaluation. In addition, we introduce a
  normalized formulation of RHI to ensure scale-invariant comparison between datasets and models. The revised metric decomposes hallucination into interpretable
  components, aggregates relation hallucination metric into a normalized relation faithfulness score. Extensive evaluation across multiple state-of-the-art
  summarization models demonstrates that the grounded extraction process yields more stable and discriminative hallucination measurements. The proposed framework
  advances automated relation-level faithfulness evaluation and supports coherence-aware, hallucination-sensitive model analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个精细化的关系级幻觉评估框架，通过依赖感知的关系抽取算法和归一化的Relation Hallucination Index (RHI)指标，实现对摘要生成模型中实体与事件间关系扭曲的可靠测量。
