AI.conclusion: UNSPECIFIC框架能够有效缓解指令约束合成中的复制粘贴漏洞，生成的约束更难且更自然，并能揭示LLM存在大量浅层遵循指令的行为，为更可靠的LLM指令遵循能力评估提供了新方法。

title: ZOMP: Zeroth-Order Multi-Modal Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning vision-language models such as CLIP typically requires backpropagation (BP) through the full model, which is infeasible when only forward-pass access is available, as is common for memory-constrained edge devices and proprietary model deployments. Prior BP-free, zeroth-order prompt-tuning methods avoid this requirement but often tune prompts in a single modality or optimize over a search space large enough that convergence requires thousands of forward passes, which is impractical under realistic query budgets. We propose ZOMP (Zeroth-Order Multimodal Prompt tuning), a query-efficient, fully forward-only method that tunes deep prompts in both the vision and text branches of a frozen CLIP model using simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation. ZOMP combines three ingredients: a cross-modal low-rank reparameterization that ties the two branches through a shared factor and keeps the effective search dimensionality small, a gradient-correction momentum term that stabilizes the noisy zeroth-order estimate, and a budget-indexed rank schedule that unlocks capacity as the query budget is spent. Across 13 vision-language benchmarks under a matched 5,000-query budget, ZOMP consistently outperforms prior BP-free prompt-tuning methods in both few-shot accuracy and query efficiency, and it generalizes better across base-to-new, cross-dataset transfer, and out-of-distribution settings. Our results show that jointly exploiting multimodality and low-rank structure is an effective route to practical, query-efficient BP-free prompt tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZOMP（Zeroth-Order Multimodal Prompt tuning），一种查询高效的纯前向传播方法，用于在冻结的CLIP模型上同时调整视觉和文本分支的深层提示。通过跨模态低秩重参数化、梯度校正动量项和预算索引的秩调度三个关键组件的结合，ZOMP在13个视觉-语言基准测试上，在5000次查询预算下，于少样本准确率和查询效率方面均优于现有无反向传播的提示调优方法。
AI.motivation: 微调视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）通常需要对整个模型进行反向传播，这在仅有前向传播访问权限的场景下（如内存受限的边缘设备和专有模型部署）不可行。现有的无反向传播零阶提示调优方法存在两个问题：一是仅在单一模态中调优提示，未充分利用多模态信息；二是搜索空间过大导致收敛需要数千次前向传播，在实际查询预算下不实用。
AI.method: ZOMP方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 跨模态低秩重参数化——通过共享因子将视觉和文本分支的提示搜索空间联系起来，降低有效搜索维度；(2) 梯度校正动量项——稳定零阶估计中的噪声；(3) 预算索引的秩调度——随着查询预算消耗逐步解锁模型容量。训练使用同时摄动随机逼近（SPSA）进行零阶优化。
AI.result: 在13个视觉-语言基准测试上，以匹配的5000次查询预算进行评估，ZOMP在少样本准确率和查询效率方面持续优于先前的无反向传播提示调优方法，并在base-to-new泛化、跨数据集迁移和分布外设置中表现更好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用多模态特性和低秩结构是实现实用、查询高效的无反向传播提示调优的有效途径。

title: Improving Constraint Models with LLM Agents
summary: The runtime of Constraint Programming (CP) solvers is highly sensitive to modeling choices, such as symmetry breaking, implied constraints, global constraints, constraint reformulation, and variable representation. Improving these constraint models has traditionally required human expertise, and existing automated reformulation systems are restricted to a predefined library of hand-crafted transformation rules. We introduce an agentic framework that instead reformulates a constraint model from an open-ended space and establishes correctness empirically rather than by construction: a Large Language Model (LLM) agent, given a model and three training instances, proposes alternative formulations, validates each by injecting its solution back into the original model, and diagnoses and repairs failures, returning the best variant it finds in a median of about fifteen minutes. The models are expressed in the CPMpy modeling library, and each proposed model is evaluated on three larger test instances. Across nine combinatorial optimization problems, the generated models outperform the originals on 21 of 27 test instances, and on some problems solve more than two orders of magnitude faster. A comparison against non-agentic baselines that reuse the same validation and selection tools indicates that the gains stem from the agent's iterative diagnosis and repair, not merely from sampling several candidates. These results demonstrate that autonomous agentic methods can support the improvement of constraint models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型代理的约束编程模型自动重构框架。该框架不依赖于预定义的规则库，而是由一个LLM代理在开放空间中提出替代模型公式，通过将解注入原始模型进行验证，并迭代诊断和修复失败，最终返回最优变体。在9个组合优化问题的27个测试实例中，生成的模型在21个实例上优于原始模型，部分问题提速超过两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 约束编程求解器的运行时间对建模选择高度敏感，但模型改进传统上依赖人类专家经验，现有的自动重构系统局限于预定义的手工转换规则库，难以探索开放的建模空间。
AI.method: 引入一个代理式框架：LLM代理在给定模型和三个训练实例后，提出替代公式；通过将解注入原始模型来验证每个候选；诊断并修复失败；使用CPMpy建模库表达模型，并在三个更大的测试实例上评估每个候选模型。
AI.result: 在9个组合优化问题、27个测试实例中，生成模型在21个实例上优于原始模型；部分问题求解速度快了两个数量级以上。与非代理式基线（复用相同的验证和选择工具）比较表明，性能提升来自代理的迭代诊断和修复，而非仅仅采样多个候选。
AI.conclusion: 自治代理方法能够支持约束模型的改进，展示了LLM代理在自动化建模优化方面的潜力。

title: Failure-Aware Long-Form Translation: Design and Implementation of a Recoverable LLM Translation System
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. A sanitized reference implementation is included as ancillary material
summary: A long-form translation request can succeed at the API layer and still produce an unusable result. The output may be empty, truncated, filtered, dominated by source or prompt material, or interrupted after producing text worth keeping. This report describes a recovery protocol developed for a deployed translation system with heterogeneous inputs and provider APIs. It delays the first visible release behind a 64-character window, validates the assembled output, and uses typed stream events to distinguish replacement from continuation. Interrupted work is retained only when a paragraph or sentence prefix can be re-derived from the source. Further attempts follow a stable model order and a shared deadline before entering a provenance-marked fallback path. A sanitized companion artifact implements the protocol and passes 38 public tests. Its fixed cases reproduce all 14 configured completion labels, contain four early-invalid prefixes before any of their 235 characters become visible, retain 31 boundary-safe characters across four interrupted streams, and satisfy the attempt, event, and provenance rules in two end-to-end scenarios. These results are executable checks of the published control flow. Translation quality and detector performance on naturally occurring outputs require a different evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个针对长文本翻译请求在API层成功但结果不可用（输出为空、截断、被过滤、被源文本/提示词主导或中途中断）的问题而开发的恢复协议。该协议将首次可见输出延迟到64字符窗口之后，验证组装结果，使用类型化流事件区分替换与续接，源文本可重新推导时才保留中断工作，并按稳定模型顺序和共享截止时间重试，最终进入带来源标记的回退路径。配套的净化实现通过了38项公开测试。
AI.motivation: 长文本翻译请求在API层返回成功，但实际输出可能为空、被截断、被过滤、被源文本或提示词污染，或在有价值内容产出后中断——这类问题在产品层面导致翻译结果不可用。需要一个系统化的恢复协议来应对异构输入和不同提供商API带来的不可靠性。
AI.method: 提出一个多层恢复协议：(1) 将首次可见输出延迟至64字符窗口之后，组装并验证完整输出；(2) 使用类型化流事件区分"替换"与"续接"两种中断类型；(3) 仅当能从源文本重新推导出段落或句子前缀时才保留中断工作；(4) 重试遵循稳定的模型顺序和共享截止时间；(5) 最终进入带来源标记（provenance-marked）的回退路径。同时提供净化版参考实现并通过38项公开测试作为控制流的可执行验证。
AI.result: 参考实现通过38项公开测试：14个配置的完成标签全部可复现；4个早期无效前缀在其235个字符变为可见之前被拦截；4个中断流中保留了31个边界安全字符；两个端到端场景满足尝试次数、事件类型和来源标记规则。作者明确指出翻译质量和检测器性能需要不同的评估方式。
AI.conclusion: 该恢复协议为长文本翻译系统的输出可靠性提供了工程化的解决方案，并通过可执行测试验证了控制流的行为。测试结果表明协议的"防止无效输出可见性"和"保留有价值中断工作"两个核心能力都得到了有效实现，但自然语言输出质量仍需单独评估。

title: EvBS: Event-guided Blur Synthesis for Domain-adaptive Motion Deblurring
summary: Motion deblurring has achieved remarkable progress with deep learning, yet pre-trained deblurring models often suffer from performance degradation in real-world scenarios due to the domain shift between training and testing distributions. To remedy this, we propose EvBS, an event-guided blur synthesis framework that generates diverse training pairs for calibrating pre-trained models to the target domain. While existing methods are constrained by the inherent entanglement between motion and visual content, our method leverages the high temporal resolution of event cameras to effectively decouple them. This enables us to utilize not only the intrinsic motion that is inherent to the given content but also extrinsic motion transferred from different sources within the target domain, thereby facilitating effective adaptation via fine-tuning. Specifically, EvBS comprises two complementary strategies: Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which blurs sharp contents with their own motion patterns, and Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which transfers motion from blurry patches to distinct sharp content. This approach generates a diverse set of training pairs that break the inherent constraints of naturally coupled motion and content, resulting in enhanced domain-adaptive deblurring performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that EvBS effectively enhances the robustness of existing deblurring models on unseen testing datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvBS，一个利用事件相机高时间分辨率来解耦运动与视觉内容的事件引导模糊合成框架，通过生成多样的训练对（内在模糊合成和外在模糊合成）来微调预训练的去模糊模型，使其适应目标域，从而解决域偏移导致的性能退化问题。
AI.motivation: 预训练去模糊模型在真实场景中由于训练与测试分布之间的域偏移而性能下降，而现有方法受限于运动与视觉内容之间的固有耦合，难以有效生成多样化的训练数据来适应目标域。
AI.method: EvBS利用事件相机的高时间分辨率解耦运动与内容，包含两种互补策略：(1) Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis——用自身运动模式模糊清晰内容；(2) Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis——将模糊斑块中的运动转移到不同的清晰内容上。通过生成多样的训练对，打破自然耦合的运动与内容的约束，实现微调域适应。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，EvBS有效增强了现有去模糊模型在未见测试数据集上的鲁棒性，提升了域自适应去模糊性能。
AI.conclusion: EvBS通过事件相机实现运动与视觉内容的解耦，生成多样且解耦的训练数据，为预训练去模糊模型提供了有效的域自适应微调手段，显著提升其在真实世界场景中的泛化能力。

title: TokenPrint: A Calibrated Token-Space Fingerprint for Language-Model Provenance
summary: Establishing the provenance of a language model---including its base checkpoint and possible overlap in training distributions---is a governance challenge that metadata alone cannot resolve. We introduce a training-free fingerprint based on the top-$k$ vocabulary projections of late hidden states elicited by 250 fixed knowledge probes, compared using Jaccard overlap over decoded token strings. We evaluate the method on 32 open-weight models from nine families (0.6B--32B) with documented relationships. (1)~A \emph{similarity ladder} broadly follows model relatedness: independently trained models on identical data score 0.48 raw (0.35 vocabulary-corrected), followed by shared-base fine-tunes (0.39/0.33), same-developer relatives (0.38/0.28), and models with no documented relationship (0.22/0.17). This identical-data signal persists across three organizations, two tokenizer families, and two architecture classes, and emerges within the first 1\% of training before measurable task competence, suggesting a contribution from shared training data beyond capability convergence. (2)~As a nearest-neighbor \emph{lineage-retrieval} method, the fingerprint ranks the exact documented base among the top two candidates for all five R1 distillations (mean rank 1.8, MRR 0.60), including a math-specialized base not identifiable from coarse metadata. (3)~A \emph{depth ablation} shows that lineage group discrimination strengthens toward the output distribution, with AUC increasing from 0.72 at quarter depth to 0.90 at the output; using only the top 5 output tokens retains AUC 0.87. (4)~The fingerprint remains stable under quantization, with Jaccard similarity of 0.92 under int8 and 0.82--0.85 under int4, compared with a maximum cross-model similarity of 0.81 in the calibration pool. We release the probes, code, and fingerprints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的模型指纹方法，基于250个固定知识探针在晚期隐藏状态的top-k词表投影进行Jaccard重叠比较，用于建立语言模型的血统（provenance）和谱系检索。在9个家族的32个开源模型上验证，该方法能揭示模型间相似性阶梯、实现血统检索、且对量化鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的血统认证（包括基础检查点和训练分布重叠）是治理层面的重大挑战，仅靠元数据无法完成。现有方法难以在没有训练或额外信息的情况下可靠地判断模型之间是否存在衍生关系或共享训练数据。
AI.method: 将250个固定知识探针输入模型，提取晚期隐藏状态的top-k词表投影，用Jaccard重叠比较解码后的token字符串，构建训练无关的指纹。方法包括三个层面的分析：相似性阶梯（与模型关系等级对照）、最近邻谱系检索（用于R1蒸馏模型）、深度消融（比较不同层级的判别力）和量化稳定性测试。
AI.result: (1) 相似性阶梯与模型关系一致：独立训练的同数据模型得分最高（0.48/0.35），其次是共享基座的微调（0.39/0.33）、同开发者近缘模型（0.38/0.28）、无关模型最低（0.22/0.17）；该信号在训练前1%即出现且跨组织、分词器和架构成立。(2) 谱系检索对全部5个R1蒸馏模型的真实基座均排入前两名（平均排名1.8，MRR 0.60）。(3) 深度消融显示越接近输出层判别力越强（AUC从0.72升至0.90），仅用top-5输出token仍保持AUC 0.87。(4) 量化下指纹稳定：int8 Jaccard相似度0.92，int4为0.82-0.85，高于校准池中最大跨模型相似度0.81。
AI.conclusion: 基于top-k词表投影的训练无关指纹可以有效建立语言模型的血统和谱系关系，且对量化鲁棒。该信号部分源于共享训练数据而非仅能力趋同，为模型治理和溯源提供了一种无需访问训练过程的可扩展工具。

title: EmoS: A Theory-Grounded Framework for Evaluating and Aligning Emotional Intelligence in Spoken Language Models
summary: Despite significant advances in instruction-following and auditory comprehension, the evaluation of Emotional Intelligence (EI) in Spoken Language Models (SLMs) remains confined to rudimentary paralinguistic perception, lacking a systematic, theory-driven cognitive framework. We introduce EmoSBench, the first comprehensive EI evaluation benchmark for SLMs constructed upon the four-branch theoretical model, covering Perceiving, Understanding, Using, and Managing Emotion across ten sub-tasks. Preliminary assessments on EmoSBench reveal a substantial gap: even leading proprietary models like GPT-4o-Audio achieve only 52.6%, significantly trailing human baselines. To bridge this gap, we develop EmoS, a specialized evaluator model optimized via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To facilitate its effective training, we curate EmoDialogue, a bilingual dataset providing necessary fine-grained supervision through response pairs with rigorously defined EI gradations. Concurrently, we introduce a reward mechanism integrating a Steep Exponential Accuracy Reward (SEAR) and a Rationale Fidelity Reward (RFR) to enforce precise ordinal scoring and valid reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that EmoS reaches 83.8% accuracy, approaching human-level performance. Furthermore, evaluations on authentic, unconstrained spoken interactions validate its robust real-world generalization, establishing a foundational framework for advancing emotionally intelligent dialogue systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出EmoSBench，首个基于四分支理论模型的语音语言模型情感智能（EI）评估基准，涵盖感知、理解、使用和管理情绪四类共十项子任务。评测发现即使GPT-4o-Audio也仅达52.6%，远低于人类基线。为弥补差距，开发了通过SFT和GRPO优化的专业评估模型EmoS，并构建双语细粒度训练数据EmoDialogue，引入SEAR与RFR复合奖励机制。EmoS达到83.8%准确率，接近人类水平，并在真实非受限口语交互中验证了泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有语音语言模型（SLMs）的情感智能（EI）评估局限于低级副语言感知（如情绪识别的声学线索），缺乏系统性、理论驱动的认知框架，无法全面衡量模型在感知、理解、使用和管理情绪等多维度上的能力。
AI.method: 1) 构建EmoSBench基准：基于四分支理论模型（Perceiving, Understanding, Using, Managing Emotion），包含十项子任务。2) 开发EmoS评估模型：通过监督微调（SFT）和组相对策略优化（GRPO）训练专业评测器。3) 构建EmoDialogue数据集：提供双语、细粒度监督信号，包含带严格EI分级定义的响应对。4) 设计复合奖励机制：整合陡指数准确率奖励（SEAR）和理由忠实度奖励（RFR），确保序数评分精确性和推理有效性。
AI.result: EmoSBench评测显示先进专有模型GPT-4o-Audio仅达52.6%准确率，显著落后于人类基准。训练后的EmoS达到83.8%准确率，接近人类水平。在真实非受限口语交互上的评估进一步验证了其稳健的现实泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EmoSBench和EmoS共同为语音模型情感智能评估与提升建立了理论驱动的基础框架，推动情感智能对话系统向人类级认知迈进。

title: NeuroGuard: Neural Gradient Update Aware of Representation Damage
comment: Accepted at HCV workshop on ECCV2026
summary: Long-tailed class-incremental learning (LT-CIL) must learn new classes from imbalanced streams while retaining old classes. Existing methods mainly change replay, classifiers, or losses. We study a different factor, namely how strongly the feature representation should be updated at each task boundary. We propose NeuroGuard, an update-control method added to DGR, a replay-based LT-CIL baseline, without adding learnable parameters. NeuroGuard preserves DGR's replay memory, classifier, and set of loss terms. Adaptive Gradient Scaling (AGS) converts teacher uncertainty into one task-wise gradient scale. Confidence-Ranked Knowledge Distillation Reweighting (CRK) gives larger knowledge-distillation weights to replay samples that the teacher predicts less decisively. Fragility-Blended Entropy Gate (FBE) adds old-memory leakage to the scale decision. Across five LT-CIL settings, NeuroGuard improves over DGR in every setting. In the four main benchmark comparisons, it achieves the best task-agnostic accuracy among the compared methods. The gains extend to both old- and new-class accuracy, while medium-frequency accuracy improves consistently across all five settings. Controlled comparisons show that the gain does not come from generic gradient suppression: AGS outperforms a matched fixed-scale control in all five settings, demonstrating that boundary-specific scaling is more effective than applying the same average scale throughout learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeuroGuard，一种用于长尾类增量学习（LT-CIL）的更新控制方法。它通过三个组件——自适应梯度缩放（AGS）、置信排序知识蒸馏重加权（CRK）和脆弱性混合熵门控（FBE）——在任务边界自适应地控制特征表示的更新强度，而不添加任何可学习参数。在五个LT-CIL设置中，NeuroGuard均优于基线DGR，四个主要基准上取得最佳任务无关准确率，并通过对照实验证明边界特定缩放优于统一的固定缩放。
AI.motivation: 现有LT-CIL方法主要关注重放策略、分类器或损失函数的设计，但忽略了另一个关键因素：在每个任务边界时特征表示应该以多强的程度被更新。这一被忽视的维度可能对缓解灾难性遗忘和学习新类存在重要影响。
AI.method: NeuroGuard在重放基线DGR之上添加三个组件而不引入额外可学习参数：（1）自适应梯度缩放（AGS）将教师模型的不确定性转化为任务级的梯度缩放因子；（2）置信排序知识蒸馏重加权（CRK）对教师预测不够果断的重放样本赋予更大的知识蒸馏权重；（3）脆弱性混合熵门控（FBE）将旧记忆泄漏纳入缩放决策。三者协同控制在任务边界时特征表示的更新强度。
AI.result: 在五个LT-CIL设置中，NeuroGuard全部优于DGR基线。在四个主要基准比较中取得最佳任务无关准确率，增益同时体现在旧类和新类准确率上，中等频率类准确率在所有五个设置中一致提升。对照实验表明，AGS在所有五个设置中优于匹配的固定缩放控制，证明边界特定缩放比全局统一缩放更有效。
AI.conclusion: 特征表示的更新强度是LT-CIL中一个独立且有效的可优化维度。通过基于教师不确定性和记忆脆弱性的任务级梯度自适应控制，可以在不增加模型复杂度的情况下显著提升长尾增量学习的整体性能。

title: Long SKILL Compliance as Logical Reasoning: Closure-Grounded Detection with Scaling-Guided On-Policy Distillation
summary: The increasing complexity of enterprise business scenarios has promoted the widespread adoption of long SKILL documents in agent systems, posing new challenges for compliance detection: large models incur substantial inference costs, while small models may fail to maintain detection accuracy. To address this gap, we propose SkillCDG, a graph-based framework for long SKILL compliance detection. SkillCDG represents complex business policies as a two-layer constraint dependency graph, where the upper layer indexes SKILL descriptions for scenario routing and the lower layer captures dependencies among atomic constraints within each SKILL. During inference, two-level retrieval followed by dependency closure supports compliance judgment and source traceability. We comprehensively evaluate the framework on three enterprise datasets and two controlled public benchmark variants. Experimental results demonstrate that SkillCDG outperforms baseline methods by up to 12.8 percentage points in detection F1 score, while reducing token consumption by a maximum 64.3\%. Moreover, we further investigate the inherent relationships among policy-graph complexity, model scale, and detection performance. Comparative experiments conducted on four checkpoints from a single model family validate a concise and effective scaling trend: end-to-end detection correctness exhibits a complexity-differentiated scaling pattern, and the complexity metric derived from the constraint dependency graph can effectively quantify instance difficulty and the performance improvement potential of models. Leveraging this insightful scaling trend, we conduct adaptive training sample selection and adopt on-policy distillation to efficiently enhance the compliance detection capability of small-scale models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillCDG，一种基于图的长期SKILL文档合规检测框架。该框架将复杂业务策略表示为两层约束依赖图（上层用于场景路由，下层捕获SKILL内原子约束的依赖关系），通过两级检索和依赖闭包实现合规判断与源追踪。在三个企业数据集和两个公开基准变体上，SkillCDG的检测F1值最高提升12.8个百分点，同时token消耗最多降低64.3%。此外，研究揭示了策略图复杂度、模型规模与检测性能之间的缩放趋势，并利用该趋势通过自适应训练样本选择和同策略蒸馏有效提升小模型的合规检测能力。
AI.motivation: 企业业务场景复杂度的增加促进了Agent系统中长SKILL文档的广泛采用，这给合规检测带来了新挑战：大模型推理成本高昂，而小模型难以保证检测准确率。现有方法在长文档合规检测上存在准确率与效率之间的根本矛盾，亟需一种兼顾两者的解决方案。
AI.method: SkillCDG采用两层约束依赖图表示复杂业务策略：上层索引SKILL描述用于场景路由，下层捕获每个SKILL内原子约束之间的依赖关系。推理阶段通过两级检索加依赖闭包来支持合规判断和源可追溯性。此外，利用复杂度度量的缩放规律，实施自适应训练样本选择并结合同策略蒸馏来增强小规模模型的合规检测能力。
AI.result: 在三个企业数据集和两个受控公开基准变体上的实验表明，SkillCDG相比基线方法在检测F1分数上最高提升12.8个百分点，同时token消耗最多减少64.3%。在单一模型家族的四个检查点上的比较实验验证了端到端检测正确性呈现复杂度差异化的缩放模式，且基于约束依赖图的复杂度指标能有效量化实例难度和模型的性能提升潜力。
AI.conclusion: SkillCDG通过图结构化的策略表示有效平衡了长SKILL合规检测中的准确率与效率；复杂度度量与模型规模之间的可预测缩放关系为小模型的高效增强提供了理论依据和实践路径。

title: UNMASK: Discovering and Causally Verifying Spurious Shortcuts in Text Classifiers
summary: Neural language models trained on large crowdsourced corpora frequently exploit spurious surface patterns tied to target labels without true linguistic or causal relevance, boosting benchmark performance while failing on adversarial or out-of-distribution inputs. Existing approaches either require manual specification of the feature vocabulary or automate discovery only partially, leaving the gap between dataset-level correlation and model-level exploitation unaddressed. We present U N M ASK, a fully automated pipeline that discovers, causally verifies, and mitigates spurious correlations in text classifiers without additional human annotation. Given unlabeled training examples, U N M ASK generates candidate surface patterns as executable boolean expressions, filters them through a statistical validation protocol with independent replication, and establishes causal model dependence via verified counterfactual interventions. Causally confirmed features then serve as annotation-free group definitions for Deep Feature Reweighting, eliminating the group labels that standard DFR requires. Applied to BERT and RoBERTa trained on MNLI, our pipeline independently rediscovers established lexical-overlap and negation biases, verifying 9 of 10 features on BERT and 6 on RoBERTa, and improving HANS accuracy by up to 12.58 pp. On CivilComments-WILDS, programmatic groups match the 70.1% worst- group accuracy of hand-labeled DFR (Kirichenko et al., 2023) without demographic annotation. We further demonstrate that the discovery and validation stages generalize to reward model preference data, surfacing interpretable spurious correlations in RewardBench2.

AI.tldr: UNMASK是一个全自动流水线，无需人工标注即可发现、因果验证并缓解文本分类器中的虚假相关性。它从无标签训练数据中生成可执行的布尔表达式候选特征，通过统计验证协议过滤，并使用验证的反事实干预建立因果依赖。经因果确认的特征作为无标注的组定义用于Deep Feature Reweighting，消除了标准DFR所需的组标签。在MNLI上验证9/10个BERT特征和6个RoBERTa特征，HANS准确率提升最多12.58pp；在CivilComments-WILDS上无需人口统计标注即可匹配手标注DFR的70.1%最差组准确率；发现和验证阶段还可推广到奖励模型偏好数据。
AI.motivation: 大规模众包语料训练的语言模型常利用与目标标签相关的表面模式取得高分，但在对抗或分布外输入上表现不佳。现有方法要么需要手动指定特征词表，要么仅部分自动化特征发现，未能弥合数据集层面相关性与模型层面利用之间的差距。目标是建立一个全自动、无需人工标注的虚假相关性发现与缓解框架。
AI.method: UNMASK包含三个关键阶段：(1) 候选特征生成：从无标签训练样本中挖掘候选表面模式，表示为可执行的布尔表达式；(2) 统计验证：通过独立复制的统计验证协议过滤候选特征，确保其具有统计显著性；(3) 因果验证：通过验证的反事实干预建立模型对特征的因果依赖。因果确认的特征作为无标注的组定义，替代标准DFR所需的组标签，实现Deep Feature Reweighting。
AI.result: 在MNLI上，UNMASK独立重新发现了已知的词汇重叠和否定偏见，在BERT上验证了10个特征中的9个，在RoBERTa上验证了6个，并将HANS准确率提升了最多12.58个百分点。在CivilComments-WILDS上，程序化组无需人口统计标注即可匹配手标注DFR的70.1%最差组准确率。发现和验证阶段还成功推广到RewardBench2的奖励模型偏好数据上，识别出可解释的虚假相关性。
AI.conclusion: UNMASK证明了虚假相关性发现、因果验证与缓解可完全自动化，无需任何人工标注。该方法的因果验证框架为区分数据集层面相关性与模型层面实际利用提供了关键桥梁。其推广到奖励模型偏好数据的能力表明框架具有跨任务通用性，未来可应用于更广泛的NLP模型安全与鲁棒性场景。

title: SCTD 3.0: Sonar Common Target Detection in the Wild - A Large-Scale, Multi-Scene Dataset from Real Marine Surveys
summary: Synthetic Aperture Sonar (SAS) is core for wide-area detection of small underwater targets. However, large-scale, high-quality SAS datasets are scarce, hindering data-driven recognition. Existing benchmarks are small and limited to single scenarios, failing to reproduce complex acoustic scattering, diverse seabeds, and multi-pose imaging in real detection. To fill this gap, we introduce SCTD 3.0 - a large-scale real-measured dataset for Sonar Common Target Detection in the Wild in natural waters. It contains over 10,000 high-quality real SAS image snippets from multi-frequency systems (240 kHz, 450 kHz, and others), covering ten typical target categories across varied seabed geomorphologies, with multiple observation angles, detection ranges, and frequency bands. We establish a rigorous hierarchical annotation protocol that decouples labeling of intrinsic physical properties, deployment characteristics, and scattering phenomena - covering material, geometry, internal structure, burial state, shadow integrity, specular highlights, edge diffraction, and resonance effects. This enables fine-grained target characterization. We also construct a multi-task benchmark for object detection, fine-grained classification, and attribute prediction, evaluating mainstream deep learning models under cross-domain, cross-scene, cross-frequency, and cross-view generalization. SCTD 3.0 is expected to provide a critical data cornerstone for robust underwater target perception in open-water environments. SCTD 3.0 is available at https://github.com/automlresearch/SCTD-3.0.

AI.tldr: SCTD 3.0是一个大规模真实实测的合成孔径声呐（SAS）公开数据集，包含超过10,000个高质量SAS图像片段，覆盖多频段、多场景、多视角的十类典型水下目标，并建立了分层标注协议和跨域多任务基准，旨在推动野外自然水域中的鲁棒水下目标感知研究。
AI.motivation: 合成孔径声呐是宽区域探测小型水下目标的核心技术，但高质量大规模SAS数据集稀缺，现有基准规模小且局限于单一场景，无法复现真实检测中复杂的声散射、多样的海底地貌和多姿态成像，严重阻碍了数据驱动的目标识别研究。
AI.method: 论文构建了SCTD 3.0数据集：(1) 采集自自然水域的真实SAS图像，包含超过10,000个高质量片段，覆盖240 kHz、450 kHz等多频系统；(2) 涵盖十类典型目标类别，覆盖多种海底地貌、观测角度、探测距离和频段；(3) 提出严格的分层标注协议，将内在物理属性、部署特征和散射现象的标注解耦，覆盖材料、几何、内部结构、埋藏状态、阴影完整性、镜面高光、边缘衍射和共振效应；(4) 构建了目标检测、细粒度分类和属性预测的多任务基准，评估主流深度学习模型在跨域、跨场景、跨频率和跨视角泛化下的表现。
AI.result: SCTD 3.0提供了大规模真实SAS数据集和多任务基准，对主流深度学习模型进行了跨域、跨场景、跨频率、跨视角泛化评估，为野外开放水域中的鲁棒水下目标感知提供了关键数据基石。
AI.conclusion: SCTD 3.0填补了大规模真实SAS数据集的空白，通过精细的标注协议和全面的多任务基准，为水下目标检测和识别研究提供了重要数据基础设施，数据集已公开供研究社区使用。

title: A Unified Framework for Dynamic Reward Shaping in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Sparse, delayed, and weakly informative rewards remain central obstacles to efficient reinforcement learning. Reward shaping addresses these limitations by supplementing the task reward with an auxiliary signal that can accelerate learning while, in the classical setting, the original objective remains the evaluation criterion. Established theory guarantees safety for fixed shaping signals: potential-based reward shaping preserves optimal policies when the auxiliary term is the discounted difference of a time-invariant potential. In contemporary reinforcement learning systems, however, both the learner and the information available for guidance evolve during training: value estimates improve, novelty diminishes, feedback shifts, and predictive models are refined. Adaptive reward mechanisms occur across exploration, Bayesian inference, human-in-the-loop learning, automated reward design, and foundation-model-based approaches. This study introduces a unified analytical framework for comparing dynamic reward shaping and neighbouring adaptive reward mechanisms. The proposed framework distinguishes parametric revision from state-dependent variation, separates additive shaping from reward replacement and reward-adjacent guidance, and organises existing methods along temporal, informational, and theoretical dimensions. Using this framework, twelve method families are comparatively analysed. The framework further highlights the conditions under which optimality guarantees survive contemporary deep reinforcement learning pipelines, replay buffers, bootstrapped critics, and reward normalisation, while exposing the unresolved relationship between adaptation rate and learner stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的分析框架，用于比较动态奖励塑形（reward shaping）及其相邻的自适应奖励机制。该框架区分参数化修正与状态依赖变化，分离加性塑形与奖励替换及奖励相邻引导，并沿时间、信息和理论三个维度组织现有方法，共比较十二个方法族，探讨最优性保证在当代深度强化学习管线中的存续条件。
AI.motivation: 奖励信号稀疏、延迟且信息量弱是强化学习高效训练的核心障碍。经典理论仅保证固定塑形信号的安全性（基于势能的奖励塑形），但当代强化学习系统中学习者与引导信息均在训练过程中动态演化（价值估计改进、新奇度衰减、反馈漂移、预测模型精化），自适应奖励机制广泛存在于探索、贝叶斯推断、人在回路学习、自动奖励设计与基于基础模型的方法中，却缺乏统一的分析框架进行比较。
AI.method: 提出统一分析框架：(1) 区分参数化修正与状态依赖变化；(2) 分离加性塑形、奖励替换与奖励相邻引导；(3) 沿时间维度（何时变化）、信息维度（依赖何种数据）和理论维度（何种保证）组织方法。基于该框架对十二种方法族进行比较分析，并检验最优性保证在当代深度强化学习管线（回放缓冲区、自举评论家、奖励归一化）中的存续条件。
AI.result: 框架成功组织了十二种方法家族并进行横向比较，识别出最优性保证在深度RL管线中存续的具体条件，同时揭示了自适应速率与学习者稳定性之间尚未解决的问题。
AI.conclusion: 自适应奖励机制虽在当代RL系统中广泛使用，但最优性保证的存续取决于具体实现细节（如回放缓冲区、自举评论家、奖励归一化的交互）。自适应速率与学习者稳定性之间的理论关系仍是开放问题，需要未来工作进一步研究。

title: Reading Cognition as Decisions Unfold in Words: A Factorized Inverse Decision Model
summary: Inverse decision modeling infers latent properties of decision processes from observed behavior, but existing formulations rely primarily on action trajectories. In verbalized cognitive tasks, task execution also produces response dynamics that action-only formulations leave unmodeled, such as verbal production, interaction, and hesitation. We propose a factorized inverse decision model (FIDM) that decomposes each individual's task-execution likelihood into an action factor and an effort factor, governed by separate individual-specific parameters. From raw verbal transcripts, a language model produces structured task-execution traces for factorized inference. On data from 400 older adults performing a grocery-shopping dialog task for cognitive screening, controlled recovery shows selective estimation of the intended factors, while matched semi-synthetic conditions show that FIDM preserves action-execution distinctions even when aggregate behavioral summaries are matched. Action evidence further localizes task-defined deviations across participants. In cognitive-status classification, FIDM provides information complementary to clinical scores, trajectory summaries, and frozen language representations, with consistent gains across all evaluated baselines in the binary setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因子化逆决策模型（FIDM），将个体任务执行似然分解为行动因子和努力因子，由独立参数控制。在400名老年人购物对话任务数据上，FIDM通过语言模型从原始文本中提取结构化任务执行痕迹进行推断，在认知状态分类中为所有基线提供一致的补充信息增益。
AI.motivation: 传统逆决策建模主要依赖行动轨迹，而在言语化认知任务中，任务执行还产生行动轨迹之外的反应动态（如言语产出、互动和犹豫），这些未被现有模型建模。作者旨在解决这一建模缺口，利用言语信号中的丰富信息提升认知评估效果。
AI.method: FIDM将每位个体在任务执行中的似然函数分解为行动因子和努力因子，分别由独立的个体特定参数控制。具体流程为：从原始言语转录中，通过语言模型生成结构化的任务执行痕迹，再基于这些痕迹进行因子化推断。
AI.result: 在400名老年人购物对话认知筛查任务中：（1）受控恢复实验显示因子选择性估计有效；（2）匹配半合成条件下FIDM在聚合行为摘要匹配时仍保留行动执行差异；（3）行动证据可定位参与者的任务相关偏差；（4）在认知状态分类中，FIDM相对临床评分、轨迹摘要和冻结语言表征均提供互补信息，在所有评估基线的二分类设定中带来一致增益。
AI.conclusion: FIDM通过解耦行动与努力因子，更好地利用言语化认知任务中的丰富反应动态，为认知筛查提供超越传统轨迹和语言表征的互补信息，在认知状态分类中展现一致的稳健提升。

title: SUMI: Scalable Unified Model for 3D Point Cloud Inference
summary: Point cloud completion commonly follows a coarse-to-fine paradigm, where a low-density coarse shape is first predicted and then upsampled to the target resolution. Although recent methods have improved global structure recovery, the fine stage often remains limited by simple upsampling and insufficient interaction with coarse structural features, making local detail reconstruction challenging. We propose SUMI, a diffusion-enhanced refinement module for coarse-to-fine point cloud completion. Unlike prior diffusion-based completion methods that use diffusion as a standalone point generator, SUMI injects noisy geometric features into cross-attention with coarse structural features, enabling reverse denoising to refine local geometry while preserving global consistency. SUMI can also be integrated into existing coarse-to-fine models as a flexible refinement module. Experiments on PCN, ShapeNet-55/34, and MVP demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines. SUMI achieves the best overall CD and F1-score on PCN, reduces CD by up to 16.1% on ShapeNet-55, and obtains the best CD across all output densities on MVP.

AI.tldr: SUMI是一个扩散增强的细化模块，用于粗到细的点云补全。与将扩散作为独立点生成器的先前方法不同，SUMI将带噪几何特征注入与粗结构特征的交叉注意力中，使反向去噪能够细化局部几何同时保持全局一致性。该模块可灵活集成到现有粗到细模型中，在PCN、ShapeNet-55/34和MVP数据集上均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有粗到细的点云补全方法虽然在全局结构恢复上有改进，但细阶段往往受限于简单的上采样策略和对粗结构特征交互不足，导致局部细节重建困难。先前基于扩散的补全方法将扩散用作独立的点生成器，未能充分利用粗到细框架的优势。
AI.method: SUMI通过将带噪几何特征注入与粗结构特征的交叉注意力中，使反向去噪过程能够利用粗级结构信息来细化局部几何。该模块可作为一个灵活的细化模块集成到现有粗到细模型中，而非独立的生成器。
AI.result: 在PCN数据集上获得最佳整体CD和F1-score；在ShapeNet-55上CD最多降低16.1%；在MVP数据集上所有输出密度下均获得最佳CD。在三个基准数据集上均优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SUMI证明了将扩散机制集成到粗到细框架中作为细化模块（而非独立生成器）的有效性，通过交叉注意力实现扩散过程与粗结构特征的信息交互，在提升局部细节重建的同时保持全局一致性，且具有良好的模型兼容性和通用性。

title: When Is a Steerable Concept Representation Real? Measurement Confounds in a Cross-Family Audit of Neuroscience Parallels in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly reported to exhibit human-like neural and cognitive signatures, including concept cells, mental number lines, and cognitive maps. These claims often rely on linear probing and activation steering applied to a single model, yet both methods are highly sensitive to measurement choices. A reported parallel may therefore reflect the model, the measurement procedure, or both. We audit four representative neuroscience-inspired paradigms across 17 models from five families, spanning $0.6$B to $72$B parameters. Our main experiment examines the causal steerability of concept directions. With raw activation units and a fixed layer and coefficient, steerability appears to increase with model scale, resembling an emergent capability. However, this pattern is produced by an uncalibrated pipeline rather than by a claim established in the steering literature. The trend depends jointly on raw units, the readout metric, and the operating point; correcting any one of these removes it. With residual-norm-comparable interventions and held-out operating-point selection, concept steering remains significant at every scale, but shows no significant trend across the Qwen3 series, although the confidence interval does not rule out a moderate positive slope. The remaining results are mixed. A linear geographic world map is consistently decodable in every tested checkpoint up to $72$B. Number magnitude is strongly encoded, but whether individual neurons appear bell-shaped or monotonic depends on the selection criterion. Language-specific structure is localizable, but the direction of the cross-lingual asymmetry reverses under a different attribution method. These results suggest that the main constraint on AI neuroscience is not a lack of phenomena, but a lack of comparable measurements and adequate controls. We release the protocol, stimuli, and code.

AI.tldr: 本文审计了LLM中的类神经与认知特征声明，通过在17个模型（0.6B至72B参数）上测试四种神经科学启发的范式，发现许多报告的"涌现能力"实际上是测量管道未校准而产生的人为产物。校正测量方法后，概念引导在所有规模下仍然显著但不再表现出规模趋势。作者得出结论：AI神经科学的主要瓶颈不是缺乏现象，而是缺乏可比较的测量和充分的对照。
AI.motivation: 越来越多的研究声称LLM展现出人类类似的神经和认知特征（如概念细胞、心理数线、认知地图），但这些声明通常基于对单一模型使用高度敏感的线性探针和激活引导方法。由于测量方法本身对测量选择极其敏感，报告的"平行现象"可能反映的是模型、测量程序或两者的组合，而非真实的类人认知机制，因此需要系统性审计。
AI.method: 作者对四个具有代表性的神经科学启发范式进行了审计，涵盖来自五个模型家族的17个模型（0.6B至72B参数）。主要实验检验概念方向的因果可引导性，通过对比原始激活单元与残差范数可比干预、固定层与系数的原始管道与校正后的管道，检验量度指标和操作点选择对结论的影响。此外还测试了地理世界地图的可解码性、数字大小编码的神经元形态、以及跨语言结构的定位与归因。
AI.result: 原始未校准管道下，概念引导的可引导性随模型规模增大而增强，看似涌现能力，但该趋势由未校准管道产生：校正原始单元、读数量度或操作点中的任何一个都会消除该趋势。采用残差范数可比干预和保留操作点选择后，概念引导在所有规模下仍显著，但在Qwen3系列中无显著规模趋势。地理世界地图在所有测试检查点均可解码；数字大小编码强烈存在，但单个神经元呈钟形或单调取决于选择标准；跨语言不对称方向在不同归因方法下反转。
AI.conclusion: AI神经科学的主要制约因素不是缺乏现象，而是缺乏可比较的测量和充分的对照。作者发布了完整的协议、刺激和代码以促进行业标准化。

title: Verifiably grounded machine interpretation of lunar geology
summary: Planetary geology relies on historical, interpretive reasoning to reconstruct past events from diverse observations. Here, we present a step toward an automated "machine intelligence geologist" by embedding this distinct methodology of geologic knowledge discovery and inference into a multimodal vision-language architecture. Focusing on the stratigraphy of lunar basaltic mare volcanism, we train a model to generate verifiably grounded geologic interpretations directly from co-registered topographic, spectral, and geologic maps. We demonstrate that while the system successfully balances established geological priors with local visual evidence to accurately describe stratigraphy and terrain, numeric age dating derived solely from vision defaults to memorized priors. Integrating an open-book retrieval mechanism resolves this, enabling the model to faithfully cite published chronologies. Our findings delineate the necessary architecture for automated geologic inference: site evidence must be visually interpreted from local data, while quantitative historical context must be retrieved from the scientific record.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态视觉-语言架构的"机器智能地质学家"，用于月海玄武岩火山地层学分析。该模型能从配准的地形、光谱和地质图中生成可验证的地质解释，并通过开放书籍检索机制解决数值定年退化为记忆先验的问题，明确了自动地质推断的架构要求：局部证据需视觉解读，定量历史背景需从科学记录中检索。
AI.motivation: 行星地质学依赖历史性、解释性推理来从多样化观测中重建过去事件，传统方法缺乏自动化工具。作者希望构建一个能嵌入地质知识发现和推断方法论的自动"机器智能地质学家"，以减轻人工分析负担并提高地质解释的可验证性和可复现性。
AI.method: 采用多模态视觉-语言架构，将地质推断方法论嵌入其中。模型输入为共配准的地形图、光谱图和地质图，训练目标是生成可验证的地质解释。此外，引入开放书籍检索（open-book retrieval）机制，使模型在需要数值年龄信息时能从已发表的年代学文献中检索并引用，而非仅依赖训练时记忆的先验知识。
AI.result: 系统能够很好地平衡既有的地质先验与局部视觉证据，准确描述地层学和地形特征。然而，仅依赖视觉输入的数值年龄定年会退化为记忆训练先验。集成开放书籍检索机制后，模型能够忠实引用已发表的年代学数据，解决了该问题。
AI.conclusion: 自动地质推断的必要架构为：现场证据必须从局部数据进行视觉解读，而定量历史背景必须从科学记录中检索获取。这为构建更通用、更可靠的自动地质解释系统提供了关键架构指导。

title: Staying True to the Origin: Continuous Image Stylization with Smooth Transitions
summary: Recent advances in generative models have achieved remarkable performance in text- and image-conditioned editing. However, preserving the content of a given image while referencing style patterns from another remains challenging, often leading to uncontrollable stylization results. In this paper, we approach image stylization from the perspective of continuous control, aiming to enable modern Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based multi-reference editing models to (1) faithfully preserve the semantic structure of the content image, (2) render strong stylization effects, and (3) smoothly transition between the two. To this end, we propose a simple yet effective two-stage training strategy along with a style-strength-aware spline formulation. Specifically, in the first stage, the model is trained to produce strongly stylized outputs while preserving the content semantics as much as possible. In the second stage, with the base model frozen, we learn a set of anchor projectors that map various stylization strengths into the model parameter space. During inference, by performing style-strength-aware spline interpolation in a low-rank space, our method enables continuous control over stylization strength, even though the model is trained with only a few discrete strength levels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method supports precise and continuous manipulation of stylization strength while generating high-fidelity results with modern DiT models. Project page: https://reychiaro.github.io/StyleController.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StyleController方法，通过两阶段训练策略和风格强度感知的样条插值，实现对基于DiT的多参考图像编辑模型的连续风格化强度控制，在保留内容语义结构的同时支持平滑的风格迁移过渡。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本和图像条件编辑模型在风格化任务中难以同时满足内容保真和风格表达两个目标，导致风格化结果不可控。作者希望从连续控制的角度解决这一问题，使基于DiT的多参考编辑模型能够忠实地保留内容图像的语义结构、渲染强风格化效果，并在两者之间平滑过渡。
AI.method: 提出了一种两阶段训练策略：(1) 第一阶段训练模型在尽可能保留内容语义的前提下产生强风格化输出；(2) 第二阶段冻结基础模型，学习一组anchor projectors，将不同的风格化强度映射到模型参数空间中。在推理时，通过低秩空间中的风格强度感知样条插值实现连续风格化强度控制，尽管模型仅用少量离散强度级别进行训练。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法支持精确且连续地操控风格化强度，并能与现代DiT模型一起生成高保真度结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过在参数空间中进行样条插值的方式，成功实现了仅用少量离散强度级别训练即可获得连续风格化控制的效果，为基于DiT的多参考图像编辑模型的风格化控制提供了一种简洁有效的解决方案。

title: Agentic AI-driven Immersive Simulation: A Knowledge-Aware Virtual Training Platform forHigh Dose Rate (HDR) Brachytherapy
summary: The convergence of the Metaverse and Large Language Model (LLM)-based AI agent is catalyzing a shift toward autonomous, immersive, and personalized pedagogical frameworks in medical education. This paper presents a novel agentic AI-driven immersive simulation specifically designed for High Dose Rate (HDR) vaginal cylinder (VC) brachytherapy in cancer care. By integrating Virtual Reality (VR) and mobile computing, the system establishes a high-fidelity, risk-free environment that allows trainees to master complex procedural skills without the facility or safety constraints posed by physical anatomy or live radioactive sources. A core contribution of this work is the seamless integration of a knowledge-aware assistant leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground agent interactions in authoritative clinical guidelines. This architecture also enables an interactive agent to provide natural language interfaces and hands-free, real-time guidance during intricate medical maneuvers. We validate the proposed system through a prototype deployment comprising a Meta Quest 3 interface linked to a local GPU-accelerated AI backend, demonstrating a feasible architecture for HDR brachytherapy simulation. Experimental results indicate that the system maintains suitable end-to-end latency and high context precision, answer completeness, and relevance in the RAG-enhanced pedagogical support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种融合VR、移动计算与基于大语言模型的AI智能体的沉浸式模拟系统，专门用于宫颈癌高剂量率阴道柱状施源器近距离放射治疗的医学教育训练。系统通过RAG技术将AI助手锚定在权威临床指南上，提供自然语言交互和免提实时指导，经Meta Quest 3原型验证了其可行性与良好性能。
AI.motivation: 医疗教育中的HDR阴道柱状施源器近距离放射治疗涉及放射性源和复杂解剖操作，传统训练面临安全风险、设施约束和临床指导资源稀缺等挑战。结合Metaverse与LLM智能体的融合趋势，作者旨在构建一个高风险程序的安全、高保真、个性化训练环境。
AI.method: 系统架构将VR（Meta Quest 3头显）与移动计算结合，构建高保真、无风险的沉浸式模拟环境；核心创新在于集成基于RAG的知识感知AI助手，将智能体交互锚定在权威临床指南中；同时实现自然语言界面与免提实时指导，用于复杂医疗操作中的交互式教学。整个系统由本地GPU加速的AI后端支撑。
AI.result: 通过原型部署验证了架构可行性，实验结果显示系统在端到端延迟、RAG增强教学支持的上下文精确度、答案完整性和相关性方面均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 该研究验证了"LLM智能体+VR+医疗模拟"技术栈在放射治疗教育中的可行性与有效性，为自主化、沉浸式、个性化的医学教学框架提供了实证基础。

title: Is the ACL Responsible NLP Checklist a Box-Ticking Exercise? A Large-Scale Analysis of EMNLP 2025
summary: Responsible NLP practice includes a) transparency, b) ethics, and c) societal impacts. The Responsible NLP Checklist aims to push these goals, and promote responsible practice. Recently, ACL released the EMNLP 2025 Checklists to aid transparency on the current research practice, which we focus on. We curate and release the first two datasets of: a) all the checklist responses and justifications from the EMNLP 2025 Main and Finding tracks; b) checklist reference linking to paper sections. We also provide the first analysis of recent EMNLP Checklists, by examining $73,922$ responses and justifications to them. For the Main track, we find that authors isolate ethics questions of the Checklist from the paper's bulk, mimicking the trend of ethics being an afterthought. We then examine \texttt{NO} responses. We find $44.9\%$ of justifications are poor or bad-faith, being brief or empty. Then, we find significant issues with the checklist design and effort of authors, namely that $6\%$ of all checklists contained logical contradictions between parent and child responses. We also find evidence of surface compliance for responsible ethics, with $53\%$ authors dismissing potential risks or social impacts of their work, for which there should be none. We compare this to the Findings track, noticing a similar trend in both tracks. Lastly, we discuss the implications of the checklist design and provide recommendations for future checklist iterations. Including: a) enforcing a minimum word count, b) enforcing more scrutiny on the risks of appliances.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次构建并发布了EMNLP 2025主会和Findings轨道的负责任NLP检查表响应数据集（含73,922条响应及理由），并进行了系统性分析，发现作者普遍将伦理问题与论文主体割裂（伦理被视为事后思考）、44.9%的"NO"响应理由质量低劣或缺乏诚意、6%的检查表存在父子响应逻辑矛盾、53%的作者轻率地否定了潜在风险或社会影响（表面合规现象）。论文最后讨论了检查表设计缺陷并提出了改进建议。
AI.motivation: 负责任NLP实践包含透明度、伦理和社会影响三个维度。ACL发布了EMNLP 2025检查表以促进研究透明度和负责任实践，但此前缺乏对检查表实际填写质量和有效性的系统性分析。作者旨在通过公开数据集和分析来评估检查表制度的实际效果，揭示其局限并推动改进。
AI.method: 作者从EMNLP 2025主会和Findings轨道收集并整理了所有检查表响应及理由，构建了两个数据集：（1）全部检查表响应及理由数据集；（2）检查表引用与论文章节的映射数据集。在此基础上对73,922条响应进行了多维度分析，包括伦理问题的填写模式、NO响应的理由质量、父子响应的逻辑一致性、风险否定的表面合规现象，并对比了主会与Findings轨道的差异。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：主会作者将伦理检查表问题与论文主体内容割裂，表现为伦理被当作事后补充；44.9%的NO响应理由质量低劣或表现出恶意敷衍（过于简短或为空）；6%的检查表存在父子响应之间的逻辑矛盾；53%的作者轻易否定了工作可能存在的潜在风险或社会影响，呈现出表面合规的特征；主会与Findings轨道展现出相似趋势。
AI.conclusion: 当前EMNLP检查表设计存在显著缺陷，填写的随意性和表面合规现象严重削弱了检查表在促进负责任NLP实践方面的效用。作者建议未来检查表应：a)强制执行最小字数要求以改善理由质量，b)加强对应用风险的审查力度。该工作为负责任NLP实践的制度化改进提供了首批实证数据基础。

title: When Does An Extra View Help? Adapting Single-View 3D Reconstruction with Extra Imagery
summary: Reconstruction of 3D objects from a single image is a challenging research problem in computer vision. The key challenge is the lack of critical information from viewpoints to complete 3D structures. Using an additional view may help to resolve the issue. However, there is no mechanism that can integrate the extra view into the single-view 3D reconstruction principle. We address this challenge by proposing ASV3D, a framework for adapting single-view 3D object reconstruction to test-time data with support from one additional image. We introduce two adaptation strategies: (i) a zero-shot adaptation scheme that leverages the auxiliary image to improve the reconstruction quality of an object without retraining, and (ii) an optimised adaptation scheme that further enhances visual fidelity and cross-view consistency via contrastive learning. We apply our ASV3D to improve two state-of-the-art single-view 3D reconstruction pipelines on both benchmark and real-world datasets. Results demonstrate that our approach consistently improves reconstruction accuracy and robustness under unconstrained multi-view inputs, outperforming the baselines in both quantitative metrics and human preference. We publish our code and the real-world object dataset in our project page at https://github.com/YNhuHuynh/ASV3D/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 提出ASV3D框架，利用一张额外图像（辅助视图）在测试时自适应提升单视图3D物体重建质量，包含零样本自适应和对比学习优化两种策略，在基准和真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 单图像3D重建的关键挑战在于缺少多视角信息导致3D结构不完整。虽然额外的视角图像可能有助于解决这一问题，但现有方法缺乏将额外视图集成到单视图重建框架中的机制。
AI.method: 提出ASV3D框架，包含两种自适应策略：(i) 零样本自适应方案，利用辅助图像在无需重新训练的情况下改善单视图重建质量；(ii) 基于对比学习的优化自适应方案，进一步提升视觉保真度和跨视角一致性。
AI.result: 在两个先进的单视图3D重建管线以及基准数据集和真实世界数据集上验证了ASV3D，结果显示该方法在重建精度和鲁棒性上均有一致提升，在定量指标和人工偏好评估中均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ASV3D能够有效利用额外视图的辅助信息提升单视图3D重建的精度和鲁棒性，并已开源代码和真实世界物体数据集。

title: Matching Supervision to the Student's Learning Capacity: A Unified Framework for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary:
On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves the reasoning abilities of LLMs by internalizing privileged context into model parameters through self-distillation.
  Two recent research lines promote vanilla OPSD by choosing which tokens to learn from and by controlling how much privileged information the teacher receives, respectively.
  However, we show that each line optimizes one variable while holding the other fixed, which leads to a suboptimal solution.
  We argue that the two variables are coupled through the student's learning capacity: the privileged information sets the per-token divergence the teacher prescribes, while token weighting selects which of these the student must absorb.
  We formalize the two lines of work into a unified optimization framework, which maximizes the aggregate teacher--student divergence, subject to a budget on the aggregate learning difficulty the student can absorb.
  Under this modelling, we propose Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation (USD), a lightweight online algorithm to solve the Lagrangian.
  USD reveals that a single dual variable governs both decisions: at one price for learning difficulty, it simultaneously sets the token-selection threshold and the direction of privileged-information adjustment, keeping supervision matched to the student's evolving capacity.
  Through extensive experiments, USD consistently demonstrates superior performance over OPSD and token- and PI-side baselines across various model scales on various reasoning benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/lauvlalala/USD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一在线策略自蒸馏（USD）框架，将OPSD中"选择哪些token学习"和"控制教师接收多少特权信息"两条研究线统一为优化问题，通过拉格朗日对偶求解，用单一对偶变量同时控制token选择阈值和特权信息调整方向，使监督信号与学生动态学习能力相匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有OPSD改进工作分为两条独立研究线：一条优化token选择，另一条控制教师接收的特权信息量。但每条线只优化一个变量而固定另一个，导致次优解。作者认为这两个变量通过学生的学习能力耦合：特权信息决定教师指定的逐token散度，而token加权决定学生需吸收哪些信息，需要统一优化。
AI.method: 将两条研究线形式化为统一的优化框架：最大化教师-学生间的聚合散度，约束为学生可吸收的聚合学习难度预算。在此建模下提出USD，一个轻量级在线算法求解拉格朗日对偶问题，其中单一对偶变量同时决定token选择阈值和特权信息调整方向。
AI.result: 在多种模型规模和推理基准上的广泛实验表明，USD在性能上一致优于OPSD以及token侧和PI侧基线方法。
AI.conclusion: token选择与特权信息控制是耦合的，统一优化这两个变量可带来更优的性能，USD通过单一对偶变量实现了监督与学生能力的高效动态匹配。

title: Accurate but Natural? Diagnosing Grammatical and Idiomatic Gaps in Japanese EFL Writing
summary: Second language writing research distinguishes grammatical accuracy from native-like idiomaticity, yet automated writing evaluation often conflates these dimensions. This study introduces a layered LLM-correction pipeline that isolates structural errors from unnaturalness by generating literal error corrections and idiomatic revisions for 3,830 English writing samples from 120 Japanese junior high school students. Applying the regex-based CEFR-J grammar extractor, we quantify two diagnostic measures: accuracy gaps (structures attempted but incorrectly produced) and idiomatic gaps (grammatically correct structures underused or overused relative to native norms). Results reveal distinct patterns: definite articles, third-person singular -s, and modals (would, could) exhibit significant accuracy difficulties, while -ing forms and hypothetical modals (would) show the largest idiomatic underuse, with simple present verbs, subject-verb-object patterns, and modal can conversely exhibiting the most pronounced overuse. A two-dimensional instructional typology maps error rates against idiomatic gaps, distinguishing accurate but overused grammar items from error-prone or avoided complex forms requiring targeted production practice. This framework advances pedagogical feedback by enabling teachers to diagnose whether learner difficulties arise from inaccurate execution, structural avoidance, or L1-mapped overreliance, supporting evidence-based interventions tailored to the specific needs of each learner.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出分层LLM纠错流水线，将二语写作中的语法准确性与地道性分离评估，通过对120名日本初中生3830篇英语写作样本的分析，量化了准确性差距与惯用性差距两个诊断指标，并构建了二维教学分类框架以区分"准确但过度使用"与"易错或规避"的语法项目。
AI.motivation: 二语写作研究历来区分语法准确性与母语者式地道性，但自动化写作评估系统往往将这两个维度混为一谈。现有工具难以识别学习者的困难究竟来自错误的语法执行、结构规避，还是母语（L1）迁移导致的过度依赖，这限制了教学反馈的有效性。
AI.method: 采用分层LLM纠错流水线，分别生成字面错误纠正（literal error corrections）和惯用地道性修改（idiomatic revisions），用于分析3830篇日本初中生英语写作样本。利用基于正则表达式的CEFAR-J语法提取器，量化两个诊断指标：准确性差距（accuracy gaps，即尝试但错误产生的结构）和惯用性差距（idiomatic gaps，即语法正确但相对母语者规范被过度使用或使用不足的结构）。
AI.result: 发现显著差异模式：定冠词、第三人称单数-s和情态动词（would, could）在准确性上存在显著困难；-ing形式和假设性情态动词（would）表现出最大的惯用使用不足，而一般现在时动词、主谓宾结构和情态动词can则显示出最明显的过度使用。二维教学分类图将错误率与惯用性差距对应，区分了"准确但过度使用"与"易错或规避的复杂形式"两类语法项目。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过使教师能够诊断学习者困难究竟源于不准确的执行、结构规避还是L1映射的过度依赖，推进了教学反馈实践，支持针对每个学习者特定需求进行循证干预。

title: Compositional Cross-Modality Translation via Whole-Volume Multitask Latent Flow Matching
summary: Cross-modality medical image translation can reduce the burden of multi-modal acquisitions, yet the field remains constrained by two coupled limitations: methods operate on 2D slices or 3D patches rather than whole volumes, and train a separate model for each translation task. Both stem from a single cause, the absence of a sufficiently strong volumetric prior, which forces generative models to learn anatomical appearance and cross-modality mapping simultaneously, an ill-posed problem at the scale of available paired datasets. We propose to decouple these objectives. A large-scale pretrained 3D variational autoencoder provides a compact latent representation of volumetric appearance, reducing translation to a conditional flow-matching problem. This compression makes whole-volume processing tractable, while a resolution-aware sampling strategy preserves native anatomical scale. We train a single model jointly across inter-modality (MRI$\to$CT, CBCT$\to$CT) and intra-modality (MRI$\to$MRI) tasks over three multi-center datasets. Across all tasks, whole-volume processing outperforms its patch-based counterpart, and the multi-task model matches task-specific baselines while replacing $N$ networks with one. Crucially, joint training unlocks capabilities inaccessible to task-specific approaches: zero-shot generalization to anatomical regions unseen during training, within 0.15 SSIM of the fully supervised model, and compositional cross-dataset translation along paths never directly supervised. These results suggest that combining a strong volumetric prior with multitask training is a scalable route toward synthesis systems that generalize beyond their training distribution. Code is available at https://github.com/arco-group/Whole-Volume-Latent-FM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于大规模预训练3D变分自编码器的跨模态医学图像翻译方法。该方法通过将体积外观压缩为紧凑的潜在表示，将翻译问题简化为条件流匹配问题，使全体积处理变得可行。单一模型可联合处理多个跨模态和模态内任务，并展现出任务特定模型无法实现的能力：对未见解剖区域的零样本泛化以及跨数据集的组合式翻译。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态医学图像翻译方法受两大耦合限制：只能在2D切片或3D斑块上操作而非全体积，且每个翻译任务需单独训练模型。这两个问题的根源是缺乏足够强的体积先验，导致生成模型需同时学习解剖外观和跨模态映射，在配对数据集规模有限的情况下属于病态问题。
AI.method: 提出解耦两个目标的方法：1）使用大规模预训练的3D变分自编码器（VAE）提供体积外观的紧凑潜在表示，将翻译简化为条件流匹配问题；2）压缩使得全体积处理变得可行，并采用分辨率感知采样策略保留原生解剖尺度；3）在多个数据中心上联合训练单一模型，涵盖模态间任务（MRI→CT, CBCT→CT）和模态内任务（MRI→MRI）。
AI.result: 在所有任务上，全体积处理优于斑块处理方法；多任务模型在匹配任务特定基线性能的同时，用1个网络取代了N个网络。联合训练还解锁了任务特定方法无法实现的能力：对训练中未见解剖区域的零样本泛化（与完全监督模型仅差0.15 SSIM），以及沿未直接监督的路径进行组合式跨数据集翻译。
AI.conclusion: 将强体积先验与多任务训练相结合，是构建能超越训练分布泛化的医学图像合成系统的可扩展路线。

title: Large Multimodal Agents for Intelligent Transportation Systems: Architectures, Evidence, and Deployment Challenges
summary: Large multimodal agents (LMAs) are increasingly proposed for intelligent transportation systems (ITS), but existing studies often conflate multimodality, agency, empirical performance, and deployment readiness. This review provides an auditable evidence map of 42 primary study families released between January 2023 and 3 August 2026 within a corpus of 91 mapped sources. It distinguishes model-level, system-level, and hybrid multimodality and classifies each family by system architecture and action authority. Evidence is assessed independently through functional capability (C0-C3), validation setting (E0-E4), three evidence propositions (P1-P3), and eight methodological-concern domains (Q1-Q8). Transportation semantics (P1) are directly evaluated in 23 families and multidimensional integration (P3) in 24; 19 families directly evaluate both. Evidence reconciliation (P2) remains unresolved because no family demonstrates the complete provenance-challenge-handling-comparison-outcome chain. Fourteen families reach C3, but 13 remain at E2; only one reaches E3 and none reaches E4. Across ITS domains, LMAs are best supported for semantic interpretation, intent translation, evidence organisation, scenario authoring, explanation, and specialist-tool coordination. Numerical forecasting, optimisation, simulation fidelity, hard constraints, low-level control, safety fallback, and final authority should remain with independently verifiable specialist systems or accountable humans. The review therefore supports bounded orchestration rather than replacement and provides a matched comparative evaluation protocol and staged roadmap for accountable deployment. The living evidence repository is available at https://github.com/pangjunbiao/ITS-LMA-Review.

AI.tldr: 本文对2023年1月至2026年8月期间面向智能交通系统（ITS）的42个大型多模态智能体（LMA）主要研究家族进行了可审计的证据图谱综述，区分了模型级、系统级和混合多模态，并通过功能能力、验证场景、证据命题和方法论关注域六个维度独立评估证据。研究发现：LMA在语义解释、意图转换、证据组织等任务上表现最佳，但数值预测、优化、安全兜底与最终决策权应保留给可独立验证的专家系统或人类。综述支持"有界编排"而非"替代"，并提供了配对比较评估协议和分阶段部署路线图。
AI.motivation: 现有面向ITS的大型多模态智能体研究常将多模态性、智能体能力、实证表现和部署就绪性混为一谈，缺乏系统化的证据评估框架，导致研究结论难以比较、可信度存疑，也无法为实际部署提供可靠的决策依据。
AI.method: 构建包含91个映射来源、42个主要研究家族的证据图谱；将多模态性分为模型级、系统级和混合三类，按系统架构和行动权限对每个家族分类；通过功能能力等级（C0-C3）、验证场景等级（E0-E4）、三个证据命题（P1-P3）和八个方法论关注域（Q1-Q8）对证据进行独立评估。
AI.result: 23个家族直接评估了交通语义（P1），24个评估了多维集成（P3），其中19个同时评估两者；证据调和（P2）因没有家族能呈现完整的溯源-挑战处理-比较-结果链条而悬而未决。14个家族达到C3功能等级，但13个仍停留在E2验证等级，仅1个达到E3，无家族达到E4。LMA在语义解释、意图翻译、证据组织、场景编写、解释和专家工具协调方面受到最佳支持；数值预测、优化、仿真保真度、硬约束、低层控制、安全兜底和最终权限应留给可独立验证的专家系统或人类。
AI.conclusion: 该综述支持"有界编排"而非"替代"的定位：LMA应作为ITS中的编排协调层，而非替代专家系统。研究提供了配对比较评估协议和分阶段部署路线图，并建立了持续更新的证据仓库，以支撑可问责的智能交通系统部署。

title: Universal or Language-Family-Specific Script Unification for Cross-Lingual Transfer? A Case Study on Turkic Languages
summary: Closely related languages written in different scripts expose little surface overlap to multilingual models, limiting cross-lingual transfer. We compare two approaches to script unification: the general-purpose uroman romanizer and the family-specific Common Turkic Script (CTS). We train matched fastText models on transliterated Wikipedia corpora from 11 Turkic languages and evaluate them on WikiANN named entity recognition and Universal Dependencies part-of-speech tagging. CTS and uroman show no significant difference on NER, while both substantially outperform the official monolingual fastText baselines. POS results reveal no universal winner: language-specific differences are associated with the cross-lingual character n-gram coverage induced by each representation, while within-language coverage becomes more important when target-language supervision is available. Although CANINE-c achieves higher overall POS averages, the substantially simpler fastText-based systems remain competitive on several treebanks. Overall, the effectiveness of script unification depends on the language, the induced subword overlap, and the available supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了两种脚本统一方法（通用uroman罗马化方案和突厥语族专用的Common Turkic Script）在11种突厥语跨语言迁移中的效果。在NER任务上两者无显著差异且均优于官方fastText基线；在POS任务上无普遍最优方案，效果取决于跨语言字符n-gram覆盖、语内覆盖度及监督数据可得性。尽管CANINE-c整体POS均值更高，简单的fastText系统在若干树库上仍具竞争力。
AI.motivation: 不同脚本书写但密切相关的语言在表层文本上几乎没有重叠，这限制了多语言模型的跨语言迁移能力。现有的脚本统一方法（如uroman）是否最优尚无系统评估，尤其缺乏面向特定语系的专用方案（如CTS）与通用方案的对比研究。
AI.method: 选取11种突厥语，分别用uroman和Common Turkic Script（CTS）对Wikipedia语料进行转写，训练匹配的fastText模型，并在WikiANN命名实体识别和Universal Dependencies词性标注任务上评估。同时引入CANINE-c作为更强的对比基线。
AI.result: CTS与uroman在NER上无显著差异且都大幅超越官方fastText基线；POS任务上无普遍赢家，性能差异与各表示诱导的跨语言字符n-gram覆盖相关，存在目标语言监督时语内覆盖更重要；CANINE-c总体POS均值更高，但fastText系统在若干树库仍有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 脚本统一的有效性取决于具体语言、诱导的子词重叠程度以及可用的监督信号。专用脚本方案（CTS）并不必然优于通用方案（uroman），简单模型（fastText）在部分场景下仍可与更复杂模型（CANINE-c）竞争。

title: EFFEKT: Efficient Federated Knowledge Transfer to Foundation Models
comment: 12 main content pages, 8 appendix pages; 3 main figures, 9 appendix figures; 8 main tables, 9 appendix tables; 1 main algorithm, 4 appendix algorithms; accepted at TMLR
summary: Recent data protection laws have accelerated the adoption of Federated Learning (FL) for privacy-preserving decentralized training. Nevertheless, increasing model sizes impose substantial computational demands on client devices, limiting FL applicability in resource-constrained settings. We introduce a novel multi-domain federated learning framework in which lightweight client-side proxy models collaborate with a server-side Foundation Model (FM) to learn new concepts without sharing private data. Our approach, EFFEKT, enables efficient server-side training of domain-specific LoRA adapters while preserving feature-space alignment between the FM and proxy extractors via novel bi-directional cross-distillation strategies. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets and deployments on low-power edge devices demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art baselines in most considered domains while maintaining lightweight computation at the client side.

AI.tldr: EFFEKT是一个多领域联邦学习框架，通过轻量级客户端代理模型与服务器端基础模型（FM）协作，在无需共享私有数据的情况下学习新概念。该方法采用双向交叉蒸馏策略保持FM与代理提取器之间的特征空间对齐，并支持服务器端高效训练领域特定的LoRA适配器。实验表明在多个真实数据集和低功耗边缘设备部署中，在大多数领域优于现有最先进基线。
AI.motivation: 数据保护法规推动了联邦学习（FL）在隐私保护去中心化训练中的应用，但不断增大的模型规模给客户端设备带来沉重的计算负担，限制了FL在资源受限场景中的适用性。现有方法难以同时兼顾客户端轻量化与服务端学习能力。
AI.method: 提出EFFEKT框架，核心包括：(1) 轻量级客户端代理模型与服务器端基础模型（FM）协作学习；(2) 服务器端高效训练领域特定的LoRA适配器；(3) 通过新颖的双向交叉蒸馏策略保持FM与代理提取器之间的特征空间对齐。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验以及在低功耗边缘设备上的部署表明，EFFEKT在大多数考虑的领域中优于最先进的基线方法，同时维持在客户端保持轻量级计算的优势。
AI.conclusion: EFFEKT通过客户端代理模型与服务器基础模型协作以及双向交叉蒸馏策略，成功解决了联邦学习中模型规模过大带来的客户端计算负担问题，实现了高效且隐私保护的分布式学习。

title: Quantization Degradation in Large Language Models: A Signal-Noise Perspective
summary: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of large language models, yet how severely a quantized model degrades is not determined by bit-width alone. We systematically study weight-only post-training quantization across bit-widths, quantization methods, model scales and downstream tasks on multiple model families. We observe that such degradation varies substantially across these factors: 4-bit quantization usually preserves performance, 2-bit often causes broad degradation, and at 3-bit, degradation becomes apparent but varies markedly with task type, quantization method and model scale. To explain this variability, we use the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to measure how strongly quantization perturbs full-precision representations. We trace degradation back to two linked processes: how quantization errors arise within individual modules, and how they accumulate across layers. First, a source SNR decomposition shows that newly introduced errors depend on three factors: the magnitude of the weight error, the strength of the task-specific signal, and how strongly the quantization error aligns with task-specific activations. Different factors affect these components in distinct ways. Second, a cross-layer propagation analysis shows that these errors can be attenuated, preserved, or amplified as they pass across layers, and that larger models benefit from weaker error amplification. Together, these results establish that quantization degradation is governed by how errors are introduced at the source and how they accumulate across the network.

AI.tldr: 系统研究了权重后训练量化（PTQ）在不同位宽、量化方法、模型尺度和下游任务上的退化行为，提出用信噪比（SNR）解释量化退化变异性，通过源端SNR分解和跨层传播分析揭示退化由误差在源头如何产生及在层间如何累积共同决定。
AI.motivation: 已有的研究知道量化会损害LLM性能，但退化的严重程度不仅由位宽决定，还受多种因素影响。作者希望系统解释为什么在不同位宽、量化方法、模型尺寸和任务下，量化退化的差异如此之大，从而建立统一的理论框架来预测和理解量化退化。
AI.method: 1) 跨多个模型家族、位宽（2/3/4-bit）、量化方法、模型尺度和下游任务进行系统的权重后量化实证研究；2) 使用信号-噪声比（SNR）量化量化扰动对全精度表示的影响；3) 提出源端SNR分解，将新引入的误差分解为三个因素：权重误差幅度、任务相关信号强度、量化误差与任务相关激活的对齐程度；4) 进行跨层传播分析，研究误差在层间的衰减、保持或放大，并考察模型尺度对误差放大的影响。
AI.result: 4-bit量化通常保持性能；2-bit常导致广泛退化；3-bit时退化变得明显但因任务类型、量化方法和模型尺度不同而差异显著。源端SNR分解显示误差由三个因素共同决定；跨层传播分析显示误差可被衰减、保持或放大，且更大的模型受益于更弱的误差放大效应。
AI.conclusion: 量化退化由两个关联过程共同决定：误差如何在单个模块内产生（源端），以及误差如何在层间累积（传播端）。这为理解和预测不同配置下量化LLM的性能提供了统一的分析框架，也为设计更优的量化策略提供了理论指导。

title: Temporal Misgrounding in Legal RAG: A Versioned-Corpus Benchmark for French Tax Law
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on AI for Law (AI4Law), Seoul. Code and data: https://github.com/rosecymbler/fiscal-fr-bench
summary: We identify and quantify temporal misgrounding: the systematic retrieval and citation of the currently in-force version of a legal article when the applicable version is an earlier or future one. Standard legal RAG treats the corpus as static; we argue legal question answering is a temporally-indexed retrieval problem. We introduce FiscalQA Pro, pairing a versioned corpus of 32,436 article-versions of the French tax code (93 years, 1938-2031) with an all-model-hard temporal-reasoning track: 209 scored, expert-reviewed questions across 33 CGI articles (221 released; twelve flagged out of the answerable scope). At selection time, no evaluated model recovered its date-applicable answer closed-book in any of four sampling draws, and the currently in-force text lacks the gold value for all but one of the scored questions. Answers are scored deterministically via atomic ground-truth "nuggets" (regex and numeric-with-tolerance), never LLM-as-judge: an LLM judge would inherit the temporal bias it is meant to score. Across eleven models (five frontier closed-API systems plus Gemini 2.5 Pro as a substitute entry, and five open-weight), parametric knowledge yields 3.0% mean strict accuracy and RAG over a static current-version corpus 2.7%. Static RAG retrieves the date-applicable version 0% of the time, confidently citing a real but inapplicable version. Our end-to-end retriever over a multi-version index, with no oracle, reaches 98.3% mean strict; an oracle-article ablation reaches 99.1%, locating the residual gap in first-stage recall, not version selection. We additionally release a version-aware jurisprudence dataset of 69,208 citation links, together with the corpus, benchmark, model responses, and pipeline code.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地识别并量化了"时间错置"(temporal misgrounding)问题：在查询法律条文时，模型会错误地检索和引用当前有效版本而非适用时间对应的旧版本或未来版本。作者提出FiscalQA Pro基准，包含1938-2031年法国税法32,436个条文版本和209道专家审核的时间推理题目。实验表明现有模型闭卷准确率仅3.0%，静态RAG仅2.7%，且静态RAG检索到时间适用版本的成功率为0%；而作者提出的多版本索引端到端检索器可达98.3%严格准确率，预留差距主要在首阶段召回而非版本选择。
AI.motivation: 标准法律RAG系统将语料视为静态的，但法律问答本质上是时间索引的检索问题——适用于特定事实场景的法律条文版本取决于事件发生的时间。当前模型普遍存在"时间错置"偏差，即在回答历史或未来法律问题时错误引用现行版本。这一问题此前未被系统性识別和量化，且缺乏专门针对时间敏感法律检索的基准。
AI.method: 作者构建FiscalQA Pro基准：(1) 版本化语料库，包含法国税法93年间(1938-2031)32,436个条文版本；(2) 全模型硬时间推理轨道，209道专家审核的评分问题(共221道发布)；(3) 基于原子ground-truth"nugget"的确定性评分（regex和数值容差），而非LLM作为裁判。此外构建含69,208个引用链接的版本感知判例数据集，并提出多版本索引端到端检索器。
AI.result: 在11个模型（5个前沿闭源API系统加Gemini 2.5 Pro替代条目，以及5个开源权重模型）上：闭卷参数知识平均严格准确率3.0%；静态当前版本语料RAG为2.7%；静态RAG检索到时间适用版本的成功率为0%，且模型会自信地引用一个真实但不适用的版本。作者提出的端到端多版本索引检索器无需oracle即达98.3%平均严格准确率；oracle条文消融实验达99.1%，证明残留差距在首阶段召回而非版本选择环节。
AI.conclusion: 法律问答应被视为时间索引的检索问题，而非静态语料上的普通问答。多版本索引直接解决时间错置问题，使准确率从约3%跃升至98%以上。研究还指出LLM-as-judge在法律时间敏感场景下不可靠，因为评判者会继承其试图评分的时间偏差。作者公开了版本化语料库、基准、模型响应及流水线代码以推动该方向研究。

title: Learning Structural Illumination for Unsupervised Low-light Enhancement
summary: Existing unsupervised low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods often estimate illumination directly from the entire low-light input, without separating its spatially varying illumination pattern, termed relative illumination structure, from the absolute exposure level or preventing unreliable low signal-to-noise ratio regions from biasing the estimate. Moreover, fixed exposure targets impose a scene-agnostic enhancement criterion, limiting adaptation across diverse lighting conditions. Inspired by the spatial propagation of light, we propose a Relative Illumination Structure Estimation (RISE) framework that decouples relative illumination structure from absolute exposure and infers it from reliable bright regions, enabling interpretable and robust enhancement. For scene-adaptive exposure adjustment, we further propose a Dual-Metering Exposure Reference derived from each input, allowing RISE to adapt the enhancement strength to individual scenes and generalize across diverse lighting conditions. Extensive benchmark and real-world generalization experiments show that RISE achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised LLIE methods while producing visually natural results.

AI.tldr: 提出RISE框架，将相对光照结构与绝对曝光级别解耦，从可靠亮区推断光照结构，并采用双测光曝光参考实现场景自适应增强，在无监督低光图像增强中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督低光图像增强方法直接从整幅低光输入中估计照明，未分离空间变化的相对光照结构与绝对曝光水平，且低信噪比区域会干扰估计；同时固定曝光目标缺乏场景自适应性，难以适应多样化光照条件。
AI.method: 提出RISE框架：(1) 将相对光照结构与绝对曝光解耦，从可靠的亮区域推断相对光照结构，实现可解释且鲁棒的增强；(2) 提出双测光曝光参考(Dual-Metering Exposure Reference)，由每张输入导出，使增强强度适应个体场景并泛化到不同光照条件。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集和真实世界泛化实验中，RISE在无监督低光图像增强方法中达到SOTA性能，同时产生视觉上自然的输出结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦相对光照结构与绝对曝光，并结合场景自适应的双测光曝光参考，RISE有效克服了现有方法在空间光照变化建模和暴露目标固定方面的局限，实现了鲁棒且可泛化的无监督低光图像增强。

title: Janus: An Algorithm-Evaluator Co-Evolution Framework for LLM-Driven Discovery under Expensive Evaluation Budgets
summary: LLM-driven program discovery relies on rapid evaluator feedback, but many scientific and engineering tasks require high-fidelity simulations, hardware execution, or physical experiments, making each evaluation expensive. Cheap surrogate evaluators can reduce this cost, yet fixed surrogates are vulnerable to search-induced distribution shift and are difficult to fit reliably from sparse, search-biased labels. We introduce Janus, a framework that uses LLMs to co-evolve target programs and executable proxy evaluators. To address label scarcity, Janus leverages domain knowledge encoded in LLMs to generate task-specific evaluator programs and calibrates them using real outcomes. To mitigate distribution shift, Janus evolves evaluators alongside target programs, selects them using a promotion-aligned objective, and maintains region-conditioned portfolios with online credit updates. Because proxy predictions remain fallible, Janus uses them only to prioritize candidates and requires real validation before candidates can enter the target-program population or update the incumbent. Across five scientific and engineering design tasks, Janus achieves a larger area under the best-so-far improvement curve over the real-evaluation budget and higher final performance than a matched baseline that evolves only target programs. On average, Janus reaches 99/% of the baseline's final improvement with 59.1/% fewer real evaluations. Evolved proxy evaluators also rank promising candidates more accurately than their seed versions. Together, these results extend evaluator-guided LLM discovery from tasks with cheap, scalable feedback to scientific domains where trustworthy evaluation is scarce and expensive.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Janus框架，通过LLM协同演化目标程序与可执行代理评估器，解决昂贵真实评估场景下LLM程序发现效率低的问题。Janus利用LLM领域知识生成任务特定评估器并用真实结果校准，采用符合推广目标的评估器演化、区域条件化模型组合及在线信用更新来缓解分布偏移，同时代理预测仅用于候选排序，真实验证仍强制保留。在五个科学与工程设计任务上，Janus用更少的真实评估达到更高最终性能，平均节省59.1%的真实评估。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的程序发现依赖快速评估反馈，但许多科学与工程任务需要高保真模拟、硬件执行或物理实验，每次评估成本高昂。固定的代理评估器易受搜索引起的分布偏移影响，且难以从稀疏、有搜索偏差的标签中可靠拟合。因此需要一种能随搜索进程共同演化、缓解分布偏移的代理评估机制。
AI.method: Janus框架的核心方法包括：(1) 利用LLM编码的领域知识生成任务特定评估器程序，并用真实结果进行校准以解决标签稀缺问题；(2) 协同演化目标程序与评估器，使用与推广目标对齐（promotion-aligned）的目标函数选择评估器，维护区域条件化（region-conditioned）的评估器组合并通过在线信用更新动态调整；(3) 代理预测仅用于候选优先级排序，候选进入目标程序种群或更新当前最优值之前必须经过真实验证。
AI.result: 在五个科学与工程设计任务上，Janus相比仅演化目标程序的匹配基线，在真实评估预算下的best-so-far improvement曲线面积更大，最终性能更高。平均而言，Janus用59.1%更少的真实评估即可达到基线最终改进的99%。演化后的代理评估器对候选的排序准确性也优于其种子版本。
AI.conclusion: Janus将评估器引导的LLM发现从廉价、可扩展反馈的任务扩展到真实评估稀缺且昂贵的科学领域，证明了协同演化代理评估器作为一种应对分布偏移和标签稀疏问题的有效策略。

title: Intent Speaks Louder: Controllable User Simulation Beyond Response Imitation
summary: User simulators are widely used as scalable environments for training and evaluating interactive assistants. Generating the next user turn is inherently one-to-many: the same profile and dialogue context may support multiple plausible continuations with different local interaction intents. A fluent response may therefore advance the dialogue through an inappropriate intent, such as acceptance rather than repair. Our key insight is that controllable user simulation should separate which local interaction intent the next user turn should realize from how that intent is expressed in language. We introduce UserIDA (User Intent-Directive Alignment), which exposes interaction intent as an explicit per-turn directive. UserIDA defines a six-way intent interface, learns directive-conditioned generation through supervised fine-tuning, and uses intent-calibrated policy optimization during group-based reinforcement learning. The reward preserves composite response quality while ensuring that intent-violating candidates rank below compliant alternatives in mixed groups. On LMSYS-USP, UserIDA achieves 86.6\% intent accuracy, outperforming the strongest dedicated user-simulator baseline by 24.3 percentage points while improving semantic and stylistic similarity. In within-context interventions, it realizes at least four of the six target intents in 91.7\% of evaluated dialogue states, compared with 22.9\% for the strongest external baseline. These results establish per-turn intent control as a complementary dimension to response fidelity in user simulation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出UserIDA（用户意图-指令对齐）框架，通过将可控用户模拟中的"交互意图"（下一轮该做什么）与"语言表达"（如何说）分离，实现用户模拟器的逐轮意图级控制。UserIDA定义了六类交互意图接口，通过监督微调学习指令条件生成，并结合意图校准的策略优化进行组强化学习，在LMSYS-USP基准上实现86.6%的意图准确率，比最强专用用户模拟器基线高出24.3个百分点，同时在语义和风格相似性上也有提升。
AI.motivation: 用户模拟器被广泛用于训练和评估交互式助手，但生成下一轮用户话语本质上是"一对多"问题：相同的画像和对话上下文可能支持多种合理的延续，且对应不同的局部交互意图。一个流畅的回复可能通过不合适的意图推进对话（如接受而非修复）。现有方法缺乏对局部交互意图的显式控制，因此需要将"哪一步交互意图"与"如何用语言表达"分离。
AI.method: UserIDA包含三个核心组件：(1) 定义六类交互意图接口，作为每轮显式指令（directive）；(2) 通过监督微调学习指令条件生成；(3) 采用意图校准的策略优化进行组强化学习。其奖励函数在保留复合响应质量的同时，确保混合组中违反意图的候选排在符合意图的候选之下。
AI.result: 在LMSYS-USP基准上，UserIDA实现86.6%的意图准确率，比最强专用用户模拟器基线提高24.3个百分点，同时语义和风格相似性也有提升。在上下文内干预测试中，UserIDA在91.7%的评估对话状态下能实现六种目标意图中至少四种，而最强外部基线仅为22.9%。
AI.conclusion: 逐轮意图控制被确立为用户模拟中与响应保真度互补的一个维度。将交互意图与语言表达分离是实现可控用户模拟的有效范式，有望提升基于用户模拟器的交互式助手训练与评估质量。

title: Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended captioning and visual QA but often describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image, a phenomenon known as object hallucination. We propose a {training-free, post-hoc representation editing technique} that operates in the representation space of the language backbone. The method performs a lightweight, one-time offline calibration on a modest paired dataset to estimate the required covariance structures, using only forward passes and empirical second-order statistics with no gradient updates or fine-tuning, after which the correction is absorbed directly into the model's existing weights. By modeling hidden states as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components, we derive a Wiener-type estimator whose optimal gains are given in closed form from the covariances of paired truthful and hallucinated representations. An eigendecomposition yields mode-wise attenuation that respects a stability criterion, i.e., the filter responds continuously to estimation noise. The correction is applied once to the feed-forward output projections of selected deeper layers, at inference time, the model runs unchanged and at the same speed. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5, MiniGPT-4, Gemma3, and mPLUG-Owl2 demonstrate consistent reductions in object hallucination on CHAIR, POPE, and MME while maintaining caption fluency and overall response quality. We further demonstrate the generality of our approach on the TempCompass video understanding benchmark and on discrete diffusion language models for grounded dialogue, showing that representation filtering reduces hallucinations even in temporal video reasoning and multi-step, sequence-wide denoising settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的、事后表示编辑技术，通过在语言骨干的表示空间中估计诚实与幻觉相关隐藏状态的协方差结构，推导出Wiener型最优滤波器并吸收到模型权重中，在推理时无缝降低视觉语言模型的目标幻觉，同时保持流畅性和响应质量。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在开放式描述和视觉问答中常描述图像中不存在的物体、属性或关系（即目标幻觉），亟需一种高效、通用且不牺牲推理速度的幻觉缓解方法。
AI.method: 将隐藏状态建模为诚实成分与幻觉关联成分的叠加，利用配对数据集通过前向传播和二阶统计量（无需梯度或微调）一次性离线估计协方差结构，推导出闭式最优增益的Wiener型估计器；通过特征分解实现逐模式衰减，并满足稳定性准则（滤波器对估计噪声连续响应）；校正被吸收进选定深层的前馈输出投影权重中，推理时模型不变。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5、MiniGPT-4、Gemma3和mPLUG-Owl2上，CHAIR、POPE和MME基准上目标幻觉一致减少，同时保持描述流畅性和整体响应质量；在TempCompass视频理解基准和离散扩散语言模型的接地区对话中同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 表示滤波是一种训练免费、事后修复、对推理速度零影响的通用幻觉缓解范式，不仅适用于标准VLMs，还扩展到视频时间推理和序列级去噪的扩散语言模型设置中。

title: A Minimal $κ$--$τ$ Logic for Risk-Sensitive Abduction
comment: 44 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to Neurosymbolic Artificial Intelligence (IOS Press/Sage)
summary: Standard approaches to abductive reasoning can retain multiple candidate explanations, but they do not generally combine explicit compositional cross-hypothesis interaction with an internal, rival-sensitive commitment judgment. This paper argues that in risk-sensitive domains -- where premature commitment carries asymmetric downside costs -- the timing of commitment is itself a governed decision that the inferential apparatus should formally represent. We present a minimal $κ$--$τ$ logical framework built on two primitives: epistemic interaction among hypotheses ($κ$) and a normative commitment threshold ($τ$). Hypotheses may coexist, reinforce or inhibit one another, and form emergent composite explanations, while collapse into committed conclusions is regulated by governance constraints rather than forced by inference alone. The logic is developed in two complementary modes sharing the interaction relation and the governance apparatus: a synthetic mode, in which atomic hypotheses are composed upward into emergent explanations, and an analytic mode, in which complex observed states of affairs are decomposed into causal clusters of latent factors, with commitment governed at both the cluster and the factor level. The framework provides formal machinery for domains in which the distinction between highly likely and commit-worthy is operationally consequential. The $κ$--$τ$ logic is positioned as the symbolic governance layer of a neurosymbolic architecture: its epistemic parameters are naturally estimated by neural components -- semantic embeddings and generative models, as demonstrated in existing computational realizations -- while its normative parameters remain under explicit human governance, yielding transparent and auditable abductive reasoning for deployment in high-stakes settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个最小化的κ–τ逻辑框架，将假设之间的认知交互（κ）与规范性承诺阈值（τ）作为两个原始概念，用于风险敏感领域中受治理约束的溯因推理。该逻辑以综合与分析两种互补模式运作，并在神经符号架构中作为符号治理层，由神经网络估计认知参数而规范性参数由人类显式治理。
AI.motivation: 标准溯因推理虽能保留多个候选解释，但缺乏结合显式组合性跨假设交互与内部、对竞争敏感的承诺判断的能力。在风险敏感领域（如医疗诊断、金融决策等），过早承诺会带来不对称的下行成本，承诺时机本身应当是一个由推理装置正式表示的受治理决策，而非仅由推理强制决定。
AI.method: 构建一个最小化的κ–τ逻辑框架，两个原始概念为：κ（假设间的认知交互，允许共存、相互加强或抑制，形成涌现性复合解释）和τ（规范性承诺阈值，控制可折叠为已承诺结论的条件）。该逻辑在两种互补模式下运作：综合模式将原子假设向上组合为涌现解释；分析模式将复杂观测状态分解为潜在因子的因果簇，承诺在簇和因子两个层面受治理。整个框架作为神经符号架构的符号治理层，神经组件估计认知参数，规范性参数由人类显式治理。
AI.result: 框架提供了将"高度可能"与"值得承诺"之间区分作为操作性后果的形式化机制。已有计算实现展示了语义嵌入和生成模型可自然估计认知参数，而规范性参数保持在显式人类治理之下，为高利害场景提供透明、可审计的溯因推理能力。
AI.conclusion: κ–τ逻辑通过将承诺时机作为受治理的决策而非推理的副产品，弥合了溯因推理中认知评估与规范承诺之间的鸿沟。它既保留假设间组合性交互的显式表达，又通过分层（簇与因子层面）的承诺治理来应对不对称下行风险，并在神经符号架构中实现认知参数可学习、规范参数可审计的双轨设计。

title: Reducing Pretraining-Generation Mismatch in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Autoregressive language models align training and use: generation conditions on a clean prompt, and training predicts future tokens from clean left context. Diffusion language models offer parallel denoising, but native dLLM pretraining can randomly corrupt prompt and continuation tokens together, weakening the clean-prefix interface needed for prompt-conditioned generation. We identify this mismatch for prompt continuation and propose PCD (Prefix-Conditioned Diffusion), a pretraining objective that combines AR prefix supervision with no-shift suffix denoising. At the training-objective level, PCD changes the attention mask, corruption mask, and label construction in continued pretraining; it does not require an autoregressive decoder, verifier, or new inference mode. By supervising the clean-prefix side autoregressively and applying diffusion only to the unknown continuation, PCD makes the local training interface resemble how block-diffusion models are queried at evaluation time. We further separate intra-sample prefix conditioning from inter-sample objective mixing, allowing us to identify the local alignment signal separately from the optional batch-level mixing knob. Across LLaDA2-Mini and Qwen-1.7B backbones, PCD consistently improves over same-family native dLLM stable baselines, reaching a 4.2% relative gain on the main LLaDA2-Mini six-benchmark average (+2.56 points) and a 14.2% relative gain in the primary Qwen mechanism comparison (+4.86 points). These results suggest that aligning the pretraining context distribution with prompt-conditioned generation can recover a measurable part of the dLLM continuation gap without changing inference.

AI.tldr: 作者指出扩散语言模型（dLLM）的预训练目标与提示续写（prompt continuation）生成任务存在失配：原生dLLM预训练会同时随机破坏提示和续写token，削弱了提示条件生成所需的干净前缀接口。为此提出PCD（前缀条件扩散）预训练目标，在训练目标层面结合自回归前缀监督与无偏移后缀降噪，无需修改解码器或推理模式，仅通过改变注意力掩码、破坏掩码和标签构建来对齐训练与推理分布。在LLaDA2-Mini和Qwen-1.7B两个骨干网络上，PCD相对同族原生dLLM稳定基线持续提升，主基准平均最高获得4.2%相对增益（+2.56分），机制对比中获14.2%相对增益（+4.86分），证明无需改变推理即可恢复dLLM续写差距的显著部分。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型在训练与使用时天然对齐：生成时以干净提示为条件，训练时也从干净左上下文预测未来token。而扩散语言模型虽然支持并行去噪，但其原生预训练会同时随机破坏提示和续写token，导致训练时的上下文分布与推理时干净提示条件生成的需求不匹配，从而削弱了提示条件生成的能力。作者旨在解决这一训练-推理失配问题。
AI.method: 提出PCD（Prefix-Conditioned Diffusion）预训练目标。其核心设计为：在持续预训练中，对干净前缀侧施加自回归监督，仅对未知的续写部分应用扩散降噪（无偏移后缀去噪），从而让局部训练接口模仿块扩散模型在评估时的查询方式。PCD仅在训练目标层面修改三个组件——注意力掩码、破坏掩码和标签构建，不需要额外的自回归解码器、验证器或新的推理模式。作者还进一步将样本内前缀条件化与样本间目标混合解耦，以便单独识别局部对齐信号与可选的批级混合旋钮。
AI.result: 在LLaDA2-Mini和Qwen-1.7B两个骨干网络上进行持续预训练实验。PCD相比同族原生dLLM稳定基线持续改进：在主LLaDA2-Mini六基准平均上获得4.2%相对增益（+2.56分），在Qwen机制对比中获得14.2%相对增益（+4.86分）。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练上下文分布与提示条件生成对齐，可以在不改变推理过程的情况下，可测量地恢复dLLM在续写任务上的性能差距。PCD通过训练目标的局部对齐信号实现了这一改进，为扩散语言模型的预训练-推理一致性提供了新的方向。

title: BAP-MOS: Bandit-Based Adaptive Prompting for Boundary-Sensitive Multi-Organ Segmentation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Source code available at https://github.com/SatvikPraveen/BAP-MOS
summary: Multi-organ ultrasound segmentation remains challenging when anatomically adjacent structures must be delineated jointly, as localized boundary errors can persist even when Dice scores are high. To address these challenges, we propose Boundary-Adaptive Prompting for Multi-Organ Segmentation (BAP-MOS), a closed-loop adaptive prompting framework. BAP-MOS formulates prompt selection as an organ-specific multi-armed bandit problem over box, point, and combined prompts. An outer Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) loop selects the prompt-selection parameter vector, while an inner UCB-Tuned loop adapts per-organ prompt preferences during fine-tuning using a bounded Dice--MSD--HD95 validation-probe reward. The framework further introduces an organ-scaled negative prompt ring to adapt sparse prompt geometry across anatomical scales, while keeping the image and prompt encoders frozen and updating only the mask decoder. We evaluate BAP-MOS on pooled prostate-region TRUS cohorts against U-Net, nnU-Net, MedSAM, fixed-prompt SAM/MedSAM, and adaptive policy variants. On this benchmark, BAP-MOS achieves Dice 0.982, HD95 0.482, and MSD 0.204, reducing HD95 by approximately 48% and MSD by 45% relative to the strongest conventional baseline.
