To verify the generalization ability of the framework, we tested it on the external PFUS1 pelvic-floor ultrasound corpus using MedSAM and its adaptive strategy variants, and the results were good. These results support adaptive prompt allocation as an effective mechanism for improving boundary-sensitive multi-organ ultrasound segmentation without modifying the foundation-model backbone. Source Code is available at: https://github.com/SatvikPraveen/BAP-MOS

AI.tldr: 提出BAP-MOS（边界自适应提示多器官分割框架），将提示选择建模为器官特异的多臂老虎机问题，通过TPE外循环与UCB-Tuned内循环的闭环比策略自适应分配框、点和组合提示，并引入器官尺度负提示环，在冻结图像/提示编码器、仅更新掩码解码器的情况下，在前列腺TRUS数据上达到Dice 0.982、HD95 0.482、MSD 0.204，HD95与MSD分别降低约48%和45%，并在外部PFUS1骨盆底超声语料上验证了泛化性。
AI.motivation: 多器官超声分割中解剖相邻结构需联合描绘时，即使Dice分数很高，局部边界错误仍会持续存在，现有方法缺乏对边界敏感性的有效机制来处理这一挑战。
AI.method: 将提示选择形式化为器官特异的多臂老虎机问题（含框、点、组合三类提示）；外层TPE循环选择提示选择参数向量，内层UCB-Tuned循环在微调期间基于有界Dice-MSD-HD95验证探针奖励自适应调整每器官提示偏好；提出器官尺度负提示环适配跨解剖尺度的稀疏提示几何；冻结图像与提示编码器，仅更新掩码解码器。
AI.result: 在合并的前列腺区域TRUS队列上与U-Net、nnU-Net、MedSAM、固定提示SAM/MedSAM及自适应策略变体对比，BAP-MOS达到Dice 0.982、HD95 0.482、MSD 0.204，相较最强常规基线HD95降低约48%、MSD降低约45%；在外部PFUS1骨盆底超声语料上使用MedSAM及自适应策略变体验证，泛化效果良好。
AI.conclusion: 自适应提示分配是在不修改基础模型骨干的情况下改善边界敏感多器官超声分割的有效机制，代码已开源。

title: Persuasive and Compliant Tendencies Predict Group Decision-Making in Humans and Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in group decision-making with other LLMs and humans. Yet it remains unclear whether their influence is driven by persuasion-oriented expression or compliance-oriented accommodation. We introduce DecisionQE, a questionnaire-based framework for measuring each model's persuasive and compliant tendencies across multiple decision scenarios, and use the Werewolf game as an interactive testbed to study their effects on social influence and group outcomes under asymmetric information. Across experiments, stronger persuasive tendency does not significantly improve group outcomes, whereas compliant-oriented models show more stable advantages in cooperation. We further reveal a dual effect of compliance: it supports cooperation in honest roles but improves concealment in adversarial roles. These findings suggest that LLM group interactions reveal not only task outcomes, but also measurable patterns of intrinsic behavioral tendency. LLMs can therefore serve as a lens for sociological observation of language-mediated interaction, while highlighting the need to incorporate behavioral tendencies into safety evaluation of LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DecisionQE框架，用于测量大语言模型在群体决策中的说服性与顺从性倾向，并以狼人杀游戏作为交互测试平台进行研究。实验发现更强的说服倾向并不能显著改善群体结果，而顺从倾向模型在合作方面表现出更稳定的优势。顺从性具有双重效应：在诚实角色中促进合作，但在对抗性角色中增强伪装能力。研究说明LLM群体交互不仅能揭示任务结果，还能反映出可测量的内在行为倾向，并强调需将行为倾向纳入LLM系统安全评估。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地参与与其他LLM及人类的群体决策，它们在群体中的影响力来源尚不明确——究竟是由说服性表达驱动还是由顺从性适应驱动。澄清这一问题有助于理解LLM在社会互动中的行为模式及其安全影响。
AI.method: 提出DecisionQE（基于问卷的框架），用于在多种决策场景中分别测量每个模型的说服倾向与顺从倾向；使用狼人杀游戏作为交互式测试平台，在不完全信息条件下研究这些行为倾向对社会影响和群体结果的作用。通过跨实验对比说服倾向与顺从倾向模型的表现差异来验证假设。
AI.result: 1）更强的说服倾向并不能显著改善群体结果；2）顺从倾向模型在合作方面展现更稳定的优势；3）发现顺从性的双重效应：在诚实角色中支持合作，但在对抗性角色中提升伪装成功率。
AI.conclusion: LLM群体交互不仅反映任务表现，还揭示可测量的内在行为倾向模式。LLM可以作为一种语言中介社会互动的社会学观察工具，同时应将行为倾向纳入LLM系统安全评估体系。

title: ZetaGPT: A Reference Implementation of Positional--Encoding--Free State--Space--Attention Language Models
summary: Transformer-based language models rely on self-attention, whose computation is permutation-equivariant and therefore lacks an intrinsic mechanism for representing token order. Existing architectures address this limitation by explicitly incorporating positional information through learned positional embeddings or hand-crafted positional encodings, such as rotary positional encoding (RoPE), treating positional information as an architecturally acquired capability rather than an inherent property of the model. Motivated by the pursuit of positional-encoding-free architectures, this work explores a language model architecture that integrates causal state-space equations to implicitly encode positional information before attention computation. Specifically, each model block applies a causal state-space equation before self-attention, allowing recurrent state dynamics to encode sequential information into token representations. Consequently, subsequent attention layers operate on position-aware representations without requiring explicit positional encodings while retaining the expressive modeling capacity of self-attention. We present \textsc{ZetaGPT}, a compact hybrid language model designed for research, rapid prototyping, algorithm verification, and educational applications. In addition to the proposed architecture, \textsc{ZetaGPT} provides a fully open-source, end-to-end training pipeline encompassing dataset construction, tokenizer training, pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning via pure reinforcement learning. To the best of our knowledge, \textsc{ZetaGPT} is the first open-source small language model without explicit positional encoding and establishes a compact, reproducible reference implementation for the development and empirical study of positional-encoding-free language models.

AI.tldr: ZetaGPT 是一个紧凑的开源混合语言模型，通过在每个模型块中引入因果状态空间方程来隐式编码位置信息，从而在无需显式位置编码（如RoPE或learned embeddings）的情况下保留自注意力表达能力，并提供了完整开源的端到端训练流水线。
AI.motivation: Transformer语言模型依赖的自注意力是排列等变的，缺乏内在的token顺序表示机制。现有方法通过显式位置编码（如RoPE或学习的位置嵌入）作为架构层面后天获取的能力来补充这一缺陷。作者希望探索无需显式位置编码的架构，让位置信息成为模型的固有属性。
AI.method: 核心架构思想是"位置编码免费"的混合语言模型：每个模型块在自注意力计算之前，先应用一个因果状态空间方程（causal state-space equation），通过循环状态动力学将序列顺序信息隐式编码到token表示中。之后的注意力层在位置感知的表示上操作，无需显式位置编码，同时保留自注意力的表达能力。此外，ZetaGPT提供完整开源训练流水线，涵盖数据集构建、tokenizer训练、预训练、SFT、RLHF和纯强化学习的CoT推理。
AI.result: ZetaGPT据作者所知是第一个无显式位置编码的开源小型语言模型，建立了紧凑可复现的参考实现，用于位置编码无关语言模型的开发与实证研究。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了通过因果状态空间方程在注意力之前隐式编码位置信息的可行性，为无显式位置编码的语言模型架构提供了开源参考实现，适合研究、快速原型开发、算法验证和教育用途。

title: VTO: Visual Tool Orchestration for Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a critical yet challenging task due to the complex and diverse nature of real-world scenarios. Traditional deep learning approaches are fundamentally limited by poor generalization across diverse scenarios. While multimodal agents offer a promising tool-learning paradigm for VAD, current systems relying on supervised fine-tuning struggle with complex orchestration, and standard reinforcement learning often causes premature termination due to coarse-grained outcome rewards. To address these challenges, we propose VTO, a process-supervised reinforcement learning framework. Moving beyond static tool usage, VTO enables the agent to dynamically explore and interact with the environment. Specifically, we introduce a foundation model-driven cognitive evaluator to provide context-aware semantic feedback, which is seamlessly integrated into a Process-Supervised Cognitive Alignment that delivers fine-grained, step-wise supervision. By explicitly penalizing logical truncation and rewarding complete causal chains, the agent optimizes its multi-step reasoning policy for interrelated tool orchestration. To support our proposed framework, we meticulously crafted VAD-Tool, a hierarchical visual tool set comprising 12 specialized vision tools spanning from entity tracking to high-stakes hazard detection, and established the corresponding benchmark for rigorous multi-step reasoning evaluation. Extensive experiments on VAD-Tool demonstrate that VTO significantly outperforms baselines, achieving up to a 10.2\% absolute accuracy improvement in tool scheduling. Code and data are available at https://github.com/MICLAB-BUPT/VTO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VTO，一个面向视频异常检测（VAD）的流程监督强化学习框架。VTO通过基础模型驱动的认知评估器提供上下文语义反馈，并结合流程监督认知对齐实现细粒度的逐步监督，使智能体能够动态探索环境、优化多步推理策略以进行工具编排。作者构建了VAD-Tool层次化视觉工具集（12个专业视觉工具）及对应基准，实验显示VTO在工具调度上相比基线取得最高10.2%的绝对准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 视频异常检测因真实场景的复杂多样而极具挑战性。传统深度学习方法泛化能力差；基于多模态智能体的方法虽然提供了工具学习范式，但依赖监督微调的系统难以处理复杂编排，而标准强化学习因粗粒度结果奖励导致过早终止，缺乏对中间推理过程的细致指导。
AI.method: VTO框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 基础模型驱动的认知评估器，提供上下文感知的语义反馈；(2) 流程监督认知对齐机制，提供细粒度的逐步监督，显式惩罚逻辑截断并奖励完整因果链；(3) 层次化视觉工具集VAD-Tool，涵盖从实体追踪到高危险检测的12个专业视觉工具。智能体通过过程监督信号优化多步推理策略，实现动态环境探索与工具编排。
AI.result: 在VAD-Tool基准上的大量实验表明，VTO显著优于各基线方法，在工具调度任务上实现了最高10.2%的绝对准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: VTO通过流程监督强化学习与认知评估器的结合，有效解决了视频异常检测中多工具编排的推理监督问题，验证了细粒度过程监督相对于传统粗粒度奖励在复杂工具编排任务中的优势。代码和数据已开源。

title: Illusion of Alignment: Detecting Hidden Disagreement in Collaborative Dialogue
summary: Collaborative dialogue can end with apparent agreement while participants still differ on goals, assumptions, or execution plans, creating an \textbf{illusion of alignment (IoA)}. A real-user study across 18 meetings confirms that IoA arises routinely in human collaboration. Yet IoA poses a paradox: if participants were aware of such disagreements, they would already be explicit; if not, they cannot articulate them when asked, leaving IoA invisible to both participants and observers. In this work, we make IoA detectable by generating diagnostic multiple-choice questions whose divergent answers across participants provide direct behavioral evidence of hidden disagreement. We construct \textbf{IoA-Suite}, a dataset and evaluation protocol for detecting hidden disagreement, spanning five task types and six domains. We find that even the best model attains only 49.5\% F1, with the bottleneck traced to private context that the dialogue does not surface. We then train \textbf{IoA-Prober-8B} based on IoA-Suite, reaching 51.8\% F1 on IoA-Suite. Across the aforementioned 18 real meetings, it surfaces 2.89 hidden disagreements per meeting that participants confirm they had not voiced, transferring to live human dialogue. Further, in multi-agent collaboration, pairing IoA-Prober-8B with LLM agents improves downstream task performance on BigCodeBench-Hard and HiddenBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"对齐幻象（IoA）"问题——协作对话中参与者表面达成一致但实际在目标、假设或执行计划上仍存在分歧。作者构建了IoA-Suite数据集和评估协议，通过生成诊断性多项选择题来检测隐藏分歧，并训练了IoA-Prober-8B模型，在18个真实会议中平均每场发现2.89个未被言明的隐藏分歧，且在多智能体协作中能提升下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 协作对话常以表面一致结束，但参与者之间可能仍存在目标、假设或执行计划上的分歧，形成"对齐幻象"。IoA存在悖论：若参与者意识到分歧则早已明说，若未意识到则无法在被问及时表述，导致IoA对参与者和观察者都不可见，难以直接检测。
AI.method: 构造IoA-Suite数据集与评估协议，覆盖5种任务类型和6个领域；通过生成诊断性多项选择题，利用参与者答案的分歧作为隐藏不一致的行为证据；基于IoA-Suite训练IoA-Prober-8B模型；在真实会议和多智能体协作场景中验证。
AI.result: 最佳模型在IoA-Suite上仅达到49.5% F1，瓶颈在于对话未呈现的私有上下文；IoA-Prober-8B达到51.8% F1；在18个真实会议中每场发现2.89个参与者确认未言明的隐藏分歧；与LLM智能体配对后在BigCodeBench-Hard和HiddenBench上提升了下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: IoA可以通过诊断性问答的行为证据实现可检测性，但受限于对话中未呈现的私有上下文。IoA-Prober-8B证明该方法能有效迁移到真实人与AI协作场景，并在多智能体协作中带来切实的下游性能提升，为检测和缓解人类协作中的隐性分歧提供了可行路径。

title: Learning Preference Adaptation for Large Language Model Personalization via Verbal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Natural language user preferences provide an interpretable interface for LLM personalization. However, universal preference summaries often contain information irrelevant to a particular downstream task. Directly supplying the full preference summary therefore wastes context capacity and introduces cross-task distraction, while manually designing task-specific preference views is difficult to scale. In this work, we study \emph{task-specific preference adaptation}: given a universal user preference summary and a downstream task, derive a task-conditioned representation that preserves sufficient decision-relevant evidence while removing redundant context. To this end, we propose \textsc{AlignXada}, a training-free meta-learning framework that induces reusable textual refinement policies for adapting universal preference summaries to task-specific ones. The refinement policy is iteratively optimized by a meta learner through verbal reinforcement learning. Across 13 tasks and three downstream models (39 task--model cells), \textsc{AlignXada} achieves an average gain of 3.82 points, improving 33 cells while retaining only 22.8\% of the original profile tokens and outperforming RAG in 36 cells. An extended faithfulness analysis further shows that the refined profiles remain largely grounded in the source preferences while preserving task-relevant personalization signals, suggesting that profile-side adaptation serves as a practical complement to universal memory construction for lifelong personalized agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AlignXada，一种无训练的元学习框架，通过语言强化学习迭代优化文本精炼策略，将通用用户偏好摘要自适应地转化为任务特定偏好表示。在13个任务和3个下游模型（39个任务-模型单元）上平均提升3.82分，改善33个单元且仅保留原始配置文件的22.8%token，在36个单元上优于RAG。
AI.motivation: 通用偏好摘要包含与特定下游任务无关的信息，直接使用完整摘要浪费上下文容量并引入跨任务干扰，而手动设计任务特定偏好视图难以规模化。因此需要一种自动方法从通用偏好中提取任务相关的决策证据。
AI.method: 提出AlignXada，一种training-free的元学习框架。它通过元学习器以语言强化学习（verbal reinforcement learning）迭代优化可复用的文本精炼策略，将通用用户偏好摘要适配为任务特定的偏好摘要。
AI.result: 在13个任务和3个下游模型构成的39个任务-模型单元中，AlignXada平均提升3.82分，改善33个单元，仅保留原始配置文件的22.8%token，并在36个单元上优于RAG基线。忠实性分析表明精炼后的配置基本保持源偏好依据，同时保留任务相关个性化信号。
AI.conclusion: 配置文件侧的自适应是通用记忆构建在终身个性化智能体中的实用补充方案，兼顾效率与个性化效果。

title: Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System
summary: We present Ego-OSCAR, an open-hardware, low-cost, head-mounted stereo-inertial capture device for egocentric data collection in the wild. EgoOSCAR pairs a hardware-synchronized global-shutter stereo camera with a 6- axis IMU, an embedded Linux SBC for on-device video encoding, and a realtime microcontroller for user feedback and watchdog functions. The complete bill of materials is under USD 200 per unit, using only commercially available components and 3D-printed parts. Alongside the device, we release a complete software stack (hardware-accelerated recording pipeline, IMU sampling daemon, time-synchronization tooling, and watchdog firmware) and roughly 550 hours of egocentric stereo video per camera with synchronized IMU, collected by a distributed contributor network across everyday indoor environments. The release is annotated rather than raw: free-form action captions cover essentially the entire recorded timeline with an open vocabulary, and per-frame 3D hand reconstructions ship alongside per-session stereo calibration. Ego-OSCAR does not aim to match the per-unit fidelity of research-grade systems such as Project Aria; it aims to be the cheapest defensible substrate for crowdsourced egocentric capture, and to lower the activation energy for any team that wants to collect egocentric data at scale. All hardware designs, software, and the dataset are open-sourced

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Ego-OSCAR，一个开源、低成本（低于200美元）、头戴式双目惯性捕捉设备，用于野外自我中心数据采集。该设备将硬件同步的全局快门立体相机与6轴IMU、嵌入式Linux板载视频编码及实时微控制器相结合，并配套完整软件栈和约550小时带同步IMU的自中心立体视频数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有自我中心数据采集系统（如Project Aria）虽精度高但成本昂贵、不够开放，难以支持大规模众包式数据采集。作者旨在提供一个价格低廉、可辩护（defensible）的数据采集基板，降低任何团队大规模采集自我中心数据的准入门槛（activation energy）。
AI.method: Ego-OSCAR由硬件与软件两部分组成：硬件上采用硬件同步的全局快门双目相机与6轴IMU，经嵌入式Linux SBC进行设备端视频编码，并配置实时微控制器负责用户反馈与看门狗功能，总物料成本低于200美元/台，仅使用商用组件和3D打印件。软件方面提供硬件加速录制管线、IMU采样守护进程、时间同步工具和看门狗固件。数据集方面由分布式贡献者网络在室内日常环境中采集了每相机约550小时的自我中心立体视频及同步IMU数据，并以开放词表标注了几乎整个时间线的自由形式动作描述，同时提供逐帧3D手部重建和逐会话立体标定。
AI.result: 成功构建了低成本、开源的自我中心数据采集设备及完整配套数据生态。设备在保持低门槛的同时产生了大规模带同步IMU的立体视频数据集（每相机约550小时），并提供了开放词表的动作标注和3D手部重建等增值标注。全部硬件设计、软件和数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: Ego-OSCAR的目标不是匹敌Aria等科研级系统的单单元保真度，而是成为最廉价且可辩护的众包自我中心数据采集基板。通过开放硬件、软件和数据集，该工作显著降低了任何团队以规模化方式采集自我中心数据的门槛。

title: Harmful Content Is Not Enough: Continuation Framing Moderates In-Context Emergent Misalignment
summary: In-context learning (ICL) can induce emergent misalignment (EM), where narrow misaligned examples alter answers to unrelated questions. Existing prompts, however, conflate harmful-text exposure with an invitation to continue assistant behavior. We hold harmful answers fixed while varying their delivery as demonstrations, evidence, assistant history, or tool output. Across ten independently sampled contexts, demonstration framing raises broad EM by $30$--$32$ percentage points on a susceptible Gemini model; the gap survives domain exclusion, semantic clustering, unseen questions, and four prompt templates. Format and length-matched controls show that harmful content is necessary but insufficient. A role times continuation factorial further reveals model-dependent provenance effects: Gemini follows both assistant and tool histories, whereas Grok largely resists tool-framed continuation. Several other frontier and open-weight models show no gap. Blinded human audits confirm every main contrast and show that the model judge underestimates active-condition failures. Thus continuation framing is a strong, model-dependent moderator of ICL-EM, not a universal consequence of harmful context.

AI.tldr: 本研究揭示了上下文学习中涌现性错位（EM）的一个关键调节因素：有害内容以何种"框架"呈现（示范、证据、助手历史或工具输出）会显著影响模型的错位程度。在易受影响的Gemini模型上，示范框架比证据框架的EM高出30-32个百分点，且这种差异在域排除、语义聚类、未见过的问题和多种提示模板中稳健存在。格式和长度匹配的对照表明有害内容是必要的但非充分的。通过角色×延续的阶乘设计，发现模型依赖的来源效应：Gemini同时跟随助手和工具历史，而Grok则抵抗工具框架的延续。盲人人类审计确认了所有主要对比。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文学习中的涌现性错位研究将有害文本的暴露与"邀请继续助手行为"混为一谈，缺乏对有害内容呈现方式如何影响错位程度的系统研究。理解这一区别对于安全评估和模型行为预测至关重要。
AI.method: 固定有害答案不变，仅改变其传递框架（示范、证据、助手历史、工具输出）。在十组独立采样上下文中评估Gemini模型，并进行格式与长度匹配的对照实验以分离内容与框架效应；采用角色×延续的因子设计探究模型间的来源效应；最后使用盲人人类审计验证自动评估的可靠性。
AI.result: 示范框架使易感Gemini模型的EM提高30-32个百分点；有害内容必要但非充分（格式和长度匹配的对照显示没有有害内容则无EM）。Gemini同时跟随助手和工具历史，Grok抵抗工具框架的延续；多个前沿模型和开放权重模型未显示差异。盲人人类审计确认了所有主要对比，并显示模型评判者低估了主动条件下的失败。
AI.conclusion: 延续框架是ICL-EM的强有力且依赖模型的调节因素，而非有害上下文导致的普遍后果。这意味着安全评估需要考虑内容呈现方式，不同模型的错位敏感性具有框架特异性。

title: Build it, Break it, Repeat: Benchmarking and improving LLM-manipulated disinformation detection in social media posts
summary: Detecting machine-generated disinformation on social media is increasingly difficult as large language models (LLMs) make it easier to generate and rewrite misleading content at scale. Static benchmark evaluations, measuring detector performance on fixed held-out datasets, do not capture how detectors behave when posts are deliberately transformed to evade classification. This paper adapts the Build it, Break it, Fix it framework into Build it, Break it, Repeat (BiBiR): iterative sessions designed to stress-test detectors' robustness under iterative adversarial conditions, evaluating whether models remain reliable when disinformation posts are systematically transformed to evade classification. Across five iterations, the findings show that the best adversarial breakers' transformations came from a combination of back-translation and LLM persona-based rewriting, with the best performing technique achieving a 95% label flip rate (LFR), whilst still preserving the meaning of the original posts. The best builders' model was a triplet contrastive model with a dynamic anchor switching (DASS) architecture, which achieved an average accuracy of 72.68%, outperforming the strong baseline (a fine-tuned e5-small-LoRA) by 15 percentage points on the most robust set of breakers' adversarial attacks. The results demonstrate that an iterative framework best exposes detector weaknesses and pushes robustness improvements; however, it may still require semantic preservation analysis to distinguish valid adversarial evasion from transformations that changed the original disinformation claims' meaning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiBiR（Build it, Break it, Repeat）迭代框架，用于压力测试社交媒体上机器生成虚假信息检测器的鲁棒性。在五轮迭代中，最好的攻击手段（反向翻译结合LLM角色重写）实现了95%的标签翻转率且保持语义不变；最好的防御模型（三元组对比学习+DASS架构）平均准确率达72.68%，比强基线高出15个百分点。结果表明迭代框架能有效暴露检测器弱点并推动鲁棒性改进，但仍需语义保持分析来区分有效对抗逃避与改变原意的变换。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型使得生成和改写误导性内容变得更容易，检测社交媒体上机器生成的虚假信息愈发困难。静态基准评估无法捕捉检测器在帖子被故意变换以逃避分类时的行为，因此需要一种迭代的对抗性评估框架来压力测试检测器的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将Build it, Break it, Fix it框架改编为Build it, Break it, Repeat (BiBiR)，通过五轮迭代会话进行对抗性压力测试。攻击方采用反向翻译与LLM基于人物角色重写相结合的方式生成变换帖子；防御方采用三元组对比学习模型配合动态锚点切换（DASS）架构来构建检测器。
AI.result: 最佳攻击技术达到95%的标签翻转率（LFR）且保持原始帖子的语义；最佳防御模型（三元组对比+DASS）平均准确率72.68%，在最具鲁棒性的攻击集上比强基线（微调e5-small-LoRA）高出15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 迭代框架最能暴露检测器弱点和推动鲁棒性改进，但该框架可能仍需引入语义保持分析，以区分有效的对抗性逃避和那些改变了原始虚假信息主张含义的变换。

title: What Irregularity Costs: CUDA C++, Rust, and Triton on a Hash-Blocked GPU Workload
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Includes a correctness result for TSDF fusion implementations: at hash load factors reached by ordinary depth trajectories, the Triton implementation silently discards blocks. Code, raw measurement CSVs and an interactive viewer: https://github.com/realitymatrix/what-irregularity-costs
summary:
GPU language comparisons are almost always run on tiled dense linear algebra, where every toolchain is good and the differences are small. We implement the same hash-blocked TSDF fusion kernel in CUDA C++, in Rust through NVIDIA's cuda-oxide, and in Triton, and measure it on a workload with the opposite character: an open-addressed hash table with compare-exchange insertion, data-dependent per-lane probe depth, and contended scatter.
  The result is a split. On the regular stage, which walks a truncation band and accumulates, all three languages land within a small factor of each other. On the irregular stage, which probes and inserts, Rust stays close to hand-written CUDA C++ while Triton is more than an order of magnitude slower. Language choice is nearly free on the work that is usually benchmarked and expensive on the work that is not.
  We attribute both gaps to specific things the languages cannot express, not to ratios. Triton's cost follows from a probe loop that must run to a compile-time bound and from tl.atomic_cas taking no mask, which forces a scratch structure with no counterpart in CUDA. Rust's cost was invisible in every instruction count: its kernel issues fewer instructions, fewer compare-exchanges and fewer registers at identical occupancy, yet was slower. Hardware counters located it in L1 residency. A GPU-scope atomic load must be coherent across SMs, no NVIDIA L1 is, so the type-correct way to read a shared location bypasses the cache on every access.
  Triton's bounded probe is also a correctness problem for fusion: at load factors an ordinary depth trajectory reaches, it silently discards blocks and the reconstruction loses patches of surface with nothing reported. We also report a defect found and fixed in cuda-oxide itself, now merged upstream: its scoped atomic load and store could not be called at all in the build mode that produces real kernels.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了同样一个哈希分块的TSDF融合内核在CUDA C++、Rust（通过cuda-oxide）和Triton三种语言中的实现性能。在规则的截断带累积阶段，三种语言性能相近；在非规则的开地址哈希表探测与插入阶段，Rust接近手写CUDA C++，而Triton慢了一个数量级以上。性能差距源于各语言无法表达特定操作，而非指令比率问题：Triton因编译期定界探测循环和tl.atomic_cas缺少mask参数而被迫使用CUDA中不存在的scratch结构；Rust虽然发出更少的指令、更少的compare-exchange和寄存器却更慢，硬件计数器定位到L1驻留问题——GPU作用域原子负载需要在SM间一致，导致每次访问绕过缓存。此外，Triton的有界探测在正常负载因子下会静默丢弃块，导致重建丢失表面碎片且无报告。
AI.motivation: GPU语言的基准测试几乎都集中在平铺稠密线性代数上，这类工作量下所有工具链都表现良好且差异很小。作者希望在一个具有相反特征的负载上比较语言——即非规则工作负载（开放寻址哈希表、依赖数据的逐通道探测深度、争用散射），以揭示在常规基准中掩盖的语言表达能力差异。
AI.method: 在相同硬件上，分别用CUDA C++、Rust（通过NVIDIA的cuda-oxide）和Triton实现相同的哈希分块TSDF融合内核。该内核包含两个阶段：规则阶段（截断带行走与累积）和不规则阶段（哈希探测与插入）。通过性能测量、指令计数、寄存器占用、L1缓存驻留等硬件计数器进行对比分析。
AI.result: 规则阶段三种语言性能相近；不规则阶段Rust接近手写CUDA C++，Triton慢一个数量级以上。Triton的瓶颈源于编译期定界探测循环和tl.atomic_cas缺少mask参数；Rust虽然指令数更少、占用量更低却因GPU作用域原子负载绕过L1缓存而变慢。此外发现并修复了cuda-oxide中scoped atomic load/store在真实内核构建模式下无法调用的问题。
AI.conclusion: 语言选择在通常被基准测试的工作负载上几乎免费，但在不被基准测试的工作负载上代价高昂。性能差异不是比例关系而是由语言无法表达特定操作导致的根本性差距。同时指出了Triton有界探测在正常负载下会导致静默数据丢失的正确性问题。

title: Metanormative Theory for RL-Based Moral Agents
comment: The 14th International Workshop on Engineering Multi-Agent Systems (EMAS 2026) held May 25-26, 2026 Co-located with AAMAS 2026 Paphos, Cyprus
summary: The overlapping disciplines of machine ethics and value alignment are concerned with designing artificial agents that are aligned with human values and that act in ethically acceptable ways. A recent trend in these disciplines is the use of reinforcement learning (RL) to design such agents, sidelining the philosophical literature that used to play a more central role. Against this backdrop, this paper pursues two goals. The first is to draw out ideas from recent work in metanormative theory that can be useful for designing artificial moral and value-aligned agents. The second is to examine the RL architecture through the lens of these ideas. This will give us clearer criteria for when an RL agent's behavior can be classified as moral, as well as a basis for evaluating and comparing different RL-based approaches to machine ethics and value alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了机器学习伦理与价值对齐领域，指出近期趋势是使用强化学习（RL）设计道德智能体，而忽视了哲学文献的作用。论文提出两个目标：一是从元规范性理论（metanormative theory）中提炼对设计道德和价值对齐智能体有用的思想；二是用这些思想审视RL架构，从而为判断RL智能体行为何时可被视为道德提供更清晰的标准，并为评估和比较不同的基于RL的机器伦理与价值对齐方法提供基础。
AI.motivation: 近年来机器伦理和价值对齐领域越来越依赖强化学习来设计道德智能体，但哲学文献的核心作用被边缘化。作者希望通过重新引入元规范性理论的思想，弥补这一缺失，并为RL为基础的道德智能体设计提供更坚实的理论基础和更具判别力的评估标准。
AI.method: 本文采用概念分析的方法：首先从近期的元规范性理论研究中提取对设计人工道德与价值对齐智能体有用的思想；然后将这些思想作为分析框架，审视强化学习架构，考察其能否以及如何满足道德行为的判断标准。
AI.result: 论文提出了更为清晰的标准，用于判断RL智能体的行为何时可以被归类为道德行为，同时建立了一个基础框架，用于评估和比较不同的基于RL的机器伦理与价值对齐研究方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将元规范性理论的核心见解与RL架构结合起来，论文为机器伦理和价值对齐提供了一条融合哲学与工程实践的路径，使这一领域能够在更坚实的理论基础上持续发展。

title: TCS-BENCH: Benchmarking State-of-the-Art Generative AI Theoretical Computer Science Research Ability
summary: We introduce TCS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on research-level Theoretical Computer Science (TCS) proof generation. TCS-Bench consists of theorem-proving tasks from papers published at top theoretical computer science venues (STOC, FOCS, and SODA). Each task provides the necessary context to derive a self-contained proof for a target result. We evaluate state-of-the-art models on this benchmark. We verify the correctness of generated proofs via a verification agent, and further benchmark the verifier against human-expert proof judgements on a set of target statements and generated proofs pairs. Our reference verifier achieves over 90% accuracy on the expert labeled set.

AI.tldr: TCS-Bench是一个用于评估大语言模型在科研级理论计算机科学（TCS）定理证明生成能力上的基准。该基准包含来自STOC、FOCS和SODA顶级会议论文中的定理证明任务，每个任务提供自包含证明所需的完整上下文。作者通过验证代理（verification agent）检查生成证明的正确性，并对照人类专家评判进行评估，参考验证器在专家标注集上达到90%以上准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估基准主要面向编程或一般数学推理，缺乏对科研级理论计算机科学定理证明能力的系统性评估。TCS定理证明需要深度逻辑推理和领域知识，是衡量LLM高级推理能力的重要测试场景，但目前缺少这样一个专业基准。
AI.method: 从STOC、FOCS、SODA三大顶级理论计算机科学会议论文中提取定理证明任务，为每个目标结果提供推导自包含证明所需的必要上下文。使用一个验证代理（verification agent）对模型生成的证明进行正确性验证，并将该验证器与人类专家对目标陈述及生成证明对的评判进行对照基准测试。
AI.result: 参考验证器在专家标注数据集上达到超过90%的准确率，表明该自动化验证机制具有较高的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: TCS-Bench为评估LLM在科研级TCS定理证明中的能力提供了一个经过验证的基准框架，其验证器的高准确率保证了评估结果的可信度。

title: Test-Time Prototype Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) repurposes a pretrained CLIP encoder for dense prediction without additional labeled supervision. Existing methods improve CLIP's spatial behavior either by redesigning its internal attention or by injecting features from auxiliary vision foundation models; both require access to the host's internal computation and are tailored to its specific forward pass. In this work, we propose Test-time Prototype Adaptation (TPA), a training-free plug-in that operates at the output level, leaving the host's forward pass and weights unmodified. By leveraging a lightweight transductive adaptation phase, TPA identifies confident anchor patches from the host's own output predictions on a small pool of unlabeled deployment-domain images, and aggregates their frozen DINO features into per-class prototypes; at inference, a single cosine similarity lookup against this frozen bank provides an auxiliary score fused linearly with the host's logits. TPA composes with five representative OVSS hosts spanning attention-redesign and VFM-injection designs, across three CLIP backbones, eight benchmarks, and multiple internal VFM choices. Under a single set of hyper-parameters and without per-host tuning or parameter updates, TPA consistently improves segmentation accuracy, with as few as approximately 10% of unlabeled deployment-domain images sufficing for effective bank construction on most benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TPA（Test-time Prototype Adaptation），一种训练无关的即插即用模块，在输出层为开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）提供辅助评分。TPA从少量无标注部署域图像中利用宿主模型自身的预测识别置信锚点，聚合其冻结的DINO特征构建每类原型；推理时通过余弦相似度查找生成辅助分数，与宿主逻辑线性融合，无需修改宿主前向传播或权重。TPA在五种代表性OVSS宿主、三个CLIP骨干、八个基准上一致提升分割精度，且仅需约10%的无标注部署域图像即可构建有效原型库。
AI.motivation: 现有OVSS方法要么通过重新设计CLIP的内部注意力，要么通过注入辅助视觉基础模型（VFM）的特征来改善空间行为，但这些方法都需要访问宿主模型的内部计算并针对其特定前向传播定制，缺乏通用性。本文旨在提出一种不依赖宿主内部结构的通用方法。
AI.method: TPA包括两个阶段：(1) 测试时原型适应：在少量无标注部署域图像上，利用宿主模型自身的输出预测识别高置信度锚点patches，聚合其冻结的DINO特征构建每类原型；(2) 推理阶段：对目标patches的DINO特征与原型库做余弦相似度查找，得到辅助评分并与宿主的logits线性融合。
AI.result: TPA在与五种OVSS宿主（覆盖注意力重设计和VFM注入两类设计）、三个CLIP骨干、八个基准、多种内部VFM选择的组合下，使用统一超参数且无逐宿主调参或参数更新，一致提升分割精度。在多数基准上仅需约10%的无标注部署域图像即可有效构建原型库。
AI.conclusion: TPA证明了仅通过输出级别的侧面适配，无需访问宿主内部计算或修改其前向传播，即可有效提升OVSS的性能。这种训练无关、即插即用的特性使其具备广泛的兼容性和实用性。

title: LatticeMind: A Conflict-Aware Memory Primitive for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems often fail not for lack of candidate answers, but because they have no persistent mechanism for deciding which incompatible claim should currently be trusted. Majority vote, debate, and judge-based selection choose an output without recording which claim wins, which is contested, or why a later update supersedes it. We present \term{LatticeMind}, a conflict-aware structured memory that handles contradiction at write time. It maintains explicit item status, applies cheap symbolic conflict checks, and invokes LLM reconciliation only for unresolved semantic cases. On a label-blind ConflictBank evaluation that removes source-name hints, LatticeMind reaches 0.97 accuracy versus 0.61 for the strongest aggregation baseline, with the gap significant at $p<10^{-6}$ by paired McNemar test. Ablations show that removing the checker or the reconciler costs 12 to 14 points. On four secondary planning benchmarks the picture is mixed: LatticeMind beats naive merge on three of four, but does not replace deliberation methods on tasks rewarding iterative search.

AI.tldr: LatticeMind是一种冲突感知的结构化记忆系统，在写入时处理多智能体LLM系统中的矛盾信息。它通过显式项目状态、廉价符号冲突检查和仅对未解决的语义案例调用LLM调和。在去除源名称提示的ConflictBank评估中，LatticeMind达到0.97准确率（最强聚合基线仅0.61），差异显著（p<10^-6）。移除检查器或调和器各损失12-14分。在四个次要规划基准上表现不一：在三个上优于朴素合并，但无法取代适合迭代搜索任务的人工审议方法。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统失败的原因通常不是缺乏候选答案，而是缺乏持久的机制来决定当前应信任哪个不兼容的主张。多数投票、辩论和基于评审的选择只输出结果，不记录哪个主张获胜、哪个存在争议，或为什么后续更新取代了之前的结论。现有方法缺乏在写入时处理矛盾的冲突感知机制。
AI.method: LatticeMind采用冲突感知的结构化记忆，在写入时处理矛盾。具体包括：维护显式项目状态、应用廉价的符号冲突检查，并且仅对未解决的语义歧义案例调用LLM进行调和。通过这种分层策略，避免了在所有冲突上无差别地使用昂贵LLM推理。
AI.result: 在去除源名称提示的ConflictBank评估中，LatticeMind达到0.97准确率，而最强聚合基线仅0.61，差异在配对McNemar检验下显著（p<10^-6）。消融实验表明，移除冲突检查器或调和器分别造成12到14分的性能损失。在四个次要规划基准上，LatticeMind在三个基准上优于朴素合并，但在奖励迭代搜索的任务上无法取代审议式方法。
AI.conclusion: LatticeMind证明了在写入时处理冲突而非在读取时聚合，是实现多智能体系统可靠决策的关键。符号检查与LLM调和的分层方法在效率与效果间取得了良好平衡。然而，在需要迭代搜索的规划任务中，冲突感知记忆不能完全替代审议式推理，表明两类方法具有互补性。

title: Mawqif-v2: An Arabic Benchmark Dataset for Cross-Target Stance Detection
summary: Publicly available Arabic datasets for target-specific stance detection remain limited, particularly for evaluating cross-target generalization. This paper presents the Mawqif-v2 Extension, consisting of 996 manually annotated Arabic tweets collected from three public targets: Women Driving, E-Cars, and Trimester System. Each tweet is annotated with stance, sentiment, and sarcasm labels following the original Mawqif annotation scheme. The released extension is intended as a held-out evaluation set for assessing model generalization to both semantically related and previously unseen targets, while the original Mawqif dataset is used for training and development. In addition, we establish baseline results using several Arabic and multilingual transformer models, as well as zero-shot large language models (LLMs), to facilitate reproducible evaluation. Together with the original Mawqif dataset, the Mawqif-v2 Extension provides a benchmark for evaluating cross-target generalization in Arabic stance detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mawqif-v2 Extension，一个包含996条人工标注阿拉伯语推文的跨目标立场检测扩展数据集，涵盖三个公共目标（女性驾车、电动汽车、学期制），每条推文标注立场、情感和讽刺标签。该扩展作为留出测试集评估模型对语义相关和未见目标的泛化能力，并提供了阿拉伯语/多语言Transformer模型及零样本大语言模型的基线结果。
AI.motivation: 公开可用的阿拉伯语目标特定立场检测数据集有限，尤其是缺乏评估跨目标泛化能力的数据资源，阻碍了该领域的研究进展。
AI.method: 收集996条人工标注的阿拉伯语推文，覆盖三个公共目标，遵循原始Mawqif标注方案进行立场、情感和讽刺标注；将原始Mawqif数据集用于训练和开发，新扩展作为留出测试集；使用多种阿拉伯语和多语言Transformer模型以及零样本LLMs建立基线。
AI.result: 建立了多个阿拉伯语和多语言Transformer模型以及零样本大语言模型的基线结果，为跨目标泛化评估提供了可复现的基准。
AI.conclusion: Mawqif-v2 Extension与原始Mawqif数据集共同构成了评估阿拉伯语立场检测跨目标泛化能力的基准资源，有助于推动该领域的发展。

title: Frequency-Domain Dual-Branch Fusion for Medical Visual Question Answering
comment: 7 Pages, 4 figures, under review at AAAI 27
summary: Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires aligning subtle visual evidence, including lesion texture, boundary sharpness, and diffuse density changes, with clinical language. Existing multimodal fusion approaches operating in the spatial domain may not fully exploit complementary frequency information present in visual and textual representations. We introduce a dual-branch frequency-domain fusion module that conditions spectral filtering on the input question, enabling adaptive selection of global low-frequency structure and fine-grained high-frequency detail before reconstructing the spatial representation for answer generation. To provide a richer spectrum for filtering, we extract complementary features from early texture-sensitive and final semantic layers of a frozen BiomedCLIP encoder and align both with the question representation using a symmetric InfoNCE objective prior to staged joint training with a BioBART decoder. We pretrain the proposed model on PMC-VQA and fine-tune it on the VQA-RAD and SLAKE benchmarks, demonstrating that frequency-aware multimodal fusion improves medical VQA performance while maintaining a lightweight and efficient architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种双分支频域融合模块的医学视觉问答方法，通过问题条件化的频谱滤波自适应选择低频结构和高频细节，并结合冻结BiomedCLIP的早期纹理特征与最终语义特征，经对称InfoNCE对齐后在BioBART解码器上进行分阶段联合训练，在PMC-VQA预训练、VQA-RAD和SLAKE微调上验证了频域感知融合的有效性与轻量高效性。
AI.motivation: 现有医学VQA的多模态融合方法主要在空间域进行，可能无法充分挖掘视觉与文本表征中互补的频率信息，尤其是病变纹理、边界锐度和弥散密度变化等低频与高频线索。
AI.method: 1) 提出双分支频域融合模块，以输入问题为条件控制频谱滤波，自适应选择全局低频结构和细粒度高频细节后再重构空间表征用于答案生成；2) 从冻结的BiomedCLIP编码器中提取早期纹理敏感层与最终语义层特征以提供更丰富的滤波频谱；3) 使用对称InfoNCE目标将双分支特征与问题表征对齐；4) 采用分阶段联合训练策略，使用BioBART作为解码器。
AI.result: 在PMC-VQA上预训练，在VQA-RAD和SLAKE基准上微调，频域感知的多模态融合提升了医学VQA性能，同时保持轻量且高效的架构。
AI.conclusion: 频率感知的多模态融合能有效提升医学VQA表现，且该方案在保持高效轻量的前提下优于纯空间域融合方法。

title: A Fair Objective for Human-Empowerment-Preserving AI: Desiderata, Design, and Likely Behavioral Consequences
comment: Slightly extended version of paper accepted for Algorithmic Decision Theory 2026
summary: This paper explores the idea of promoting well-being and safety in human-AI interactions by forcing AI agents explicitly to empower humans and to manage the power balance between humans and AI agents in a desirable way. Using a principled, partially axiomatic approach based on desirable properties, we design a parametrizable and decomposable objective function for AI systems that represents an inequality- and risk-averse long-term aggregate of human power. It can take into account models of human bounded rationality and social norms, and crucially, considers a wide variety of possible human goals. We prove how certain desiderata enforce particular functional forms and restrict parameter ranges. We exemplify the consequences of softly maximizing this metric in several paradigmatic situations and describe what instrumental sub-goals it will likely imply.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于公理化方法设计的可参数化、可分解的目标函数，用于AI系统在人类-AI交互中显式地赋予人类权力并管理权力平衡，该函数表示人类权力的不平等厌恶和风险厌恶的长期聚合，并考虑了人类有界理性、社会规范及多样化的可能人类目标。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统在人类生活中的作用日益增强，如何确保AI行为促进人类福祉与安全成为关键问题。现有研究多聚焦于对齐或安全约束，但缺乏对"权力平衡"这一核心维度的系统化、原则性建模。作者希望通过设计一个基于期望性质（desirable properties）的公理化目标函数，来显式地管理和引导AI赋予人类权力，从而促进长期的人类福祉。
AI.method: 采用部分公理化的方法：首先定义一系列关于权力分配与聚合的期望性质（desiderata），通过数学证明展示这些性质如何强制特定函数形式并限制参数范围；随后设计一个可参数化、可分解的目标函数，代表人类权力的不平等厌恶（inequality-averse）与风险厌恶（risk-averse）的长期聚合；该函数可整合人类有界理性模型与社会规范，并能覆盖广泛的可能性人类目标。
AI.result: 证明了特定的期望性质确实会强制目标函数采用某些函数形式并限制参数取值范围；通过在多种典型场景中软最大化该指标，示例性地展示了其后果，并描述了由此产生的可能工具性子目标（instrumental sub-goals）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为AI系统提供了一种原则性的方式来促进人类赋权和维持合理的权力平衡，同时保持可参数化与可分解的灵活性。其在不同范式情境中的行为揭示了该方法可能引出的工具性子目标，为未来AI安全与对齐研究提供了新的视角与工具。

title: ELBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Education-Facing Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in education as tutors, teaching assistants, and content generators. These roles place demands that ordinary question answering does not: a usable education-facing model is supposed to be accurate, safe under sensitive prompts, instructionally useful, and aligned with pedagogical goals at the same time. Existing benchmarks evaluate these requirements largely in isolation, so none assesses education-facing suitability as an integrated profile. We introduce ELBench, the first benchmark to evaluate all four requirements (General Capability, Safety and Trustworthiness, Basic Education, and High-Level Cultivation) on the same models under a common protocol, combining curated public sources with newly synthesized safety and cultivation data. We evaluate nine models, seven frontier general-purpose systems and two education-specialized variants, and report three findings. First, module-level profiles are more informative than a single aggregate: the top six models are statistically indistinguishable on overall score, yet their module leaders differ substantially, and safety is anti-correlated with practical teaching (r = -0.83). Second, the Chinese-developed models lead the safety module, the most discriminative in the suite; this advantage is largest on region-specific normative content and narrows, but does not vanish, on universal-harm content. Third, the two education-specialized models lead neither education module, and on High-Level Cultivation all models share a systematic blind spot: on the structured judgment task they converge on the same non-reference option, favoring pedagogical style over fit to the stated goal, so the module scores uniformly low and does not separate models. This raises, but does not resolve, whether domain post-training keeps pace with frontier systems on education tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ELBench，这是首个在同一协议下从通用能力、安全与可信、基础教育、高阶培养四个维度综合评估大模型教育适用性的基准。通过评估9个模型（7个前沿通用模型和2个教育专用变体），发现模块级画像比单一总分更具区分力，安全性与教学实用性呈显著负相关，教育专用模型在两大教育模块均未领先，且所有模型在高阶培养的结构化判断任务上存在系统性盲区。
AI.motivation: 教育场景对大语言模型提出了不同于普通问答的综合性要求（准确性、安全性、教学效用与教育学目标对齐），但现有基准大多孤立评估这些要求，缺乏对教育适用性进行一体化画像的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建ELBench基准，融合公开数据源与新增的安全和培养类合成数据，在同一协议下评估四个模块（通用能力、安全与可信、基础教育、高阶培养），并对9个模型（7个前沿通用系统+2个教育专用变体）进行模块级与整体比较。
AI.result: 发现三点：1）模块级画像比单一总分更有效——总分前六名统计上无显著差异，但各模块最优模型差异明显，且安全与实用教学呈负相关（r=-0.83）；2）中国开发的模型在最具区分度的安全模块领先，优势在区域规范内容上最大，在通用危害内容上缩小但未消失；3）两个教育专用模型在两大教育模块均未领先，所有模型在高阶培养的结构化判断任务上系统性偏向教学风格而非任务目标，模块分数普遍偏低且无法区分模型。
AI.conclusion: ELBench表明教育场景评估需要模块级画像而非单一总分；同时提示领域后训练在教育任务上是否跟上前沿通用模型的步伐仍是一个未决问题。

title: Open-World Semantic Segmentation with Sensitivity Modeling
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) Satellite Workshops
summary: Modern vision systems must operate in "open-world" settings, where models must recognize known categories and detect unseen or anomalous content. Conventional semantic segmentation models operate under a "closed-world" assumption, often producing overconfident misclassifications on novel content. We address open-world semantic segmentation, the joint task of segmenting known classes while detecting and grouping novel or anomalous content without additional supervision, by extending a dual-decoder baseline with a third, complementary decoder within a unified encoder-decoder design. The first decoder performs closed-set segmentation using Gaussian prototypes for known categories. The second uses contrastive feature learning to isolate unknown regions in embedding space. The third, our key contribution, is a sensitivity decoder that captures fine-grained texture irregularities and activation instabilities indicative of semantic uncertainty, which neither semantic prototypes nor contrastive norms can reliably detect. The three decoders provide genuinely complementary signals: class-level OOD distance in logit space, global feature energy in embedding space, and local activation instability across encoder scales. Experiments on Cityscapes and BDD-Anomaly show that our method improves anomaly segmentation and novel-class discovery while maintaining competitive closed-set accuracy, with gains of +2.4% AUROC and a 2.5 pp. reduction in FPR@95TPR on BDD-Anomaly over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种三解码器统一编解码架构，用于开放世界语义分割（同时分割已知类别并检测/分组未知或异常内容）。在双解码器基线基础上新增第三个"灵敏度解码器"，通过捕获细粒度纹理异常和激活不稳定性来补充类别级OOD距离与全局特征能量的不足。在Cityscapes和BDD-Anomaly上，异常分割AUROC提升+2.4%，FPR@95TPR降低2.5个百分点，同时保持有竞争力的闭集精度。
AI.motivation: 传统语义分割模型基于"封闭世界"假设，面对未见或异常内容时会产生过度自信的错误分类。真实视觉系统需要在开放世界环境中运行，必须同时识别已知类别并检测未知内容，这是一个未完成的挑战。
AI.method: 在统一编解码器设计中，将双解码器基线扩展为三解码器架构：(1) 闭集分割解码器，使用高斯原型对已知类别建模；(2) 对比特征学习解码器，在嵌入空间中将未知区域隔离；(3) 灵敏度解码器（核心贡献），捕获跨编码器尺度的细粒度纹理不规则性和激活不稳定性。三个解码器提供互补信号：逻辑空间的类别级OOD距离、嵌入空间的全局特征能量、以及编码器各层间的局部激活不稳定性。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes和BDD-Anomaly数据集上的实验表明，该方法在异常分割和新类别发现上均有改进，BDD-Anomaly上AUROC提升+2.4%，FPR@95TPR降低2.5个百分点，同时保持有竞争力的闭集分割精度。
AI.conclusion: 三解码器架构提供的互补信号（语义原型、对比特征、灵敏度检测）能够更全面地捕捉开放世界中的语义不确定性，有效弥合了单独使用语义原型或对比范数检测未知内容的局限，为开放世界语义分割提供了可行方案。

title: FemWear: A Specialized Wearable Foundation Model for Women's Health
summary: General wearable foundation models are pretrained across broad sensor streams and populations, but are not designed around women's-health tasks. We introduce FemWear, a specialized wearable foundation model that parameter-efficiently repurposes a pretrained multimodal wearable backbone. FemWear retains the patch projection and Transformer encoder, training 239,236 parameters (1.11% of a 21.54M-parameter encoder) through low-rank residual adapters and causal task-family heads. It learns one shared longitudinal representation for menstrual, symptom, affective, sleep/recovery, autonomic, activity, and pregnancy-related outcomes. We evaluate six cohorts with 63 comparable primary metrics, including 33 from women's-health cohorts, while retaining the 32-task OpenMHC ability-retention benchmark. On a fixed participant split over three seeds, FemWear improved cycle-phase macro-F1 by 8.15% and reduced mean absolute error for cramps, mood symptoms, and sleep problems by 9.32%, 5.80%, and 9.43%, respectively. In a stricter 42-participant nested leave-one-participant-out audit, 24-hour onset, 72-hour onset, and cramps retained positive changes of 2.87%, 6.35%, and 2.19%; phase, mood, and sleep were neutral or negative, and no endpoint had a strictly positive corrected confidence interval. Capacity-matched experiments outperformed a latest-day multilayer perceptron but not shared-GRU or multi-gate mixture-of-experts baselines. Train-only calibration reduced onset expected calibration error by 84.2--88.2% with zero temporal-nesting violations. FemWear enables targeted transfer and coherent probability outputs for women's-health research, but does not establish universal performance dominance or clinical validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FemWear，一个面向女性健康任务的专用可穿戴基础模型。它通过低秩残差适配器与因果任务族头部，仅训练21.54M参数编码器中的0.24M参数（1.11%），将预训练多模态可穿戴骨干参数高效地迁移至月经、症状、情感、睡眠/恢复、自主神经、活动及妊娠相关结局的共享纵向表示学习。在六个队列的63项指标评估中，FemWear提升了周期相位宏F1（+8.15%）并降低了抽筋、情绪、睡眠问题的MAE，但在更严格的42参与者留一交叉验证中改善有限，未在所有端点建立统一优势或临床有效性。
AI.motivation: 通用可穿戴基础模型虽在大规模传感器流与人群中预训练，但未针对女性健康任务设计。作者希望通过参数高效的适配方法，将预训练多模态可穿戴骨干能力迁移至女性健康专用任务，同时保留原有能力。
AI.method: FemWear保留预训练模型的patch投影与Transformer编码器，使用低秩残差适配器（LoRA）训练仅1.11%的参数（239,236个参数），并设计因果任务族头部，学习跨月经、症状、情感、睡眠/恢复、自主神经、活动和妊娠七个维度的共享纵向表示。
AI.result: 在六个队列、63项可比主要指标评估中（含33项来自女性健康队列），FemWear在固定参与者划分下将周期相位宏F1提升8.15%，抽筋、情绪症状、睡眠问题MAE分别降低9.32%、5.80%、9.43%。在42参与者的严格嵌套留一交叉验证中，24小时发作、72小时发作、抽筋保持正改善（2.87%、6.35%、2.19%），但相位、情绪和睡眠为中性或负向，无端点的校正置信区间严格为正。容量匹配实验优于最新日MLP，但未超越共享GRU或多门混合专家基线。仅训练集校准将发作期望校准误差降低84.2-88.2%且零时间嵌套违规。
AI.conclusion: FemWear实现了女性健康研究的定向迁移与连贯概率输出，但未建立普遍的性能优势或临床有效性，仍需更大规模与更严格验证。

title: Pragmatic Attack Surface: Vulnerabilities of Implicit Context in Large Language Models
summary: In the era of large language models (LLMs), attackers often manipulate natural language to elicit unsafe or harmful outputs, creating a new natural language attack surface unique to LLM-based systems, where attacks directly exploit explicit linguistic cues in user prompts to bypass the safety mechanism of LLMs. However, such attacks can often be mitigated by existing safety alignment algorithms. On the other hand, human language is inherently grounded in pragmatics, necessitating typical context to interpret language, e.g., world knowledge, social norms. However, such contexts are often implicit because they are not directly expressed in human language and are not sufficiently leveraged in safety alignment, creating a fundamental mismatch between human language interpretation and safety alignment approaches. In this paper, we demonstrate that this mismatch exposes vulnerabilities in LLMs. We refer to this vulnerability as the pragmatic attack surface, which can be exploited to achieve high attack success rates. The experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms baseline attack methods across various open-source and closed-source models by a substantial margin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语用攻击面"（pragmatic attack surface）概念，指出LLM安全对齐算法主要依赖直接语言线索进行防护，但人类语言本质上是语用驱动的，需要隐性语境（如世界知识、社会规范）来理解。这种语言理解与安全对齐之间的根本性不匹配导致了LLM的新漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞实现高攻击成功率。实验证明该方法在多个开源和闭源模型上显著优于基线攻击方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全攻击主要利用显性语言线索，但此类攻击通常可被现有安全对齐算法缓解。然而，人类语言理解高度依赖隐性的语用上下文（如世界知识、社会规范），这些上下文很少被安全对齐所涵盖，形成了根本性不匹配，恰好为攻击者提供了新的可利用空间。
AI.method: 作者提出"语用攻击面"概念，通过利用人类语言理解所需的隐性语用上下文来构造攻击。攻击方法利用LLM无法从安全对齐中获得完整的语用推理能力这一缺陷，使模型在需要隐性语境解读的情况下产生不安全输出。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的语用攻击方法在多个开源和闭源LLM上的攻击成功率显著优于现有基线攻击方法，验证了语用攻击面的存在及其可利用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了LLM安全对齐与人类语言语用理解之间存在的根本性不匹配，证明了这一不匹配构成新的安全攻击面。研究强调需要在安全对齐中更全面地考虑语用层面的语言理解，以弥合现有防护的盲区。

title: Three Necessary Principles for Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning
comment: Accepted at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026) Workshops
summary: We argue that learning visual representations without labels requires a training signal jointly complete across three non-overlapping objectives: semantic invariance across augmented views, patch-level spatial prediction, and representational non-degeneracy. We formalize these as the observation, prediction, and regularization principles and prove (i) that combining observation and prediction without regularization admits the constant encoder as a global minimizer under negative-free alignment; (ii) that the two objectives are gradient-complementary and structurally non-conflicting at the encoder output; and (iii) that the momentum encoder converges to the same fixed point as the online encoder and provides no collapse guarantee at convergence. Contrastive alignment provides only self-limiting collapse resistance, formalized via an explicit gradient-decay argument. Dropping prediction withholds the spatial training signal by construction; dropping observation forfeits cross-view semantic invariance by construction; at the scale we study, no pair substitutes for the third. Every major self-supervised method is a special case of a single unified energy decomposition. We pair every theoretical claim with a controlled experiment, including a patch-retrieval evaluation for the spatial consequence of prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文论证无标签视觉表征学习需要同时满足三个非重叠目标：跨视图语义不变性（观测）、补丁级空间预测（预测）和表征非退化（正则化）。通过理论证明与受控实验表明，三者缺一不可，且所有主流自监督方法均为统一能量分解的特例。
AI.motivation: 自监督视觉表征学习是否存在一个统一的理论框架来解释不同方法为何有效、以及它们所需的共同训练信号，仍缺乏严格的形式化分析。本文旨在回答"学习视觉表征究竟需要什么信号"这一根本问题。
AI.method: 作者形式化了三个原则：观测（语义不变性）、预测（补丁级空间预测）和正则化（非退化性），并证明：(i) 在无负样本对齐下，仅结合观测与预测而缺少正则化时，常数编码器是全局最小化器；(ii) 观测和预测两个目标在编码器输出处梯度互补且结构上不冲突；(iii) 动量编码器收敛到与在线编码器相同的固定点，且在收敛处不提供坍塌保证。对比对齐仅提供自限性的抗坍塌能力（通过显式梯度衰减论证）。同时构建一个统一能量分解，证明所有主流自监督方法均为其特例。
AI.result: 理论证明与受控实验（包括针对预测空间后果的补丁检索评估）共同表明：剔除预测会按其构式去除空间训练信号，剔除观测会按其构式丧失跨视图语义不变性，在所研究的规模下没有任何目标对可以替代第三个目标。
AI.conclusion: 无标签视觉表征学习的完备训练信号必须同时包含观测、预测和正则化三个非重叠目标，这为主流自监督方法提供了统一的理论解释，并明确了各方法不足之处的根本原因。

title: SuperLocalMemory 4.0: The Governed Memory Operating System for AI Agents
comment: 35 pages, 17 figures, 4 tables. Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21853302. Code: https://github.com/qualixar/superlocalmemory/releases/tag/v4.0.0
summary:
AI agents are becoming shared infrastructure, yet durable memory is commonly assembled from separate retrieval, governance, and operational components. We present SuperLocalMemory 4.0, a governed, local-first memory operating system for AI agents. The system combines dense semantic, BM25 lexical, temporal, Hopfield-associative, and spreading-activation retrieval through reciprocal-rank fusion; a governed learning and behaviour layer; bi-temporal recall; multi-scope personal, shared, and global memory; role-based access control; GDPR-oriented export and verified erasure; audit trails; and a deployment-context EU AI Act checklist.
  V4 introduces a reliability spine for its primary write path: generation-fenced admission, a policy registry, verifiable memory transactions with per-projection apply, verify, compensate, and erase owners, and hash-checkable completion manifests. The runtime is available through CLI, MCP, an HTTP daemon, a dashboard, editor integration, and framework adapters, and supports fully local, local-with-on-device-model, and provider-assisted modes.
  We evaluate eleven fault-injection and mechanism scenarios, each repeated 200 times. The released evidence bundle reports 2,200 of 2,200 deterministic repetitions upholding their scoped component properties. The governed write envelope measured 3.522 ms at p50 and 5.297 ms at p99, versus 1.835 ms and 2.569 ms for the ungoverned baseline, corresponding to in-process control-plane overheads of 1.687 ms at p50 and 2.728 ms at p99. These are scoped component and mechanism measurements, not an end-to-end multi-process or external retrieval-accuracy benchmark. The paper consolidates prior SuperLocalMemory work on privacy-preserving multi-agent memory, information-geometric retrieval, and the V3.3 Living Brain lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍SuperLocalMemory 4.0，一个以本地优先和治理为核心的多智能体AI记忆操作系统，整合了多种召回机制（语义、BM25、时序、Hopfield联想、激活扩散）通过倒数秩融合，并引入V4可靠性脊柱（生成围栏准入、策略注册表、可验证记忆事务、哈希可检查完成清单）。通过11个故障注入场景重复200次共2200次确定性测试验证可靠性，治理写入封装在p50/p99上相比基线分别增加1.687ms/2.728ms的控制平面开销。
AI.motivation: AI智能体正成为共享基础设施，但当前的持久记忆系统通常由分离的检索、治理和运维组件拼装而成，缺乏统一的、受治理的、本地优先的记忆操作系统方案。
AI.method: 系统结合稠密语义、BM25词法、时序、Hopfield联想和激活扩散检索，通过倒数秩融合；实现受治理的学习与行为层、双时间点回忆、多范围（个人/共享/全局）记忆、基于角色的访问控制、GDPR导向的导出与验证擦除、审计轨迹和EU AI Act部署检查清单。V4新增可靠性脊柱：生成围栏准入、策略注册表、带逐投影应用/验证/补偿/擦除所有者的可验证记忆事务，以及哈希可检查完成清单。通过CLI、MCP、HTTP守护进程、仪表板、编辑器集成和框架适配器提供运行时，支持完全本地、本地+设备上模型、提供商辅助三种模式。
AI.result: 评估覆盖11个故障注入和机制场景，每个重复200次；发布证据包报告2200/2200次确定性重复均维持其限定组件属性。治理写入封装的p50为3.522ms、p99为5.297ms，对比无治理基线（p50:1.835ms, p99:2.569ms），即进程内控制平面开销为p50 1.687ms、p99 2.728ms。作者明确声明这些是限定范围的组件和机制测量，而非端到端多进程或外部检索准确性基准。
AI.conclusion: SuperLocalMemory 4.0通过统一治理与可靠性脊柱，在可接受的进程内开销代价下（p99约2.7ms）实现了高确定性的记忆写入可靠性，并整合了此前的隐私保护多智能体记忆、信息几何检索和V3.3生活大脑生命周期工作。

title: Se-DPO: Self-Evolving Token Credit for Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aggregates token-level log-probability ratios via uniform summation, implicitly treating all tokens as contributing equally to the preference signal. However, the contribution of individual tokens to the preference signal varies. We introduce token credit, which modulates each token's KL regularization based on its contribution to the preference outcome. We derive that effective token credit is proportional to the magnitude of each token's implicit reward, and observe that this quantity evolves substantially during training. This implies that static token credit becomes increasingly misaligned as training progresses. In this work, we propose Se-DPO (Self-Evolving Token Credit for DPO), a live mechanism that derives token credit from the model's own evolving internal signals during DPO training. Since the reward signal varies in reliability across positions, Se-DPO calibrates token credit based on both the strength and the confidence of each token's contribution. Se-DPO requires no external models, adding only a lightweight calibration network with minimal computational overhead. Experiments show that Se-DPO improves over DPO by up to 9.8 points on AlpacaEval~2 and 12.2 points on Arena-Hard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Se-DPO（自演化Token信用动态直接偏好优化），针对DPO中均匀求和所有token对数概率比的问题，为每个token分配动态信用权重来调节其KL正则化，该信用由模型自身的内部信号动态演化生成，无需外部模型。
AI.motivation: DPO用均匀求和聚合token级对数概率比，隐含地认为所有token对偏好信号的贡献相同。但不同token对偏好结果的贡献差异显著，且token的隐式奖励幅度在训练过程中会大幅变化，导致静态token信用随训练推进而越来越失配。
AI.method: Se-DPO从模型自身演化的内部信号中动态推导token credit，该信用正比于每个token隐式奖励的幅度。由于奖励信号在不同位置的可靠性不同，Se-DPO同时基于每个token贡献的强度和置信度来校准token credit。仅需引入一个轻量校准网络，计算开销极小，无需外部模型。
AI.result: Se-DPO在AlpacaEval 2上相比DPO提升最多9.8个百分点，在Arena-Hard上提升最多12.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过为每个token分配自演化、自适应且基于置信度校准的信用权重，Se-DPO有效解决了DPO中token级贡献不均衡的问题，显著提升了偏好优化性能。

title: Your VLM Already Knows When: Training-Free Temporal Grounding by Asking Yes or No
summary: Multimodal LLMs that recognise events reliably still fail to say when they happen. Prompted for timestamps, strong VLMs reach as little as $3.8\%$ R@0.5 on Charades-STA, and $77$ to $80\%$ of their wrong predictions carry low output entropy: the models are confidently wrong, and entropy-based error detection stays below a random classifier. We show that this failure lives in the task interface, not in perception. Holding the weights fixed, replacing timestamp regression with a coarse-to-fine scan of binary questions, whose first-token probabilities are consumed only as a ranking, raises R@0.5 by $28$ to $50$ points across four frozen backbones. The residual failures decompose into two measurable axes: a perception axis that moves with the backbone, and a geometry axis that is analytically predictable from the ratio of the output-window and event widths. FV-Action, the training-free method built on this analysis, reaches $56.8\%$ R@0.5 on Charades-STA, above the same backbone's native grounding pipeline and the strongest training-free result on this benchmark; it surpasses every TVG-trained model evaluated zero-shot on TACoS, and improves over direct prediction on ActivityNet Captions and QVHighlights, with no temporal supervision at any stage.

AI.tldr: 多模态大语言模型虽能可靠识别事件，但无法准确预测事件发生时间。在冻结权重的条件下，将时间戳回归替换为粗到细的二进制问题扫描（仅消费首词概率作为排序），在四个冻结骨架上将R@0.5提升了28至50个百分点。基于此分析的无训练方法FV-Action在Charades-STA上达到56.8% R@0.5，超越同骨架的原生定位流程及最强无训练结果，并在多个基准上超越或改进现有方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在时间定位任务上表现极差（如Charades-STA上仅3.8% R@0.5），且模型对错误预测高度自信（77-80%的错误预测输出熵低），导致基于熵的错误检测甚至不如随机分类器。作者旨在查明失败根源并设计无需时间监督的解决方案。
AI.method: 作者证明失败源于任务接口而非感知能力：固定权重下，用粗到细的二进制问题扫描替代时间戳回归，仅将首词概率用作排序依据。将残余失败分解为两个可测量的维度：随骨干网络变化的感知轴，以及可由输出窗口与事件宽度比率解析预测的几何轴。据此构建无训练方法FV-Action。
AI.result: FV-Action在Charades-STA上达到56.8% R@0.5，超过同骨干的原生定位流程和该基准上最强的无训练结果；在TACoS上超越所有经TVG训练模型的零样本评估；在ActivityNet Captions和QVHighlights上相比直接预测有所改进，全程无需任何时间监督。
AI.conclusion: 多模态大语言模型的时间定位失败根源在于任务接口（时间戳回归）而非感知能力，通过将接口改为粗到细的二元问答扫描可大幅提升定位性能。该分析揭示了失败的可分解结构（感知轴+几何轴），为无监督时间定位提供了理论与实证基础。

title: Your Prompt Is Not the Only Prompt: How Much Do LLMs Weight Structured-Output Schema Descriptions?
summary: Structured output, where an LLM populates a predefined JSON schema, has become a default mechanism for data labeling and information extraction, but it also introduces a second instruction channel through schema descriptions. We tested whether classification-label definitions are better placed in the system prompt, user prompt, or schema description using a single-field classification task with nonce labels across ten model configurations from two vendors. Schema descriptions did not consistently outperform prompt-based placement; for GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.4 without reasoning, schema placement underperformed system prompts by 11-13 percentage points. Yet schemas are not inert metadata: when prompts and schemas conflicted, incorrect schema instructions caused accuracy drops of 5-45 points, with Claude Haiku 4.5 falling from 52.5% to 7%, indicating that schema instructions can override prompt instructions, and GPT-5.5 falling from 100% to 73%. Further, adding a required intermediate reasoning field before the label field improved schema-only accuracy by 15-24 points when headroom existed, exceeding system-prompt-only performance in every case tested. The effect held even for Claude Sonnet 4.6 at medium reasoning, where extended thinking alone did not produce a comparable gain. This suggests that schema design can affect how effectively models use information encoded in field descriptions. Overall, these results indicate that schema influence is model-dependent. In practice, the system prompt remains a safe default for definitions, but the bigger discipline is maintaining a single source of truth and preventing prompt/schema drift. More importantly, schema design itself may be a stronger lever than instruction placement. Practitioners should treat prompts and schemas as a unified instruction surface and empirically validate both placement and field design for their target model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了结构化输出中Schema描述作为第二指令通道的效果，发现Schema置放并不稳定优于提示词置放，且因模型而异；但Schema并非惰性元数据——冲突时可能覆盖提示词指令导致准确率大幅下降。关键发现是，在标签字段前添加中间推理字段可使仅Schema的准确率提升15-24个百分点，甚至超过仅系统提示词的性能，表明Schema设计本身可能比指令置放更重要的杠杆。
AI.motivation: LLM填充JSON Schema的结构化输出已成为数据标注和信息提取的默认机制，但Schema描述引入了第二条指令通道。现有实践对"分类标签定义应放在系统提示词、用户提示词还是Schema描述中"缺乏系统验证，且提示词与Schema冲突时的行为尚不明晰。作者旨在回答Schema设计如何影响模型对字段描述中信息的利用效率。
AI.method: 使用单字段分类任务，采用非ce标签（nonce labels），覆盖两家供应商的十种模型配置（含GPT-4.1、GPT-5.4、Claude Haiku 4.5、Claude Sonnet 4.6等），对比三种指令置放方式（系统提示词、用户提示词、Schema描述）的性能；设计提示词与Schema冲突的对照实验；并测试在标签字段前添加必需中间推理字段对准确率的影响。
AI.result: （1）Schema描述并未一致优于提示词置放，GPT-4.1和GPT-5.4（无推理）的Schema置放比系统提示词低11-13个百分点。（2）当提示词与Schema冲突时，错误的Schema指令导致准确率下降5-45个百分点（Claude Haiku 4.5从52.5%跌至7%；GPT-5.5从100%跌至73%），证明Schema能覆盖提示词。（3）在标签字段前添加必需推理字段，使仅Schema准确率提升15-24个百分点（存在空间时），且在所有测试案例中超过仅系统提示词的性能；该效应在Claude Sonnet 4.6中即使启用扩展思维也未获得可比增益。
AI.conclusion: Schema的影响是模型依赖的。实践上，系统提示词仍是定义的安全默认位置，但更重要的是维护单一真实来源、防止提示词/Schema漂移。Schema设计本身可能是比指令置放更强的杠杆。建议将提示词和Schema视为统一的指令表面，并针对目标模型实证验证置放位置与字段设计。

title: MDB-Link: Hierarchical Schema Linking for Multi-Database Text-to-SQL
summary: Traditional Text-to-SQL research and benchmarks assume a known target database, overlooking settings in which a query must be routed within a large, heterogeneous database collection. We therefore study schema linking in a multi-database setting, where the system must first locate the target database and then construct a compact, SQL-relevant schema for generation. We propose MDB-Link, a hierarchical schema-linking framework that retrieves question-relevant columns from a global index, aggregates retrieval evidence to shortlist databases, and uses a budget-aware large language model (LLM) for database reranking, table selection, and column grounding. With Qwen2.5-14B, MDB-Link outperforms LinkAlign on MMQA, Spider2-Snow, and BIRD-dev in database localization and column selection while producing schema subsets close in size to the gold schemas. Exact match improves from 16.88 to 51.41 on MMQA, 2.50 to 9.17 on Spider2-Snow, and 12.52 to 38.01 on BIRD-dev. MDB-Link also runs faster than LinkAlign and AutoLink, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical schema reduction for downstream SQL generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MDB-Link，一个面向多数据库场景的层次化schema链接框架，通过全局索引检索、数据库短名单聚合、以及预算感知的LLM重排序和表/列选择，实现了查询在大型异构数据库集合中的路由定位和紧凑schema构建，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统Text-to-SQL研究和基准假设目标数据库已知，忽略了查询需要在大型异构数据库集合中路由的场景。现有方法缺少在多数据库设置下首先定位目标数据库，再为生成构建紧凑且SQL相关的schema的解决方案。
AI.method: MDB-Link采用层次化schema链接框架：(1) 从全局索引检索问题相关的列；(2) 聚合检索证据以短名单候选数据库；(3) 使用预算感知的LLM进行数据库重排序、表选择和列落地。
AI.result: 使用Qwen2.5-14B，MDB-Link在MMQA、Spider2-Snow和BIRD-dev上超越LinkAlign，在数据库定位和列选择方面表现更好；生成的schema子集大小接近黄金schema。Exact match在MMQA上从16.88提升至51.41，Spider2-Snow上从2.50提升至9.17，BIRD-dev上从12.52提升至38.01。MDB-Link运行速度也优于LinkAlign和AutoLink。
AI.conclusion: MDB-Link验证了层次化schema缩减对下游SQL生成的有效性，展示了在多数据库异构集合中进行查询路由和紧凑schema构建的实用方案。

title: A continually expandable foundation model for brain MRI
summary: Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to neuroscience and clinical assessment, but models are commonly developed for individual diseases, populations or imaging protocols. Foundation models promise more general representations, yet they are usually pretrained once and can lose earlier capabilities when updated with new data. Here we show that Alcmaeon, a three-dimensional brain MRI foundation model pretrained without manual labels on more than 425,000 volumes and derived imaging maps, can be expanded sequentially across clinical domains. Alcmaeon combines volumetric encoding and latent diffusion generation with Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP), which protects network modules important to earlier domains while leaving the remaining capacity trainable. Across expansion from healthy ageing and neurodegeneration to developmental, psychiatric and tumour imaging, GBP showed less forgetting than sequential adaptation and elastic weight consolidation across voxel-level reconstruction measures, with its largest advantage after adaptation to tumour imaging. The blueprints provided an inspectable record of how model capacity was protected and reused. Representations from different model levels supported image synthesis, disease classification, survival modelling and postoperative prediction, although no single representation was optimal for every task. These findings provide a route towards brain MRI foundation models that can grow with emerging data while retaining earlier capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Alcmaeon，一个基于超过425,000个体积和衍生影像图谱、无需人工标注预训练的三维脑MRI基础模型。该模型通过图蓝图剪枝（GBP）实现跨临床领域的顺序扩展，在从健康衰老和神经退行性疾病扩展到发育、精神疾病和肿瘤影像时，相比顺序微调和弹性权重巩固表现出更少的灾难性遗忘。蓝图提供了模型能力保护和复用的可检查记录，不同模型层的表征分别支持图像合成、疾病分类、生存建模和术后预测。
AI.motivation: 传统脑MRI模型通常针对单一疾病、人群或成像协议开发，缺乏通用性；现有基础模型虽然追求通用表征，但通常只预训练一次，在加入新数据更新时会遗忘早期习得的能力（灾难性遗忘）。需要一个既能跨临床领域扩展、又能保留早期能力的脑MRI基础模型。
AI.method: Alcmaeon采用三维体积编码与潜在扩散生成的架构，结合图蓝图剪枝（GBP）技术——该技术保护对早期领域重要的网络模块（蓝图），同时保持剩余容量可训练，从而在顺序扩展过程中实现知识与能力的保留。
AI.result: 在从健康衰老/神经退行性疾病扩展到发育、精神疾病和肿瘤影像的实验中，GBP在体素级重建指标上比顺序适应和弹性权重巩固表现出更少的遗忘，且在肿瘤影像适应后的优势最为显著。不同模型层的表征在不同任务（图像合成、分类、生存建模、术后预测）中各有优势，没有单一表征在所有任务上都最优。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了一条构建可随新数据持续成长、同时保留早期能力的脑MRI基础模型的路径。蓝图机制不仅缓解了灾难性遗忘，还提供了模型能力分配的可解释性记录。

title: OBLIVION: Workflow-Level Operational Skill Unlearning for Deployed Agents
summary: Large language model agents are becoming operational interfaces to files, memories, registries, and external tools. This deployment shift creates a new skill revocation problem: after a skill is removed from an explicit registry, an agent may still reconstruct it from residual carriers such as archives, transcripts, schemas, or memory entries. We study this problem as operational skill unlearning, where the goal is not parameter-level forgetting, but preventing a deployed agent from rebuilding a revoked skill through primitive tools. We introduce OBLIVION, a controlled benchmark and defense harness for revoked-skill resurrection. OBLIVION models each episode as a source-to-sink workflow, applies Cross-Surface Coherent Erasure to reduce residual carriers, and uses frozen workflow remediation near dangerous sinks. On the locked 88 attack episodes, the no-defense arm reaches formal attack success rate 1.0. OBLIVION reduces the rate to 0.114 and impact-weighted exposure to 0.115 while keeping locked utility at 1.0 and benign block rate at 0. In a separate skill-attack-derived sandbox, OBLIVION reduces attack success from 1.0 to 0.2 and impact-weighted exposure from 1.0 to 0.213 while preserving all utility controls. These results support workflow-level evaluation beyond checking explicit skill entries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型智能体中的"技能撤销"（skill revocation）问题——当已撤销技能仍能从残留载体中被重建时，如何阻止部署中的智能体通过基础工具复原被撤销的技能。作者提出OBLIVION基准与防御框架，通过跨表面一致擦除和冻结工作流修复，将攻击成功率从1.0降至0.114（锁定场景）和0.2（沙盒场景），同时保持效用不受影响。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体正成为文件、内存、注册表和外部工具的操作接口，这种部署转变带来了新的"技能撤销问题"：即使技能从显式注册表中移除，智能体仍可能从归档、转录、模式或内存条目等残留载体中重建该技能。传统参数级遗忘方法无法解决这种操作层面的技能重建威胁，需要面向工作流级别的防御方案。
AI.method: OBLIVION包含基准与防御两大部分。基准将每个情节建模为源到汇（source-to-sink）的工作流；防御采用Cross-Surface Coherent Erasure（跨表面一致擦除）以减少各表面上的残留载体，并在危险汇附近使用冻结工作流修复（frozen workflow remediation）。实验设置包括88个锁定攻击情节和技能攻击衍生的独立沙盒。
AI.result: 在88个锁定攻击情节中，无防御组形式攻击成功率达到1.0，OBLIVION将其降至0.114，影响加权暴露度降至0.115，同时锁定效用保持在1.0、良性阻止率为0。在独立沙盒中，OBLIVION将攻击成功率从1.0降至0.2，影响加权暴露度从1.0降至0.213，且保留所有效用控制。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持在显式技能条目检查之外进行工作流级别的评估。OBLIVION证明操作级技能遗忘（operational skill unlearning）是可行且有效的，防御目标不是参数级遗忘，而是阻止已部署智能体通过原始工具重建被撤销的技能。

title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks
summary: Internal safety scores judge a prompt before any text is generated, and they are validated by how well they separate harmful prompts from benign ones. That separation is then read as evidence that the score will also catch the attacks that succeed. Harmful intent is a property of the prompt. Jailbreak success is an outcome produced later by a particular target model, decoding policy, and judge. A filter tuned on a score that measures the wrong quantity spends its false positive budget on attacks that would have failed anyway. In this paper we audit that inference. Attention based measurements are usually read from prompt dependent locations, so a wrapper changes both the content being judged and the place the signal is taken from. We therefore introduce Active Attention Probing, which supplies a fixed content independent measurement coordinate. We pair every base goal with a plain and a wrapped version and generate real completions from the target models. On Llama, wrapping raises harmful generation from 0.05 to 0.27 while harmful intent AUROC falls from 0.936 to 0.803, so the attacks grow more dangerous while the prompts look safer to the score. Among wrapped harmful prompts the outcome AUROC is 0.220, which places the attacks that succeeded below the attacks that failed. Rare token, passive, and detector derived channels reproduce the reversal on the same matched design, and the reversal itself persists across three target models, seven attack families, and two independent judges. Distribution shift then degrades calibration and threshold transfer before it degrades ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文质询了一个常见推断：内部安全分数（用于生成前判断提示词）能有效区分有害与良性提示词，就被认为也能捕捉后续真正成功的越狱攻击。作者引入“Active Attention Probing”（主动注意力探测），提供固定、与内容无关的测量坐标，证明在包装（wrapper）攻击下，有害生成率上升但有害意图AUROC下降，出现“攻击更危险而提示词看起来更安全”的反转现象。该反转在多种目标模型、攻击家族和评判器上稳健存在，且分布偏移先损害校准和阈值迁移，再损害排序。
AI.motivation: 内部安全分数常依据其区分有害/良性提示词的能力来验证，并据此推断能捕捉真正成功的攻击。但“有害意图”与“越狱成功”是不同概念——前者是提示词属性，后者是后续目标模型、解码策略和评判器共同作用的产物。若分数测错了量，会把假阳性预算浪费在本来就会失败的攻击上。作者希望审计这一推断链条的有效性。
AI.method: 引入Active Attention Probing（主动注意力探测），提供固定且与内容无关的测量坐标，避免传统基于注意力测量因从提示词相关位置读取信号而受包装攻击干扰的问题。将每个基础目目标与普通和包装版本配对，从目标模型生成真实完成结果。在Llama上比较有害生成率与有害意图AUROC；评估包装后有害提示词的“结果AUROC”（outcome AUROC）；还测试稀有token、被动及检测器派生通道在同一匹配设计上的表现，跨三个目标模型、七个攻击家族和两个独立评判器验证。
AI.result: 在Llama上，包装使有害生成从0.05升至0.27，而有害意图AUROC从0.936降至0.803——攻击变得更危险但提示词在分数上看起来更安全。包装后有害提示词的结果AUROC为0.220，意味着成功的攻击排在失败的攻击之下。稀有token、被动和检测器派生通道在同一匹配设计上复现了这一反转，且反转在三个目标模型、七个攻击家族和两个独立评判器上持续存在。分布偏移先损害校准与阈值迁移，之后才损害排序。
AI.conclusion: 以有害意图分离能力验证的安全分数，并不能可靠预测越狱成功。当提示词被包装后，分数会系统性地把成功的攻击排在失败攻击之下，产生反向排序。这提示安全评估应直接度量“攻击结果”而非仅依赖意图分离指标，且阈值/校准的迁移性需在分布偏移下单独评估。

title: Circuit Fine-Tuning for Compute-Efficient Transformer Adaptation
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become the de facto standard for adapting Vision Transformers (ViTs) to downstream tasks. While parameter count has been the dominant efficiency metric in PEFT, it does not imply \textit{compute efficiency}: parameter-sparse methods can still incur full-model training cost per step, and typically need long schedules to reach peak accuracy. We introduce Circuit Fine-Tuning (CFT), a compute-efficient framework that uses circuit discovery---conventionally used to explain trained models---to select modules for fine-tuning before training. Whereas attribution is conventionally formulated against a trained task head, we formulate it against a near-zero-initialized probe head, which isolates the response of the backbone to the target distribution rather than the preferences of a particular classifier. CFT then fine-tunes only the recovered subgraph. CFT needs no learning-rate warmup and reaches peak accuracy in ${\sim}20$ epochs on average---versus $44$--$96$ for strong PEFT baselines---yielding $2.3$--$6.6\times$ fewer training FLOPs and up to $16\times$ less wall-clock time, while adding zero parameters and no inference operations. Experiments across a standard visual transfer benchmark (VTAB-1k), hierarchical backbones (Swin), domain-shifted medical imaging (CBIS-DDSM), and a vision-language model (Gemma-3 on CUB-200) demonstrate the effectiveness of CFT. Code is available at https://github.com/UriKialy/CFT

AI.tldr: 本文提出电路微调（CFT），一种以计算效率为核心的参数高效微调框架。CFT在训练前使用电路发现技术选择要微调的模块子图，并且将归因公式化到近零初始化的探针头上（而非训练好的任务头），从而隔离骨干网络对目标分布而非特定分类器偏好的响应。CFT无需学习率预热，平均约20个epoch达到峰值精度（对比强PEFT基线需44-96个epoch），训练FLOPs减少2.3-6.6倍，墙钟时间减少最多16倍，且零参数增加、无推理开销。在VTAB-1k、Swin、CBIS-DDSM和Gemma-3 on CUB-200等基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法以参数量作为效率主要指标，但参数稀疏并不意味着计算高效：参数稀疏的方法仍可能每步经历全模型训练成本，且通常需要长时间训练计划才能达到峰值精度。作者希望弥合参数量效率与计算效率之间的差距，提出真正在训练FLOPs和墙钟时间上高效的微调框架。
AI.method: CFT使用电路发现（传统上用于解释已训练模型）在训练前选择微调模块。关键创新是归因的公式化对象：不同于传统对训练好的任务头进行归因，CFT针对近零初始化的探针头进行归因，以此隔离骨干网络对目标分布的响应而非特定分类器的偏好。训练时仅微调恢复出的子图（subgraph），无需学习率预热。
AI.result: CFT平均约20个epoch达到峰值精度，而强PEFT基线需要44-96个epoch；训练FLOPs减少2.3-6.6倍，墙钟时间最多减少16倍；同时不增加参数、无额外推理操作。在VTAB-1k、Swin（层级骨干）、CBIS-DDSM（域偏移医学影像）和Gemma-3 on CUB-200（视觉语言模型）上均有效。
AI.conclusion: CFT证明了电路发现可以作为前训练选择的工具，将归因目标从任务头转为近零初始化的探针头，能够显著提升微调的计算效率，同时保持参数和推理零开销，是一种通用的计算高效PEFT框架。

title: Exploring LLM Capabilities for Situational Understanding and COLREG compliance on real-world maritime navigation scenarios
comment: Submitted and accepted to the IFAC WC 2026 as an invited session paper for track 7.2 Transportation and Vehicle Systems - Marine Systems
summary: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown considerable capability for situational understanding, reasoning, and decision making in different domains, most notable in the automotive sector. Therefore, we explore current state-of-the-art LLMs as a tool for maritime navigation, which includes both codified rules in the Collision Regulations (COLREGs) and uncodified best practices summarized in the concept of ``Good Seamanship''. We construct a dataset consisting of 50 diverse, real-world navigation scenarios from AIS data, label scenarios with applicable COLREG rules, recommended actions, and the reasoning for the action. We explore a variety of different LLM architectures and sizes to determine their understanding of maritime navigation tasks as well as evaluate their reasoning capabilities in this domain. The results obtained indicate that the maritime navigation task remains difficult to solve without fine-tuning, even for larger online models.

AI.tldr: 本文探索使用大型语言模型（LLMs）进行海上导航任务，构建了基于AIS数据的50个真实导航场景数据集，并标注了COLREG规则和推荐行动。研究发现，即使是大规模的在线LLM模型，在未经微调的情况下也难以解决海上导航任务。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在汽车领域的态势理解、推理和决策方面展现了较强能力，因此作者希望探索将其应用于海事导航领域。海事导航既包含成文的碰撞规则（COLREGs）也包含不成文的良好航海实践（Good Seamanship），这为LLM的应用提出了独特挑战。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个包含50个多样化真实世界导航场景的数据集（来源于AIS数据），为每个场景标注适用的COLREG规则、推荐行动及行动推理。然后评测了多种不同架构和规模的LLM，考察其对海事导航任务的理解能力和推理能力。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，海事导航任务在未经微调的情况下仍然难以解决，即使是更大的在线模型也难以胜任该任务。
AI.conclusion: 海上导航涉及编码化规则（COLREGs）与未编码化的良好航海实践，现有LLM在不进行微调的情况下无法充分掌握这一领域知识，需要针对性的微调或领域适配才能提升性能。

title: How Do Large Language Models Judge Social Attraction? Evidence from Theory-Grounded Persona Ratings Across Multiple LLMs and Humans
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Includes technical supplement
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to perform subjective evaluations traditionally made by humans, yet their validity as social judges remains unclear. This paper examines whether LLMs can assess social attraction from theory-grounded persona profiles constructed from ten psychological and relational constructs and organized into three tiers: socially attractive, socially mixed, and socially unattractive. We examine LLM ratings in two studies and compare them with human judgments in a third study. In Study 1, 34 LLMs rated 12 profiles across three repeated runs. Although some models tended to give higher or lower ratings overall, they showed strong stability across runs, consistent three-tier ordering, and high agreement in relative profile ordering. Study 2 examined sensitivity to gender presentation using six matched name-and-pronoun profile pairs and a separate pronoun-only test with a gender-neutral name, finding no significant effects in either analysis. In Study 3, 198 human participants evaluated the six matched profiles from Study 2. Their ratings reproduced the three-tier structure and followed a profile ordering consistent with that of the LLMs. However, LLMs rated attractive profiles more positively and unattractive profiles more negatively than humans, while neither group showed a significant overall effect of gender presentation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三个研究系统检验了LLM作为"社会评价者"的有效性：研究1中34个LLM对基于人格构念构建的三层人格档案进行评分，表现出高稳定性、一致的分层排序和高一致性；研究2发现性别呈现对LLM评分无显著影响；研究3中198名人类参与者的评分复现了三层结构和排序，但LLM在极端档案上趋向更极端的评分。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被用于替代人类进行主观评价，但其作为社会评价者的有效性（即能否像人类一样评估社会吸引力）尚不明确。现有研究缺乏从理论构建的人格档案出发、系统比较LLM与人类判断的系统性验证。
AI.method: 设计三项研究：(1) 34个LLM对12个基于心理学和关系学构念构建的三层（有吸引力/混合/无吸引力）人格档案进行三轮重复评分，评估稳定性、分层顺序和排序一致性；(2) 使用六组匹配姓名与代词的个人资料对及一个仅代词对照测试，检验性别呈现效应；(3) 招募198名人类参与者评估研究2中的六组匹配档案，与LLM评分进行直接比较。
AI.result: 研究1：LLM虽然存在整体评分高低偏差，但运行间高度稳定、三层排序一致、相对档案排序有高度共识。研究2：性别呈现（姓名和代词）对LLM评分无显著影响。研究3：人类评分复现了三层结构且排序与LLM一致，但LLM对吸引力档案评分更正面、对无吸引力档案评分更负面；两个群体均未表现出显著的性别呈现效应。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够做出与人类高度一致的相对社会吸引力判断，表明其具有作为社会评价者的潜力；但在绝对评分上存在两端趋向极端的系统偏差，需在对LLM主观评价结果进行解读时予以考虑。

title: Tropical Cyclone Forecasting via Latent Rectified Flow using Satellite Imagery and Atmospheric Fields
summary: Tropical cyclones are growing more destructive in a changing climate, and efficient forecasting of their structure and track has become a necessity. Deep generative models promise an alternative to computationally expensive numerical weather prediction (NWP), yet current systems produce either satellite imagery or atmospheric fields, never both; they need many sampling steps, putting them out of reach of modest hardware; and their storm tracks come from regression heads with no physical link to the generated atmosphere. This work presents a single-pass model that jointly forecasts GRIDSAT-B1 infrared imagery and four ERA5 atmospheric fields (U-wind, V-wind, air temperature, and surface pressure) out to nine hours. A five-channel variational autoencoder compresses each 5 x 256 x 256 frame to a 4 x 64 x 64 latent, and a conditional rectified-flow UNet with a factorized temporal-attention module predicts the next three frames from three past frames, their best-track coordinates, and timestamps. The model is then reward-fine-tuned (DRaFT) against a differentiable track error derived from the predicted winds through a steering-flow calculation. On held-out 2022 storms the model reaches 16.35 dB PSNR and 0.759 SSIM, ahead of a reproduced cascaded-diffusion baseline at every lead time (+0.84 dB at +9 h) while sampling ~30x faster (56 ms vs. 1673 ms). Track error at +9 h is 62.4 km, 15% below the baseline, and a reward fine-tuning study demonstrates a further 8-11% track-error reduction across sampler budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个单步（single-pass）深度生成模型，联合预测热带气旋的GRIDSAT-B1红外卫星影像与四个ERA5大气场（U风、V风、气温、地表气压），预测时长9小时。模型采用五通道变分自编码器将5×256×256帧压缩为4×64×64潜变量，配以条件整流流UNet和分解时间注意力模块，从3个过去帧预测后续3帧。模型通过DRaFT（可微奖励微调）针对由预测风场经引导流计算得到的可微路径误差进行优化。在2022年留出风暴测试集上达到16.35 dB PSNR和0.759 SSIM，全面领先级联扩散基线（+0.84 dB@+9h），采样速度约快30倍（56 ms vs 1673 ms），+9h路径误差62.4 km，比基线低15%，奖励微调进一步降低8-11%路径误差。
AI.motivation: 气候变化下热带气旋更具破坏性，需要高效的路径与结构预报。数值天气预报（NWP）计算成本高，而现有深度生成模型要么只生成卫星影像、要么只生成大气场，无法同时得到两者；且需要大量采样步骤，难以在一般硬件上运行；其气旋路径来自回归头，与生成的大气场之间缺乏物理耦合。因此需要一种既高效又能联合生成多模态数据、且路径与大气物理关联的模型。
AI.method: 模型由两部分构成：(1) 五通道变分自编码器（VAE）将5×256×256的帧（含4个大气场+1个红外影像通道）压缩为4×64×64的潜表示；(2) 条件整流流UNet（rectified-flow UNet），内含分解式时间注意力模块（factorized temporal-attention），以3个过去帧的潜变量、最佳路径坐标和时间戳为条件，单步预测未来3帧。训练分为两阶段：先进行标准生成式训练，再通过DRaFT（Differentiable Reward Fine-Tuning）框架，以从预测风场经引导流（steering-flow）计算得到的可微路径误差为奖励进行微调，使路径预测与生成的大气动力学直接耦合。
AI.result: 在2022年留出风暴测试集上，模型达到16.35 dB PSNR和0.759 SSIM，在全部预报时效内均优于复现的级联扩散基线（+9h时+0.84 dB），采样速度约快30倍（56 ms vs 1673 ms）。+9h路径误差为62.4 km，比基线低15%。奖励微调实验表明，在不同采样器预算下可进一步减少8-11%的路径误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了单步联合生成卫星影像与大气场在热带气旋预报中的可行性，通过整流流实现高效采样，并通过可微奖励微调将路径预测直接锚定到物理上连贯的大气动力场，显著优于级联扩散基线，在精度和推理速度上均有明显提升。

title: Fair on the Surface? Benchmarking Hidden-Output Fairness Gaps in LLM Recommenders
summary: Fairness audits for LLM-based recommenders have largely focused on observable outputs, implicitly assuming that stable recommendations reflect stable internal processing. We challenge this assumption with FairGap, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate recommendation fairness at two levels: observable output shift (OBS) and hidden representation shift (IBS), measured through controlled counterfactual identity probes across gender, age, and race. Their relationship is summarized via Representation-Output Alignment (ROA), with quadrant diagnostics for identifying user-level hidden-output mismatch. Applied to six open-weight LLM families across three domains, FairGap reveals pervasive hidden-output decoupling: ROA rarely exceeds 0.22, and a non-negligible user population shows stable outputs despite substantial internal shifts, a mode that output-only audits cannot detect by design. Further, activation steering that reduces IBS by up to 8x simultaneously worsens OBS, demonstrating a fundamental tension between internal and output-level fairness that existing frameworks are unequipped to diagnose.

AI.tldr: FairGap是首个联合评估LLM推荐系统两个层面公平性的基准：可观察输出偏移(OBS)与隐藏表征偏移(IBS)，通过反事实身份探针在性别、年龄、种族维度上进行可控测量。在六个开源LLM家族三个领域的实验中发现隐藏-输出解耦现象普遍存在（ROA极少超过0.22），出现输出稳定但内部大幅偏移的用户群体，且激活操控在降低IBS达8倍的同时恶化了OBS，揭示了内部与输出层面公平性之间的根本张力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推荐系统公平性审计仅关注可观察输出，隐含假设稳定推荐反映稳定内部处理，但这种假设未被验证。作者想要挑战这一假设，揭示仅基于输出的公平性审计可能存在的盲区。
AI.method: 提出FairGap基准，在可观察输出层(输出偏移OBS)和隐藏表征层(隐藏表征偏移IBS)两个层面联合评估公平性，通过可控反事实身份探针在性别、年龄、种族维度进行测量。定义表征-输出对齐度(ROA)总结两者关系，并提供象限诊断来识别用户层面的隐藏-输出不匹配。在六个开源LLM家族三个领域上应用。
AI.result: 揭示了普遍存在的隐藏-输出解耦现象：ROA极少超过0.22；存在输出稳定但内部显著偏移的用户群体（仅输出审计无法检测的模式）；激活操控将IBS降低至8倍的同时使OBS恶化，表明内部与输出层面公平性存在根本性张力。
AI.conclusion: 仅观察输出的公平性审计在诊断LLM推荐系统的真实公平状态上存在系统性盲区。内部表征与输出层面的公平性并不必然对齐，甚至可能相互矛盾，现有框架无法诊断这种张力，需要同时考虑两个层面的公平性评估。

title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
summary: Audio Description (AD) is a verbal narration of key visual content in videos, enabling access for visually impaired audiences. Unlike standard video captioning, AD is a structured editorial task: descriptions must be inserted into gaps in dialogue and must convey only what is needed to understand the narrative being told. However, existing approaches formulate AD generation in an artificial setting where both the content and timing of descriptions are pre-specified, reducing the task to clip-level captioning. They further rely on noisy transcription and alignment pipelines, and lack the rich parallel data required for modeling narrative context. We introduce a new formulation of AD generation in which models must jointly decide what to describe and when to do it. To support this, we present REFRAMED, a high-quality dataset of 2,023 videos that span 3,302 scenes from 206 movies, with professional AD transcripts (both American and British versions), professional subtitles and aligned screenplays. We also provide a manually curated challenge set that pairs full movies with multiple AD references, together with evaluation protocols that leverage dialogue gaps and multi-reference comparisons. Experiments with state-of-the-art AD systems and multimodal LLMs show that they outperform trivial baselines but fall far short of expert human performance. Our dataset and benchmark establish a new foundation for research on video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文重新定义了自动音频描述（AD）生成任务：模型需同时决定"描述什么"和"何时描述"，而非在预指定的片段级设定下进行描述生成。作者提出了REFRAMED数据集，包含206部电影的2,023个视频、3,302个场景，配有专业AD文本（美国版和英国版）、专业字幕及对齐的剧本，并提供人工精选的全电影多参考挑战集及基于对话间隙和多参考比较的评估协议。实验表明现有最先进的AD系统和多模态大语言模型虽优于平凡基线，但与人类专家表现相去甚远。
AI.motivation: 现有的AD生成方法在人为设定下进行——描述的内容和时间都被预先指定，将任务降格为片段级字幕生成。这些方法依赖有噪声的转录和对齐流程，缺乏建模叙事上下文所需的丰富并行数据，无法捕捉AD作为结构化编辑任务（须插入对话间隙、只传达理解叙事所需内容）的本质。
